Summons a lightning spear while also manifesting ancient dragon crests. On throwing the spear, the crests will launch additional spears.
Charge to increase the number of crests and add a bolt of lightning to impact.

An incantation that was taught only to the most accomplished knights, and now a lost art in the Lands Between.
“古龙”芙柔桑克斯的特殊祷告。\n\n能召唤红色雷电，缠绕执行者与周围我方人物。:
Special incantation of the ancient dragon Florissax.

Calls down red lightning to bolster the caster and nearby allies. While enrobed with red lightning, all forms of damage negation (including physical) are increased. This also increases damage negation while guarding as an additional effect.

There was a time when the priestess never knew love, and thus never used this incantation herself.
王城古龙信仰的其中一种祷告。\n\n能召唤雷电，让执行者的身体带有雷电。\n在此:
One of the incantations of the capital's ancient dragon cult.

Calls down lightning to charge the caster's body.
While charged, electric shocks will strike the area several times.
Charging increases potency.

The origin of incantations that bolster the body with lightning, and now a lost art in the Lands Between.
龙飨祷告之中，最具代表性的一个。\n能展现“狂龙”贝勒的巨大力量。\n\n能将自:
One of the greatest Dragon Communion incantations.
Harnesses the fearsome power of Bayle the Dread.

Channels the form of the dread dragon to emit a mighty roar accompanied by a heatwave burst, causing violent eruptions of fire in the area.

Even after being consumed, the throbbing heart of Bayle continues to resist its subjugation, never weakening. One day, the fire within will consume the very body and soul of its Communion devourer. One day.

One of the greatest Dragon Communion incantations.
Harnesses the fearsome power of Bayle the Dread.

Channels the form of the dread dragon in right arm to smash foes with an exposed talon bone coursing with flame lightning.

Even after being consumed, the throbbing heart of Bayle continues to resist its subjugation, never weakening. One day, the fire within will consume the very body and soul of its Communion devourer. One day.
其中一种龙飨祷告。\n\n能将自身化为龙，从空中喷出灵火吐息。\n借由蓄力能延长:
One of the incantations of Dragon Communion.

Transforms caster into a dragon to spew ghostflame breath from above.
Charging extends duration. This incantation can be used while jumping.

The land of spiritgraves is home to all manner of dead, and even the corpses of fallen dragons found their way there. Several of them were endowed with such vivacity that even in death, they could not fully die.
“花蕾圣女”萝蜜娜使用的祷告。\n\n能缓慢旋身，唤来无数蝴蝶。\n蝴蝶触碰后会:
Incantation used by Romina, Saint of the Bud.

Summons a myriad of butterflies while performing a gentle twirl. The butterflies break apart on contact, scattering rot and setting off a chain reaction.

The scarlet butterflies are as the Goddess of Rot's wings. Bereft of a master, they were soothed by Romina, who reached out to them.
腐败眷属──虫群使用的招式。\n能作为祷告执行。\n\n能分泌大量具粘性的丝线，:
Skill of the pests known as the Kindred of Rot, now wielded as an incantation.

Secrete numerous sticky threads, then twist them into two spears launched frontwards. Charge to enhance potency.

The pests are abandoned servants, and it is for this reason that they found a mother in the Saint of the Bud.
赞颂“癫火之王”米德拉而有的祷告。\n\n能召唤形似癫火之王的头部，散布癫火。\:
Incantation in praise of Midra, Lord of Frenzied Flame.

Summons an apparition of the Lord's head to spew frenzied flame.
This incantation can be used while in motion. The apparition will remain for as long as the input is held.

The Lord of Frenzied Flame shall take their torment, despair. Their affliction. Every sin, every curse. All melted away.
Yet Midra, like others before him, was too weak to become a Lord.
“大祭司”尤弥尔的指头魔法。\n其中一个受隐匿的奥秘。\n\n能在目标脚边形成神:
A finger sorcery of Count Ymir, High Priest.
One of the secret hallowed rites.

Conjures an image of a microcosm at a foe's feet that pulses with a single wave before disappearing in a burst.
Charging enhances potency.

The broken and discarded are fully willing to cling to fleeting simulacra, earning them some modicum of sympathy.
自愿成为指头之母的“大祭司”尤弥尔\n所施展的指头魔法。\n\n能形成包围施展者:
A finger sorcery of Count Ymir, aspiring mother of fingers.

Surrounds the caster with a mesh of hefty fingers that wards all manner of projectiles, whether magical or physical in nature, away from the caster. Charging enhances potency.

The dear fingers look after their mother, or perhaps that is merely what the mother wishes to believe.
角人老妪托付的意念。\n\n能在自身头上召唤守护灵。\n守护灵会紧紧跟随执行者，:
An entreaty received from the hornsent grandam.

Summon a guardian spirit above the caster's head. The spirit never strays far from the caster, conjuring several apparitions before dissipating.

"Take vengeance upon Messmer and his lot.
They who betrayed us, aye, they who burned us...
Let them face in thy wrath their just deserts."
塔的拷问官们施展的魔法。\n能作为螺旋祷告执行。\n\n能挥动手臂，连续释放黄金:
Sorcery of the inquisitors of the tower, wielded as an incantation of the spiral.

A swing of the arm releases a procession of golden arcs.
Charging enhances potency.

The arcs resemble barbs, a known symbol of coercive questioning.
塔的拷问官们施展的魔法。\n能作为螺旋祷告执行。\n\n能挥动手臂，释放黄金大弯:
Sorcery of the inquisitors of the tower, wielded as an incantation of the spiral.

A swing of the arm releases a giant golden arc.
Charging enhances potency.

The arc resembles the barb, a known symbol of coercive questioning.
塔的祭司们施展的高阶魔法。\n能作为螺旋祷告执行。\n\n双手交叉紧握后，高举指:
Superior sorcery of the tower priests, wielded as an incantation of the spiral.

Wrap one's arms together and hold them up to the heavens to summon a spiral of light that erupts at the enemy's feet.
Column of light persists for as long as the button is pressed.

The spiral is a normalized Crucible current that, one day, will form a column that stretches to the gods.
神兽舞狮的愤怒风暴。\n能作为祷告执行。\n\n能大幅度旋转自己的身体，\n再唤:
The tempest of the Dancing Lion, wielded as an incantation.

A whirlwind-like twist of the body summons a storm, launching a tornado forward.
Charging enhances potency.

The majority of divine beasts were gored and hung upon Messmer's spears, then burned in his flame. Those who witnessed the deed likened it to a funeral pyre for the tower itself.
角战士的始祖──神鸟战士的招式。\n能作为祷告执行。\n\n能将双手如展翼般打开:
A technique of the divine bird warriors, the very first of all horned warriors, wielded as an incantation.

Spread the arms wide like wings to release a flurry of feathers. 
This incantation can be cast while in motion.
Hold to continue releasing feathers.

The divine bird warriors, and indeed this technique, are said to bear resemblance to the golden Crucible.
直属“穿刺者”梅瑟莫的\n火焰骑士们的祷告。\n\n能释放形如蛇的蜿蜒火焰。\n:
Incantation of the Fire Knights under Messmer the Impaler's personal command.

Launches a flame with a serpentine coil.
Charging enhances potency.

When the flame they received from Messmer would not find purchase within them, the Fire Knights relied on fire incantations to honor their bond.
火焰骑士之中的贤者，萨赞的祷告。\n\n能召唤浮空的燃烧云朵，\n在目标头上降下:
Incantation of Salza, sage of the Fire Knights.

Summons a cloud of flame overhead that pelts foe with rain of fire from above. Charging increases potency.

Salza's disdain for barbarism never waned, even as he burned more villages and scorched more land than any other.
“穿刺者”梅瑟莫的祷告。\n\n在空中形成梅瑟莫之火聚集成的巨大火球，\n朝目标:
An incantation of Messmer the Impaler.

Summons Messmer's flame to form a giant floating orb. The orb soars toward a foe, crashes into the earth, and explodes after a brief delay.
Charging enhances potency.

Messmer despised his own fire. Time and time again he hoped to rid himself of it, but ever did it burn.
米凯拉舍弃的大卢恩。\n\n完全毁坏，无法让恩惠的力量回归，\n只剩下能抵抗魅惑:
A Great Rune relinquished by Miquella.

Broken and bereft of its bounty, it retains naught but the power to resist charms.

Miquella set off for the tower enshrouded by shadow, abandoning everything—his golden flesh, his blinding strength, even his fate.

All in an effort to bury the original sin. To embrace the whole of it, and be reborn as a new god.
蒙受毁坏的龙战士，埃贡的勾指。\n关节隆起，指头内侧硬化变色。\n\n对上“狂龙:
Furled finger of Igon, the broken drake warrior.
Gnarled and knotty, and deeply discolored on the inside.

When facing Bayle the Dread, this summons Drake Warrior Igon from his sign.

"My soul yet lies on the mountain."
受侵蚀的粗制钥匙。\n\n能打开“塔之镇”贝瑞特井底的铁栅栏。:
A crude, corroded key.

Opens the iron grating at the bottom of the well in Belurat, the tower settlement.
结冻的铁制钥匙。\n\n能打开喟叹监牢上层的铁栅栏。:
A frozen iron key.

Opens the iron grating on the upper level of the Lamenter's Gaol.
结冻的铁制钥匙。\n\n能打开喟叹监牢下层的铁栅栏。:
A frozen iron key.

Opens the iron grating on the lower level of the Lamenter's Gaol.
角人制作的简易地图。\n标示着黄金十字记号的所在地。\n\n十字记号是米凯拉留下:
A simple map drafted by a hornsent.

Marked with the locations of golden crosses.

These crosses indicate Miquella's footprints.
表面有数个孔洞，\n外型细长的淡蓝色石质项链。\n\n能够吹响位在神秘遗迹内的吊:
A pale-blue necklace made from a thin, elongated stone hollowed out from the inside.

Use at a hallowed ruin to sound a hanging bell.

It was a teaching of Count Ymir. The fate of the one who sounds the hanging bell will be guided by the stars.
拥有两个心房的“狂龙”贝勒的心脏。\n表面布满数个如角一般的碎石，仍鲜红地鼓动。:
The biatrial heart of Bayle the Dread.
Dotted with horn-like gravel stones and glistening with deep-red liquor.

Gorge upon this at the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion to absorb Bayle's power.

The purest form of Communion, in the words of its priestess.
角人制作的简易地图，其中的更新版本。\n标示着新找到的黄金十字记号的所在地。\n:
A simple map drafted by a hornsent.
Recently revised.

Reveals the locations of newly-discovered golden crosses.

The crosses are akin to Miquella's footprints.
Or gravestones, which mark what he has left behind.
缀以螺旋图案雕刻的钥匙。\n\n能打开在“塔之镇”贝瑞特，\n位于二楼的仓库的门:
A key with a spiral engraving.

Opens the door to the storeroom on the second floor of Belurat, the tower settlement.
白色树皮制成的卷轴。\n\n据说在受幽影藏匿的塔中，有一道神之门──\n内容记载:
A scroll made of white tree bark.

Few can decipher the scroll, which describes the secret rite of the divine gateway said to be found at the tower enshrouded by shadow.

"A lord will usher in a god's return,
and the lord's soul will require a vessel."
老兵安帕赫写给“红狮子”弗蕾亚的信。\n\n里头似乎写着答案，能解开她的问题。\:
A letter written by Sir Ansbach to Freyja the Redmane.

Presumably written in answer to her query, but the page is neatly folded to keep prying eyes from reading it.
老旧的简易古地图。\n“大祭司”尤弥尔给予的物品。\n\n上头标示着神秘遗迹的所:
A simple old map, faded and dirty.
Acquired from Count Ymir, High Priest.

Indicates the location of a hallowed ruin.

"I only wish to be of service."
老旧的简易古地图。\n“大祭司”尤弥尔给予的物品。\n\n上头标示着不同于前一张:
A simple old map, faded and dirty.
Acquired from Count Ymir, High Priest.

Indicates another hallowed ruin, apart from the one shown on the first map.

"May the gleaming stars guide you evermore."
老旧的简易古地图。\n“大祭司”尤弥尔最后给予的物品。\n\n上头标示着不同于前:
A simple old map, faded and dirty.
Acquired from Count Ymir, High Priest.

Indicates a third and final hallowed ruin, distinct from those shown on the first two maps.

"May you join the glimmering stars above."
装在素烧陶壶内的黑色浓浆。\n\n受穆尔委托，希望交给休里耶的物品。\n\n不知:
An ebony-black syrup held in an unglazed jar.

Moore asked that this be delivered to Thiollier.

An unknown liquid apparently gathered and aged by the forager brood.
于“穿刺者”梅瑟莫体内燃烧的火种。\n模样黯然，受恶之蛇侵蚀。\n\n能燃烧位于:
The kindling that burned inside Messmer the Impaler.
A dark thing, eaten away at by a wicked serpent.

Burns the sealing tree said to be found at the old Rauh ruins.

Messmer, much like his younger sister, bore a vision of fire.
钥匙柄雕制徽章图案的铁制钥匙。\n\n能打开幽影城的西边城墙，\n大门旁的那道木:
Iron key with an engraved crest.

Opens the wooden door beside the great gate on the shadow keep's west wall.
燃炉工匠留下的笔记。\n内容写着操作时须注意的事项。\n\n 当魔像的燃炉有火的:
A note left presumably by a furnace keeper, containing admonitions regarding the furnace's proper use.

"Keep fire pots well clear when the golem's furnace is ablaze—and never let me catch you with pots that produce flaming whirlwinds, for goodness' sake."
“金针骑士”蕾妲留下的信。\n写给追寻米凯拉的同伴们。\n\n 米凯拉大人的目的:
Message left by Needle Knight Leda, addressed to kindred spirits who also pursue Miquella's trail.

"Kind Miquella seeks the tower sealed by shadow,
and the Gate of Divinity found there.

If we are to reach him,
we must burn the tree that seals the path.

And for that we require a flame."
“落叶”丹恩留下的信。\n写给追寻米凯拉的同伴们。\n\n 找到封印之树了，就在:
Message left by Dryleaf Dane, addressed to kindred spirits who also pursue Miquella's trail.

"We've found the sealing tree just ahead.

But if we are to burn it, we need the proper kindling. That of Sir Messmer."
写着扼要的内容，\n并附有双手击拳修士插画的信。\n\n 如果你在寻找格斗的对手:
A letter bearing a terse message and an illustration of a monk, his hands held together.

"Seek me to the east if you wish to pursue the way of the warrior.

When you find me, you will challenge me to a bout.
There is no need for words."
老兵安帕赫留下的信。\n写给追寻米凯拉的同伴们。\n\n 能通往幽影树的教区，\:
Message left by Sir Ansbach, addressed to kindred spirits who also pursue Miquella's trail.

"It would seem that the people of the keep have flooded the holy quarter that leads onward to the Scadutree, barring access.

However, there is no route that leads there from this storehouse.

Perhaps there is another way to reach the holy quarter, from somewhere else in this keep..."
集物虫们捡到的文件。\n内容写着扼要的情报：\n\n 当你发现受封印的灵魂气流，:
Note found by the forager brood, imparting knowledge in brief.

"Should you chance upon a sealed spiritspring, look for stacked stones nearby. By toppling them, you may break the seal."
被撕下、丢弃的日记书页，\n上头有着颤抖的笔迹。\n\n 我有触碰到他，就一次。:
A discarded page ripped from a diary, bearing a passage written in a tremulous hand.

"I touched him, but only once.

When he thrust his staff in my face,
I brushed it aside.

It was then that I touched him.
The aging untouchable."
从灵墓生成，非常罕见的虚幻生命。\n介于生物与灵魂之间的物品。\n\n能用在“满:
An exceptionally rare creature that burgeons from spiritgraves and lives only a fleeting existence.
Neither flesh nor spirit, but something in between.

Material required by the amber egg cradled by Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon, to birth people anew.

Being born anew allows the reallocation of attributes boosted by leveling up.
“金针骑士”蕾妲留下的信。\n写给追寻米凯拉的同伴们。\n\n 丹恩要我转达：\:
Message left by Needle Knight Leda, addressed to kindred spirits who also pursue Miquella's trail.

"Dane passed on a message...
The sealing tree is in the ancient ruins of Rauh.

It lies beyond the high bridge leading from the first floor of the storehouse.

I will join you there,
once I have finished the task at hand."
钥匙柄雕制徽章图案的铁制钥匙。\n\n能打开幽影城教区内的教堂，\n其中祈祷厅的:
Iron key with an engraved crest.

Opens the door to the prayer room in the house of worship found in the church district of the shadow keep.
“金针骑士”蕾妲留下的信。\n写给追寻米凯拉的同伴们。\n\n 前面那座受幽影封:

"The Gate of Divinity lies in the tower sealed by shadow.

I will follow the crosses east."
集物虫们捡到的文件。\n内容写着关于受封印的灵魂气流的情报。\n\n购买之后，才:
A note found by the forager brood.
Contains information about sealed spiritsprings.

Further details are available only to paying customers.
流浪画家的其中一幅作品。\n以《侵略》为题的绘画记忆。\n\n据说该名画家会画下:
Work of a wandering artist.
Reminiscence of a painting titled "Incursion."

This painter is said to have captured the landscapes seen during the last moments of those welcomed into death's embrace. 

The soul of the painter, and vestiges of the dead's last moments can be discovered by visiting the location depicted even now.
流浪画家的其中一幅作品。\n以《神之塔》为题的绘画记忆。\n\n据说该名画家会画:

墓地平原的地图碎片。\n\n灵墓散布，气氛抑郁的平原。\n角人的螺旋塔矗立于西北:
Map of the Gravesite Plain.

A somber plain covered in spiritgraves. The spiral tower of the hornsent lies to the northwest, and the entire expanse is marred by the harrowing ravages of war.
幽影亚坛的地图碎片。\n\n位于东北方，仰望幽影树的高地。\n梅瑟莫军以幽影城为:
Map of Scadu Altus.

The plateau occupied by Messmer's army that peers towards the Scadutree to the northeast, named after its counterpart in the realm of the Erdtree. At its center lies the shadow keep.
位于墓地平原以南，海岸的地图碎片。\n\n散发蓝色微光的花朵，满地盛开的梦幻海岸:
Map of the southern shore of the Gravesite Plain.

A captivating vista of brilliant blue flowers, intermingled with colossal stone coffins of unknown origin that seemingly drifted to this place. To the east, the jagged peak thrusts upward into the clouds.
劳弗古遗迹的地图碎片。\n\n受清水与绿意入侵的巨大古遗迹。\n由于地面崩裂，将:
Map of the ancient Rauh Ruins.

These giant ruins are flooded, overgrown, and split into two by a chasm. To the southwest is the Church of the Bud, overlooking the tower of shadow.
位于墓地平原以东，谷底的地图碎片。\n\n在阳光无法穿透的溪谷底层，有一座茂密的:
Map of the abyss at the east of the Gravesite Plain.

A thick forest sprawls at the depths of the ravine that is untouched even by sunlight. Known as the sanctum of Sage Midra, and is a region forbidden by the hornsent.
残留在穆尔尸体上的铃珠。\n\n献给圆桌厅堂的孪生老妪，\n能够增加交易项目。:

Offer to the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold to gain access to new items.

Material used for crafting items.

Grown by bloodfiends in pools of blood.

Perhaps even the fiends admire blood's beauty.
结冻之后，依然蠕动的蛆虫。\n用于制作道具的其中一项材料。\n\n主要能在监牢取:
Frozen maggots that somehow continue to wriggle.
Material used for crafting items.

Mainly found in gaols.

The maggots develop in great-jar innards, and are an invaluable source of sustenance to the prisoners.
姿态曼妙，即将枯萎的深紫色睡莲。\n用于制作道具的其中一项材料。\n\n会生长在:
A deep-purple water lily that is on the verge of wilting.
Material used for crafting items.

Grows in the blue flower field at the coast.

Like a syrupy poison, its nectar lulls the imbiber into sweet, velvety sleep.
盈满暗紫蜜血的嫩芽。\n用于制作道具的其中一项材料。\n\n非常罕见的物品。\n:
A young shoot, heavy with velvety purple nectar.
Material used for crafting items.

Exceedingly rare to find.

Said to burgeon forth where the nectar-like blood of abandoned Trina pooled.
抓着癫火葡萄的有翅虫。\n用于制作道具的其中一项材料。\n\n会在谷底森林里缓慢:
Winged insect carrying a dangling frenzied flame grape.
Material used for crafting items.

Flies lazily around the abyssal forest.

Said to be heralds of the aging untouchable. On seeing these, the wise know to stay well clear of that place.
由内膨胀变大的癫火眼球。\n用于制作道具的其中一项材料。\n\n非常罕见的物品。:
An eyeball of the frenzied flame that has swollen from within.
Material used for crafting items.

Exceedingly rare to find.

Marked with fingerprint burns, proof of having being touched directly by the Three Fingers' embrace.
古老守墓者的头盖骨。\n用于制作道具的其中一项材料。\n\n主要能在卡罗隐藏墓地:
Skull bone of an old grave keeper.
Material used for crafting items.

Mainly found in hidden grave of Charo.

The old grave keepers are boatsmen, and continue to summon the dead even after withering away.
大型肉食野兽的排泄物，和着硬角残骸的粪便。\n用于制作道具的其中一项材料。\n\:
Excrement of a large carnivorous beast containing fragments of horns.
Material used for crafting items.

Found underfoot in places like forests where beasts dwell.

It is said that the deadliest of the horned predators enjoy the sport of hunting and devouring other horned creatures.
含有高温气体的方形石。\n用于制作道具的其中一项材料。\n\n能在锻造遗迹取得。:
Block of stone infused with hot gas.
Material used for crafting items.

Found in the ruined forges.

Perhaps these were once used as fuel for the smithing process.
生长在墓地的灵火花。\n用于制作道具的其中一项材料。\n\n会生长在卡罗隐藏墓地:
Ghostflame flower that grows in gravesites.
Material used for crafting items.

Blossoms in the hidden grave of Charo.

Of a pair with another gravesite flower, the grave violet.
All but incorporeal, it burns without so much as a sound.
有着细微鸣叫声的铃虫。\n用于制作道具的其中一项材料。\n\n主要会在石棺附近发:
Cricket that produces a raspy cry.
Material used for crafting items.

Mainly found near stone coffins.

The sound of these crickets are often taken to be the rustling of the restless dead, or sometimes the sound of their calling voices.
流着烫热血液的异形花。\n用于制作道具的其中一项材料。\n\n非常罕见的物品。\:
Flower with an uncanny shape, coursing with hot blood.
Material used for crafting items.

Exceedingly rare to find.

A single flower is said to blossom—only once—from the hearts of dead warriors who oft partook of the Dragon Communion.
形似老者指头的淡粉色蘑菇。\n用于制作道具的其中一项材料。\n\n非常罕见的物品:
Light-pink mushroom resembling a wizened finger.
Material used for crafting items.

Exceedingly rare to find.

Used to by those who wish to become fingers to induce hallucinations. They call these mushrooms the stillborn of the Two Fingers.
盈满神人血液的嫩芽。\n用于制作道具的其中一项材料。\n\n非常罕见的物品。\n:
A young shoot, heavy with Empyrean blood.
Material used for crafting items.

Exceedingly rare to find.

Said to burgeon forth from where the golden blood of Miquella, the wounded Empyrean, pooled.
从石棺渗漏而出的蓝黑色融泥，\n其中浓稠凝固的物品。\n用于制作道具的其中一项材:
Bruise-colored putrescence that oozes from stone coffins, congealed into a large viscous lump.
Material used for crafting items.

Found underground in the land to where stone coffins drift.

The putrescence is what remains of the impure lives kept within the stone coffins.
透过水流磨成圆形的岩石。\n用于制作道具的其中一项材料，\n也能直接丢出。\n\:
Round piece of rock shaped by the water's current.
Can be used for crafting, or simply for throwing at enemies.

Found on the ground at places like river banks.

It breaks easily, owing to extensive cracking.
即将化为灵魂的墓碑碎片。\n用于制作道具的其中一项材料。\n\n主要能在墓地平原:
A piece of a gravestone that has started to turn into a spirit.
Material used for crafting items.

Mainly found on the Gravesite Plain.

In places to where the dead have been brought since antiquity, the oldest gravestones turn into spirits and then fade away.
缀以雕刻的椭圆形石头。\n用于制作道具的其中一项材料。\n\n在劳弗古遗迹发现的:
Oval-shaped stone bearing an engraving.
Material used for crafting items.

Relic found at the ancient ruins of Rauh.

In the center of the stone is a small nest-like hole. Once this is inhabited by a sprite, the stone can be used as a ritual implement.
形如蛇的绳状余火。\n用于制作道具的其中一项材料。\n\n主要能在幽影亚坛取得。:
Serpentine, cord-like ember.
Material used for crafting items.

Mainly found in Scadu Altus.

A remnant of Messmer's flame, the symbol of the crusade, it continues to smolder as if crawling across the ground.
闪耀着黄金光辉的遗骨碎片。\n用于制作道具的其中一项材料。\n\n非常罕见的物品:
Shard of bone with a golden shine.
Material used for crafting items.

Exceedingly rare to find.

A bone fragment touched by the gold of the Scadutree, broken from the remains of the warriors who perished in the realm of shadow. A blessing such as this is said to be the greatest honor that can be granted to the dead.
缠绕红色雷电的花朵。\n用于制作道具的其中一项材料。\n\n能在位于南方海岸的尖:
Flower that crackles with red lightning.
Material used for crafting items.

Found at the jagged peak on the south coast.

Said to bloom where the red lightning of the ancient dragons strikes the earth.
依稀带有指纹纹路的石质薄片。\n用于制作道具的其中一项材料。\n\n能在指头遗迹:
Flake-like stone shard with a faint fingerprint engraving.
Material used for crafting items.

Found at finger ruins.

A piece that came loose from the tip of one of the column-like stone fingers that grow at finger ruins.
特别尖锐的碎石。\n用于制作道具的其中一项材料。\n\n能在位于南方海岸的尖刺山:
A particularly sharp piece of gravel stone.
Material used for crafting items.

Found at the jagged peak on the south coast.

The scale of an ancient dragon that has supped on the blood of lesser dragons.
燃炉魔像脸部的缩小版本。\n用于制作道具的其中一项材料。\n\n非常罕见的物品。:
A smaller imitation of the furnace golem's visage.
Material used for crafting items.

Exceedingly rare to find.

A stone mask surrounded by curled horns, depicting the fell god of fire that haunts the sagas of the hornsent.
寄宿着灵魂的骨灰。\n能召唤咒剑士米拉的灵魂。\n在召唤后会立刻投入战斗。\n\:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.
Use to summon the spirit of Curseblade Meera. 
Attacks immediately after being summoned.

Curseblades appear to dance when they spin their shimmering circular blades. These ascetics, who failed to become tutelary deities, were a scourge for those who attempted to invade the hornsent homeland.

Long ago, before the land was overshadowed by invasion, this scourge was shunned, and the curseblades were imprisoned. It was during this confinement that Meera met Labirith, and upon her death, Labirith was plunged into a devastating darkness.
寄宿着灵魂的骨灰。\n能召唤血怪咒术师的灵魂。\n召唤时不消耗专注值，而是血量。:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.
Use to summon the spirit of a bloodfiend hexer.
Summoning consumes HP rather than FP.

This spirit conducts bloodboon rituals with a sacred spear, casts bloodflame hexes, and takes a singular pleasure in letting the blood of foes.

Long ago, a subjugated tribe discovered a twisted deity amongst the ravages of war, and they were transformed into bloodfiends. The mother of truth was their savior.
寄宿着灵魂的骨灰。\n能召唤守墓鸟的灵魂。\n\n灵墓守卫──古老魔像的灵魂。\:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.
Use to summon the spirit of a Gravebird.

The spirit of an old golem and spiritgrave keeper, who flies with stone wings and spouts ghostflame.

According to legend, the Gravebirds were crafted to be kindred to the Deathbirds.
寄宿着灵魂的骨灰。\n能召唤“火焰骑士”希德的灵魂。\n\n直属梅瑟莫的火焰骑士:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.
Use to summon the spirit of Fire Knight Hilde.

A spirit who belonged to the Fire Knights; an order which answers directly to Messmer.
Hilde swings a slender greatsword and casts fire incantations.

Hilde was a dear friend to Salza the sage, and joined those who urged that the specimens be preserved. Hilde's ashes were enshrined as a charm to protect the storehouse.
寄宿着灵魂的骨灰。\n能召唤蜘蛛蝎的灵魂。\n\n体型大于人身的蝎子灵魂。\n会:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.
Use to summon the spirit of a spider scorpion.

This scorpion is larger than a human, and attacks with pincers and a poisonous tail.
Appears some distance from the summoner.

This breed of scorpion was native to the realm of shadow, but was far smaller in size. Recent giant scorpions are said to trace back to the Church of the Bud.
寄宿着灵魂的骨灰。\n能召唤２名角人拷问官的灵魂。\n\n手持倒刺烛台的拷问老妪:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.
Use to summon the spirits of two hornsent inquisitors.

The inquisitor hags wield barbed candlesticks. One of the inquisitors casts a tower hex to heal HP, while the hex of the other boosts her own attack power.

Inquisitions often perplexed the minds of the uninitiated, and so seniority was viewed as an asset.
寄宿着灵魂的骨灰。\n能召唤“亚人剑士”约西的灵魂。\n\n翁吉为精通连星剑的剑:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.
Use to summon the spirit of Yosh, the demi-human swordsman.

Onze, a master swordsman who devoted himself to the Star-Lined Sword, realized that only ruin awaited at the end of the procession of stars, and imprisoned himself in order to forestall it.
However, Yosh, an apprentice who absorbed his technique, stubbornly refused to heed his master's words, and spent his entire life at his side, in defiance of his self-imposed seclusion.
寄宿着灵魂的骨灰。\n能召唤２名梅瑟莫士兵的灵魂。\n\n由持斧、持矛士兵搭配的:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.
Use to summon the spirits of two of Messmer's soldiers.

One soldier wields an axe, while the other wields a spear.
Both of them are adept at charge attacks.

These soldiers belonged to the ignoble penal battalion, and were buried hidden from the Scadutree's sight.
寄宿着灵魂的骨灰。\n能召唤“黑骑士团长”安卓斯的灵魂。\n\n黑骑士团为梅瑟莫:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.
Use to summon the spirit of Andreas, Knight-Commander of the Black Knights.

The Black Knights were the primary force of Messmer's army. Their first leader was Andreas, a man endowed with great strength and command over the powers of the Crucible, and whose spirit in these ashes dwells.
Though he remained a devout follower of Messmer after his flight from the Erdtree, he would rebel after learning of his liege's serpentine nature. His righteous stand was rewarded with imprisonment in an underground tomb.
寄宿着灵魂的骨灰。\n能召唤“黑骑士副团长”修的灵魂。\n\n黑骑士团为梅瑟莫军:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.
Use to summon the spirit of Huw, Knight-Captain of the Black Knights.

The Black Knights were the primary force of Messmer's army. Second to their first Knight-Commander was Huw, a man with agile command of both twinblade techniques and the powers of the Crucible, and whose spirit in these ashes dwells.
Though a champion of the divine beast hunt, he followed his father, Andreas, into rebellion against Messmer, and like his father, he too was imprisoned in an underground tomb.

Messmer mourned the loss of a brother-in-arms.
寄宿着灵魂的骨灰。\n能召唤大嘴小恶魔的灵魂。\n\n参考龙的模样制成的古老小恶:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.
Use to summon the spirit of a large-mouthed imp.

The spirit of this old imp, said to be fashioned after a dragon, has a big mouth that serves as a cannon and allows it to fire shells from the rear of the battlefield.
寄宿着灵魂的骨灰。\n能召唤３只人形苍蝇的灵魂。\n\n其中２只会一边飞行，一边:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.
Use to summon the spirits of three man-flies.

Two of the man-flies attack foes from the air, while the third spits poison from the rear.

Afflicted hornsent eventually metamorphosed into a fly-like form. It was believed that the moment the transformation took place, they were relieved from their suffering.
寄宿着灵魂的骨灰。\n能召唤“锻造魔像”泰乌尔的灵魂。\n\n稳如山的岩石魔像灵:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.
Use to summon the spirit of Taylew the golem smith.

The spirit of the stalwart stone golem who launches his own fists as projectiles.

Taylew was said to be the runt of the litter and the first to stop moving, but it was he who became the guardian deity of smithery.
寄宿着灵魂的骨灰。\n能召唤“神鸟战士”奥尼斯的灵魂。\n\n角战士的始祖──神:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.
Use to summon the spirit of Ornis the divine bird warrior.

Spirit of the divine bird warrior from whom the horned warriors claim descent. Clad in golden armor, and granted wings and feathers by divine invocation.

Ornis succeeded in taming the divine bird and made its wings his own as he soared through the sky. When he finally fell to earth, he lived on as the guardian deity of the temple quarter.
寄宿着灵魂的骨灰。\n能召唤角战士的灵魂。\n\n塔的守护者，重装战士的灵魂。\:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.
Use to summon the spirit of a horned warrior.

This heavily-armored guardian spirit of the tower attained inhuman strength through divine invocation, and wields a curved greatsword that brings horns to bear on its foes.

In the tower, these warriors and their weapons both are spiritual vessels.
寄宿着灵魂的骨灰。\n能召唤“古龙”芙柔桑克斯的灵魂。\n\n为了侍奉新王，自愿:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.
Use to summon the spirit of Ancient Dragon Florissax.

Florissax assumed this spirit form to offer her service to a new lord.
Uses her own dragonbolt to increase all damage negation (including physical) for herself and nearby allies. Strikes foes with the Flowerstone Gavel's dragonbolt to reduce enemy lightning damage negation.

Long ago, Florissax assumed human form to share Dragon Communion with the world. Now, she has acquired a human heart.
寄宿着灵魂的骨灰。\n能召唤指虫的灵魂。\n\n尚还年幼，体型娇小的指虫灵魂。\:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.
Use to summon the spirit of a Fingercreeper.

Devoted to its summoner, this young, diminutive Fingercreeper eagerly restores HP. They are ever so fond of their mothers at this tender age.
寄宿着灵魂的骨灰。\n能召唤“火焰骑士”昆兰的灵魂。\n在召唤后会立刻投入战斗。:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.
Use to summon the spirit of Fire Knight Queelign.
Attacks immediately after being summoned.

Spirit of a knight granted relief by the Iris of Grace.
Wields a spear-like greatsword that impales foes upon fire, keeping the taint of impurity away from fair mother Marika.

That grace was his salvation, though it was but a fleeting blessing. And having been saved, all that was left to him was to wage war.
寄宿着灵魂的骨灰。\n能召唤“黑夜剑士”约兰的灵魂。\n\n接受了赐福覆眼膜，得:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.
Use to summon the spirit of Swordhand of Night Jolán.

Spirit of a swordhand granted light by the Iris of Grace. Wields a sword of bottomless black that penetrates the enemy's guard.

Though it was not by the shining star that she had longed for, thus was her Night illuminated.

But this was an at times blinding light, and threatened to expunge the Night entirely.
寄宿着灵魂的骨灰。\n能召唤约兰与安娜的灵魂。\n\n在放入尤弥尔的傀儡，安娜之:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.
Use to summon the spirits of Jolán and Anna.

Spirits of two Swordhands of Night, one of them being possessed by Count Ymir's doll Anna. Together, Jolán's sword and Anna's claws are as bottomless black, and penetrate the enemy's guard.

Jolán and Anna were born in a cold, dark gaol, where they were raised, deprived of light, to be Swordhands of Night. Thus were they cultivated to become the most terrifying masters of their blades, though the burden of the deed left their hearts frail and pliant.

Usable on large and colossal swords.

Usable on hand-to-hand weapons.

Usable on throwing blades.

This Ash of War grants an armament the Keen affinity and the following skill:

"Scattershot Throw: Employ smithing arts to conjure multiple copies of the armament in both hands and throw them all at once. Follow up with an additional input to throw again."

Usable on throwing blades.

This Ash of War grants no affinity to an armament, but imparts the following skill:

"Wall of Sparks: Scatter perfumed powder in vicinity, producing intense sparks after a brief delay. Can be charged to increase power and range. The properties of the sparks are determined by the perfume bottle used."

Usable on perfume bottles.

This Ash of War grants no affinity to an armament, but imparts the following skill:

"Rolling Sparks: Scatter perfumed powder before you, triggering rolling explosions of deadly sparks. The properties of the sparks are determined by the perfume bottle used."

Usable on perfume bottles.

This Ash of War grants an armament the Keen affinity and the following skill:

"Raging Beast: Step with the swiftness of a beast, leap high, and slash foe from above. Initial step can be taken forward, backward, left, or right. Strong attack allows for a follow-up attack."

Usable on beast claws.
能赋予武器属性、战技的战灰。\n属性为“锋利”，战技如下：\n\n 战技：野兽爪:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Keen affinity and the following skill:

"Savage Claws: Pounce like a beast to viciously slash into foe with left and right claws."

Usable on beast claws.
能赋予武器属性、战技的战灰。\n属性为“锋利”，战技如下：\n\n 战技：死角一:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Keen affinity and the following skill:

"Blind Spot: Leap into close quarters to take advantage of the enemy's blind spot and gore them from the side. Inputs determine which side you strike from. This attack slips below the opponent's guard."

Usable on backhand blades.
能赋予武器属性、战技的战灰。\n属性为“锋利”，战技如下：\n\n 战技：迅斩\:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Keen affinity and the following skill:

"Swift Slash: A skill passed down amongst hornsent swordsmen. Take a swift forward step to slice through foes. This sharp strike also fires off a shearing vacuum. Can be charged to increase the skill's power and the distance of the forward step."

那优美的律法，那温柔的梦。: Beget Order most elegant, from my tender reverie.
请别忘记我的虚像。: Impress my vision upon thine heart.
希望在你那全新的世界里头，: In the new world of thy making,
……那失去的赐福又再一次，: And one other. Whom grace would again bless.
朝雾的彼端前进，抵达交界地，: Cross the fog, to the Lands Between.
觐见艾尔登法环──: To stand before the Elden Ring.
……死亡卢恩被释放了。: The Rune of Death is unbound.
黑色火焰燃烧了黄金树，: Black flames have devoured the Erdtree,
灰暗的死亡命运遍布交界地。: and the Lands Between are shrouded by Death's dark fate.
然而那火焰，同样也燃烧了拒绝的刺。: But the flames will also burn the impenetrable thorns.
……你真的是烂好人啊。: Well, if you really are that gullible...
那我劝你最好别靠近火山官邸。: then stay away from the Volcano Manor!
宿主啊，我真的非常高兴。: Lord host, I could not be more content.
庆幸自己获得智慧，遇见的人是您……: I found knowledge, and then found someone. That someone was you.
庆幸能待在您的体内，完成这件事。: And now, inside you, here I am...
你真的是不要脸的小偷啊。: I should have known, you scheming little thief.
多谢啊，你不打开我还伤脑筋咧。: My sincerest gratitude. I thought I'd never wrench that thing open.
你真的是大贵客耶。: You're the finest customer a man ever had!
下贱的褪色者，你去死吧。: This is how you die, you disgusting Tarnished.
我会让你的牺牲发挥最大的价值。: Don't worry, I've got big plans for you. After you snuff it...
所有的一切！蒙受诅咒的赐福吧！: Unleash it upon them! A cursed blessing to all!
……你知道指头女巫吗？: Have you heard of the Finger Maidens?
她们是侍奉双指，帮助、引导褪色者的人……: They serve the Two Fingers, offering guidance, and aid, to the Tarnished.
但现在的你，没有女巫在身边。: But you, I am afraid, are maidenless.
……我可以代替她们的职务。: I can play the role of maiden.
只要你渴求艾尔登法环，\n这件事肯定对你有帮助。: To aid you in your search for the Elden Ring.
……所以，希望你能帮忙──: You need only take me with you.
带我到黄金树的树脚。: To the foot of the Erdtree.
想让卢恩化为自己的力量时，\n请在赐福所在处呼唤我。: Summon me by grace to turn runes into strength.
这枚戒指交给你。: I bequeath to you this ring.
需要长距离移动时，就使用那枚戒指吧。: Use it to traverse great distances.
那能够呼唤名为托雷特的骏马灵魂。: It will summon a spectral steed named Torrent.
……我明白了。心有疑念，我也不勉强。: I understand. I'm asking you to put faith in but a stranger.
但你一定会需要这个条件。: Yet I'm certain that we can reach an understanding.
届时，希望你到赐福所在处呼唤我。: Summon me by grace if you should reconsider.
……想把卢恩化为自己的力量吗？: Shall I turn your runes to strength?
一下子就好，让我碰触你……: Let my hand rest upon you, for but a moment.
……这簇小巧的金光，是黄金树的赐福。: This tiny golden aura is the grace of the Erdtree.
据说在过去，这金光从你们褪色者的眼眸散失，: This light once shone in the eyes of your Tarnished brethren.
而如今，又转而出现、引导你们。: But now it is all that guides you. Or so I hear.
你应该看得见吧？: You can see them, can't you?
赐福的指引──引导使命所在的光芒。: The rays of grace, that guide you through your burden.
过去母亲在黄金树赐予我的那个使命，: For my purpose, given to me by my mother inside the Erdtree, long ago.
还有即使肉身烧毁，变成灵魂形貌的身体，\n我还能继续活命的理由。: For the reason that I yet live, burned and bodiless.
……其实我也想向你道歉，: There is something for which I must apologise.
我曾说要代替指头女巫的职务，\n但我没有办法引导你。: I've acted the Finger Maiden, yet can offer no guidance.
因为我不是女巫，而且……\n也失去了既有的使命。: I am no maiden. My purpose…was long ago lost.
……断崖之城史东薇尔，那里有一位碎片君王。: Upon the cliff, in Castle Stormveil, is a shardbearer.
他是在艾尔登法环破碎之际，\n拥有那破碎一部分的其中一位半神。: A demigod who inherited a fragment of the shattered Elden Ring.
……如果赐福的光芒指引你前往那里，: If the rays of grace signal the castle,
那么，你就是真的受到艾尔登法环引导。: then the Elden Ring beckons you.
……我希望你能受艾尔登法环引导，\n进而勇于挑战各种难关。: To face the challenge presented by the Ring.
是很久以前就销声匿迹的玛莉卡女王，\n她所留下的箴言。: Words of Queen Marika, who vanished long ago.
……你想听的话，我可以转达。: If you wish, I will share them with you.
……我知道了。\n我直接复诵玛莉卡的箴言：: Very well. In Marika's own words.
“吾王啊，王的众战士啊，我将夺去你们的赐福。”: My Lord, and thy warriors. I divest each of thee of thy grace.
“当你们的双眸黯淡褪色，\n我将放逐你们于交界地之外──”: With thine eyes dimmed, ye will be driven from the Lands Between.
“于交界地之外征战，生存，死亡吧。”: Ye will wage war in a land afar, where ye will live, and die.
……怎么样？希望多少能代替女巫的引导。: Well? Perhaps that might serve you in lieu of a maiden's guidance.
……我知道了，这不必勉强自己听。: Of course. Perhaps there is no need.
改变心意了再和我说。: Tell me if you should change your mind.
……这个地方也有玛莉卡女王的箴言。: Spoken echoes of Queen Marika linger here, as well.
你还想听的话，我可以转达。: Shall I share them with you?
“在你们面临死亡之后，那被夺去的会再归还──”: Then, after thy death, I will give back what I once claimed.
“返回交界地，投身交战，\n随心所欲地展现艾尔登法环。”: Return to the Lands Between, wage war, and brandish the Elden Ring.
“与死亡比邻，成为强者吧──\n王的众战士啊，吾王葛孚雷啊。”: Grow strong in the face of death. Warriors of my lord. Lord Godfrey.
“黄金树是掌管一切的存在。做出抉择吧──”: The Erdtree governs all. The choice is thine.
“要融入律法？还是脱离律法……”: Become one with the Order. Or divest thyself of it.
“沦为无力的边境支流？”: To wallow at the fringes; a powerless upstart.
“半神啊，我可爱的孩子啊。”: Hear me, Demigods. My children beloved.
“你们能成为任何存在──\n能成为王者，也能当上神祇。”: Make of thyselves that which ye desire. Be it a Lord. Be it a God.
“但是当你们没有成为任一存在，就会被抛弃……”: But should ye fail to become aught at all, ye will be forsaken.
“噢，拉达冈啊，黄金律法的忠犬啊。”: O Radagon, leal hound of the Golden Order.
“你还不是我，还不是神祇。”: Thou'rt yet to become me. Thou'rt yet to become a god.
“我的半身啊！击碎彼此吧！”: Let us be shattered, both. Mine other self.
“我在此宣告，去探索黄金律法──”: I declare mine intent, to search the depths of the Golden Order.
“明了何谓正当性之际，\n我们的信仰与赐福也会获得加强。”: Through understanding of the proper way, our faith, our grace, is increased.
“那些幸福的幼年时光，盲从时代已经走向终结。”: Those blissful early days of blind belief are long past.
“我的同志啊，毋须再犹豫不决！”: My comrades; why must ye falter?
“王的众战士啊，吾王葛孚雷啊。”: Hark, brave warriors. Hark, my lord Godfrey. We commend your deeds.
“遵循引导战斗至此，着实难能可贵。”: Guidance hath delivered ye through each ordeal, to the place ye stand.
“歼灭那山顶上的巨人们，封印火焰吧。”: Put the Giants to the sword, and confine the flame atop the mount.
“如此一来，那光耀的生命时代，\n就能拉开序幕──”: Let a new epoch begin. An epoch glistening with life.
“展现艾尔登法环，迎接黄金树时代之始！”: Brandish the Elden Ring, for the Age of the Erdtree!
怀疑你是不是真的受赐福指引……: To see whether or not grace truly does guide you.
还有，会不会挺身挑战难关。: And...whether you are fit to face the challenge that entails.
结果是我杞人忧天。: It seems my worries were unfounded.
从一开始，托雷特就相信你了……: Torrent had your measure from the very start.
有一件事情，是我能引导你的──: There is but one other thing I can do to offer you guidance.
圆桌厅堂。那是受到指引的褪色者，: I can take you to the Roundtable Hold...
也就是英雄们聚集的地方，我能够带你前往。: Gathering place of Tarnished champions, guided by Grace...
怀疑你是不是真的想觐见艾尔登法环，: To determine if the Elden Ring would truly have you.
还有，会不会为此投身无数战斗，向前迈进。: If you had the mettle to endure this long and arduous path.
他一直在等你。: He is always eager to see your return.
……可以的话，希望你去见他。: Please, will you talk to him, when you can?
他一定会很高兴。: I'm sure he would be much contented.
他有时候会哭泣。: I see him crying, from time to time.
好像是因为想念母亲，: I think he misses his mother.
也希望有人能称赞他好看。: He wants someone to tell him he's beautiful.
……身为母亲，还有母亲生下的人，: Does being born of a mother...
所有人都会像他们那样吗……？: Mean one behaves in such a manner?
……你的身体里，还住着另外一个人吗？: Is there...another person inside of you?
……我没有从中感受到恶念，就交由你判断了。: I sense no malice. Do as you think best.
我的名字是梅琳娜，和这个人有着约定。: I am Melina, and I have an accord with this person.
说不定我们会相处一阵子……: We might be together for some time.
我的名字是梅琳娜，和这个人一起旅行。: I am Melina, and I am travelling with this person.
交换条件中提到的树脚，就快到了。: Only a little further till the foot of the Erdtree, and the accord is fulfilled.
我是在黄金树的树脚诞生的，: I was born at the foot of the Erdtree.
也是在那里接受了母亲赐予我的使命……: Where mother gave me my purpose.
但现在，我失去了一切。: Though now, everything is lost to me.
即使肉身烧毁，变成灵魂形貌的身体，\n我还能继续活命的理由。: The reason for which I live, burned and bodiless.
谢谢你带我来到黄金树的树脚。: For bringing me to the base of the Erdtree.
在这里，我就可以自由行动。: Here, I can govern my own movement.
……那么，我们的约定完成了。: And thus, the accord is fulfilled.
我要去确认自己的使命。: I shall depart to ascertain the purpose I was given.
将卢恩化为力量的方法，还有托雷特，\n我都留在这里。: I shall leave Torrent, and the power to turn runes into strength, here with you.
希望你能达成自己的使命。: I wish you luck, in realising your ambition.
……你都一路征战过来了，: You have fought long and hard.
肯定有办法当上王──当上艾尔登之王。: I have no doubt you will become Elden Lord. May you take the throne.
你还记得我吗？我是梅琳娜。: It's me, Melina. Your travelling companion.
我想和你聊一聊。: Allow me a moment to converse with you.
……你没办法进入黄金树吧？: You were unable to enter the Erdtree, no?
它的表面布满荆棘，拒绝让你进入。: Prevented by the mantle of barbs.
是黄金树拒绝外界一切，由自我形成的硬壳。: A husk of the Erdtree's being; that spurns all that exists without.
想要觐见艾尔登法环，当上艾尔登之王，: The only way to stand before the Elden Ring...
就必须克服那些刺。: and become the Elden Lord...is to pass the thorns.
……我的使命与此相关。: My purpose serves to aid in that very act.
所以，我希望再和你一起旅行，: So I'd like you to undertake a new journey, with me.
走到云海之上，积着厚雪的巨人山顶──\n那有着灰灭火焰的山顶。: To the flame of ruin, far above the clouds, upon the snowy mountaintops of the giants.
这么一来，我就能燃烧黄金树……: Then I can set the Erdtree aflame.
也能引导你走上成为艾尔登之王的路。: And guide you. Down the path to becoming Elden Lord.
……我希望再和你一起旅行，: I wish to journey with you once more.
你只要想办法前往，: All I ask of you is to make the journey.
到那云海之上，积着厚雪的巨人山顶。: To the snowy mountaintops of the giants, far above the clouds.
自己是在要求你犯下重罪。: I'm asking you to commit a cardinal sin.
但如果，那条路会通往我希望的结果，: But it must be done to reach the path beyond.
我想要往下走。: And that is the path I wish to travel.
……我想告诉你一件事。: There is something I'd like to say.
我的使命虽然是母亲赐予的，: My purpose was given to me by my mother.
但现在，达成使命是出自我的意愿，: But now, I act of my own volition.
已经和母亲的期望无关。\n我是为了让世界变成希望的模样而行动──: I have set my heart upon the world that I would have.
……我不允许任何人践踏这份心意。: I won't allow anyone to speak ill of that.
灰灭火焰就在前方。: The flame of ruin lies just ahead.
……我很庆幸是和你一起旅行。: I'm glad it was you I travelled with.
真的该谢谢托雷特。: I must tender my thanks to Torrent, too.
你要一直帮助这个人喔。: Please continue to lend your aid. Till the end.
……我一直注视着交界地。: I have long observed the Lands Between.
心想着，这个世界必须被修复……: This world is in dire need of repair...
等你准备好了，再和我说。: Tell me, when you are fully prepared.
你做好犯下重罪的心理准备了？: Are you ready to commit a cardinal sin?
……如果你的心向着癫火，: If you intend to claim the frenzied flame,
那是不能接触的事物，: It is not to be meddled with.
是会吞噬所有生命，所有意念的浑沌。: It is chaos, devouring life and thought unending.
即使这个世界陷入毁灭的境地，充满了痛苦与绝望，: However ruined this world has become, however mired in torment and despair...
一切还是美好。: There is beauty in that, is there not?
我希望你──想当上王的你，\n不要否定这件事情。: If you would become Lord, do not deny this notion.
……请不要让你的心，向着癫火。: Please, leave the frenzied flame alone.
……我会准备火种。: I shall see to the kindling.
这是我的使命，同时也是出自我的意愿。: It is a purpose which I choose to fulfil.
所以请不要让你的心，向着癫火。: So, please... Leave the frenzied flame alone.
……癫火是不能接触的事物。: The frenzied flame is not to be meddled with.
那是会吞噬所有生命、所有意念的浑沌。: It is chaos, devouring life and thought unending.
请不要让你的心，向着癫火。: So, please... Leave the frenzied flame alone.
……我再说一次──: I ask you, one more time.
请让你的心，远离癫火吧。: Please, seek not the frenzied flame.
我希望你──想当上王的你，: As one who strives to become a Lord,
不要否定生命存在，世间生生不息这些事。: deny not the lives, the new births of this world.
……否定这些了，那也算不上是王了。: Those who would are not fit to be called Lord.
没有生命的世界里，哪里会有王呢？: When the land they preside over is lifeless.
拜托你了，能不能悬崖勒马？: Please, put a stop to this madness.
癫火之王根本算不上是王──: The Lord of Frenzied Flame is no lord at all.
那么，你我已经不能共存。: A pity. You are no longer fit.
我会对你痛下杀手。: I will kill you, as sure as night follows day.
这是我的责任──\n因为我让你获得了卢恩的力量。: Such is my duty, for allowing you the strength of runes.
……你啊，过来吧，过来老太婆这吧……: You, please, I can read them.
……迷雾中有座深不见底的洞穴，\n迷雾彼端有血的诅咒。: Within the fog, a gaping hole. Beyond the fog, one cursed by blood.
……地底有着潜伏者的片鳞半爪。: Below the surface, traces of those who lurk in the shadows.
……想要一探究竟，朝东边，朝东边去！: In the east, the east. Should you desire…
穿过怒潮，会有疯狂，会有浑沌等着。: You will face wrath, then madness, and finally, chaos.
你不可以往这条路前进。: This is a path you must forsake.
南方有不祥之兆，不祥之兆啊！: Dread awaits you in the south. Blackest dread!
想到那座小岛的废弃教堂，: At an abandoned church on that wee isle.
把古老心脏吃下去吗？: You would devour the heart of an ancient?
……褪色者啊，往黄金树脚前进吧。: Head to the foundation of gold, Tarnished...
在大升降机重合半月吧。: …and reunite the half crescents, at the Grand Lift.
哦，是吶。这座桥坏了，过不得。: Oh, but the bridge is collapsed, and cannot be crossed.
屠杀、屠杀、再屠杀……\n但百耳小子却无法得逞。: Slaughter, slaughter, slaughter... The all-hearing slaughtered, but alas, it was for naught.
因为你会从大壶之中抢走那东西嘛。: But all you need do, is snatch it from the big pot.
……你喜欢祭典吗？还是喜欢花？: …Are you one for festivals? Or flowers?
南边有催动星辰的大祭典；: To the South, a grand festival to make the stars turn.
东边有含苞待放的花蕾吶。: To the East, the hardened bud of a flower to be.
投身进那片吓人的猩红腐败之中吶？: Into the heart of the scarlet rot?
……没有资格这档事，说来也真悲哀吶。: What a pity it is, to be without the right.
你也只能束手无策──: All you can do is stand, at a loss.
拿不到重合用的半月，: Without even the half crescents that wish to be whole.
呆站在这条路前方，那一动也不动的大升降机前头。: Before the unmoving, unfeeling Grand Lift ahead.
还是说，你要投身水中？: Or, are you planning to throw yourself to the waters?
走向那不光彩的路，潜入黑暗的地底？: To find the coward's passage, through the dim cavern?
……你身怀重合用的半月，: You. The one who holds both half crescents.
那去这条路前方的大升降机吧。: Take the path to the Grand Lift ahead.
……你会当上王。: For you...are the one who will be Lord.
所有人啊，看仔细了！回朝啦！: Bear witness, one and all! The Lord is returned!
艾尔登之王，回朝啦！: The Elden Lord is come again!
东边有崩毁的黄金，西边有亵渎的蛇。: To the east...ruins of gold. To the west...the serpent's sacrilege.
……要选哪一边去，都无妨吶。: Wherever the path leads, so shall you follow.
去哪一边，都半斤八两吶！: Wherever the path leads, only more sorrow.
这是诅咒啊──玛莉卡女王的诅咒！: Tis a curse! A curse! The curse of Queen Marika!
……指头大人以前说过：: The Fingers I served once prophesied...
褪色者终有一天会当上艾尔登之王，修复黄金律法。: A Tarnished would one day become Elden Lord and restore the Golden Order.
铺天盖地的黄金──那光柱源头的大树。: The gold that enshrouds the heavens. The great tree which begets the pillars of light.
褪色者啊，朝大树的树脚迈进吧。: O Tarnished, hasten to the foot of the tree.
指头大人肯定会引导你吶。: The Fingers will surely guide you...
往前走就是巨人火焰之地，: Ahead lies the Land of the Giants' Flame.
不准继续靠近。: And the way forth is forbidden.
燃烧黄金树是初始的重罪啊，你有听懂吗？: Hear me. The burning of the Erdtree is the first cardinal sin.
那会释放命定之死，最后会毁了世界。: Doing so will unbind Destined Death, and slay the world itself.
谁准你做这种事的吶！: Who would dare put you up to such a task?
少爷，您本该丧命的呀。: My poor, sweet lordling should have died a true death.
您应该是半神中的第一位死者，: As the first of the demigods to die.
因为命定之死而殒命。: As a martyr to Destined Death.
那为什么，您会化成这身丑陋的模样？: But why must it yet bring such disgrace?
黄金之子竟然变成死诞者，: A scion of the golden bough, sentenced to live in Death...
还有什么事，比这更不堪？: How could such a thing come to be...
少爷本该丧命的呀。: My poor, sweet lordling should have died a true death.
罪该万死的！你这罪该万死的东西！: A curse! A curse upon you!
最后等着你的，只有死亡吶！: Your path leads only to death!
要犯下滔天大罪，: You'll soil your hands soon enough.
一路辛苦了，我是“解指”恩雅。: You've done well. I am Enia, the Finger Reader.
指头大人是无上意志的使者，\n而我是传达大人所言的老太婆。: I interpret the words of the Fingers, envoys to the Greater Will.
仔细瞧，指头大人在颤动──\n这代表祂在欢迎你这大卢恩的持有者吶。: Look there. The Fingers tremble. To welcome you, shardbearer.
……来，听好指头大人的话：: Let their wisdom wash over you.
“伟大的艾尔登法环是黄金律法──”: "Great Elden Ring, root of the Golden Order."
“让世界规律不乱，让生命蒙受福祉与赐福。”: "Anchor of all lands, giver of grace, wellspring of all joy."
“破坏律法是滔天大罪，带来的恶果当然无可避免……”: "The tragic corruption of the Order has taken its toll."
“如今世界与生命毁坏得无以复加，”: "Across the realm, life lies in ruin. Fallen to pieces."
“即使如此，无上意志也不会弃世界、生命于不顾，”: "But the Greater Will has not abandoned the realm, nor the life that inhabits it."
“因此你们褪色者才会受到赐福指引，被赋予使命。”: "So it is that the Tarnished are guided by grace. Called to act."
“褪色者啊，你持有的大卢恩是艾尔登法环的大碎片，”: "Brave Tarnished, your Great Rune is a handsome shard of the Elden Ring."
“成为艾尔登之王，修复黄金律法吧。”: "To become Elden Lord, and restore the Golden Order."
……别忘了指头大人的话。: Let the words of the Fingers guide you.
……对了，大卢恩都是由半神持有。: Ahh, Great Runes are the stuff of demigods;
半神是指艾尔登法环的宿主──\n神祇女王玛莉卡，祂的孩子们。: the children of the goddess, Queen Marika. She who is vessel of the Elden Ring.
那群孩子都因为大卢恩的力量堕入歧途，彼此争斗……\n但是没有人能当上艾尔登之王。: Tainted by the strength of their runes, her children warred, but none could become Elden Lord.
所以你们褪色者才会受赐福指引吶。: And so grace was extended, to your kind, the Tarnished.
“在许久许久以前，无上意志早已舍弃那群半神。”: "The Greater Will has long renounced the demigods."
“褪色者啊，无须踌躇──尽情杀戮、掠夺他们吧。”: "Tarnished, show no mercy. Have their heads. Take all they have left."
半神全部都是玛莉卡女王的孩子，: The demigods are each and all the direct offspring of Queen Marika.
其中只有“接肢”葛瑞克是后代子孙……: Godrick the Grafted was but a distant relation...
所以继承到的神祇血统最为稀薄，力量也最为弱小。: The runt of the litter, his divine blood sorely diluted.
你身上好像有黄金追忆吶。: A remembrance of gold has found its way into your possession.
……半神还有伟大的诸位英雄，: Demigods, and even the greater of the champions,
身形消失之后，会受黄金树雕琢，成为追忆。: are hewn by the Erdtree upon their end, into remembrances.
黄金追忆会保存追忆之主的力量，: These remembrances yet house the power of their former masters.
如果你希望得到那力量，尽情施展……: And should you wish to wield that same power, well…
指头大人能助你一臂之力。: I will lend you the strength of the Fingers.
……有什么好犹豫的吶？: Heh… Do not recoil from my offer.
指头大人都出言引导了──要你们褪色者动手争夺。: The Fingers guide us all. And you Tarnished, you are here to take, are you not?
……啊，是你啊。有什么事吶？: Ah. You have returned. What is it?
别忘了指头大人的话。: Let the words of the Fingers guide you.
……哦，真不简单……: I had my doubts, but...my, look at you.
从以前到现在，这是我第二次同时看到两片大卢恩吶。: Only once before have I seen two Great Runes together.
瞧啊，指头大人也十分激动：: Look there. The Fingers shudder with exuberance.
“褪色者啊，做得很好。无上意志肯定会欢欣无比。”: "Fine work, brave Tarnished. The Greater Will is pleased."
“如此便证明，你拥有成为艾尔登之王的资质。”: "You have earned the right to become Elden Lord."
“褪色者啊，朝着黄金树前进，觐见玛莉卡女王吧。”: "Now, seek the Erdtree, and an audience with Queen Marika."
嗯，大概跟基甸小鬼头不相上下。: As much from you as they do young Gideon.
收下吧，这是老太婆的一点心意。: Take this. A token of farewell.
玛莉卡女王是艾尔登法环的宿主，能见到相关的虚像。: Queen Marika is the vessel of the Elden Ring, carrier of its vision.
然而祂在艾尔登法环破碎之后，被囚禁在黄金树之内──: But after the Elden Ring's shattering, she was imprisoned in the Erdtree.
作为神却让律法破碎，那是犯下大错的惩罚。: A grim punishment for shattering the Order, despite her godhood.
“但即使祂受到重罚，仍旧是神，也是虚像的容器。”: "But even in shackles, she remains a god, and the vision's vessel."
“只要向那容器献上大卢恩，\n你就会成为她的伴侣──成为艾尔登之王。”: "Confer Great Runes to become Elden Lord, and join Queen Marika as her consort."
我很清楚吶，黄金树拒绝你了。: You know what this means. The Erdtree has spurned you.
发生预料之外的事，感到困惑，正在与无上意志沟通。: Shaken by this turn of events, they are busy consulting the Greater Will.
等到沟通结束，指头大人会再出言引导你们。: When they are finished, the Fingers will again offer their guidance.
……只是这可能要等上数千、数万个日子吶。: But thousands, if not tens of thousands, of moons must first pass.
我是无妨，但你们等不得吧？: No matter for me. But you? How will you ever manage the wait...
……指头大人再出言引导，\n可能要等上数千、数万个日子吧。: It may be thousands upon thousands of moons before the fingers again offer their guidance.
那是身为人之子万万不得做出的事。: That is not the domain of mere men.
烧毁黄金树是最为原始的重罪，\n更别提追求死亡卢恩的力量……: The burning of the Erdtree is the first cardinal sin. And you say you seek the power of the Rune of Death, too?
死亡卢恩就是“命定之死”──: The Rune of Death goes by two names; the other is Destined Death.
是黄金律法诞生之初，首先去除、封印的黑暗影子。: The forbidden shadow, plucked from the Golden Order upon its creation…
你却打算释放它……: Unleashing the rune now would be unthinkable...
……这件事指头大人，不，无上意志绝对不会点头。: The Fingers would never permit it. Nor would the Greater Will.
……现在指头大人静止不动，\n我们也无从感知无上意志。: The Fingers, dormant, severing our link to the Greater Will.
世界与生命愈发崩坏，\n甚至发生指头大人也无从预知的事……: The realm, and all life, in ruins. Impossible events transpire, beyond the ken of the Fingers.
又怎能说，重罪如今仍是重罪？: Who is to say that the cardinal sin must be cardinal forever?
只要你认为自己的做法没错，就去做吧。: Take the course you deem most worthy.
在交界地最高的地方，那里有个冒出袅袅轻烟的巨人大锅──\n能烧毁黄金树的火就在锅: Only the smoldering flame in the Great Forge of the Giants, on the highest peak in the Lands Between, can burn the Erdtree.
然而想让锅里的火窜起，必须要有特殊的火种。: But special kindling is required to reignite the flame.
……要有能看见火焰虚像的人。\n唯有把那人当祭品，才能用大锅的火烧毁黄金树。: For the flame to burn the Erdtree, a sacrifice is needed. Of one who envisions the flame.
前往死亡卢恩的路，也会随之明朗。: And can lead you to the Rune of Death.
现在我们应该没有交集了？: What use do you have for me, now?
我是“解指”，正在等待沟通结束，指头大人的发声。: I am a Finger Reader. I will remain here, until their dialogue ends, and the Fingers speak again.
去贯彻你认为正确的事吧。: Do as you please. Take whatever course seems most worthy to you.
要我老太婆继续替你工作吗？: You'd force this tired old crone to work, even now?
你还真是不懂得顾忌吶。: A harder taskmaster have I never met.
只要你不嫌弃，\n我老太婆愿意陪你走到最后。: I'll see it to the end with you, if it please.
去做你认为正确的事吧。: Do what you believe is right.
……感谢你的好意。: Oh, such a fine gift, I will gladly accept.
我老太婆没有什么秘密。: I have no secrets for you to plunder.
……那早在很久以前，就忘得一乾二净了。: I lost my appetite for them a lifetime ago, or more.
……初次见面啊，褪色者。: A pleasure to meet thee, Tarnished.
听说有褪色者骑着灵马，: I'd heard tell of a Tarnished hurtling about atop a spectral steed.
让我花了点时间去找……: And upon looking into the matter,
看来就是你啊。: the talk, I surmise, is of thee.
那名为托雷特的灵马──: Thou'rt possessed of the power, no?
你能召唤它，没错吧？: To call forth the spectral steed named Torrent.
有物品要转交给你。: I was entrusted this, for thee.
那物品叫作召魂铃。: Tis a bell for calling forth spirits.
没有回归黄金树的骨灰，能从中召唤出灵魂。: Summon them with it, from ash unreturned to the Erdtree.
而那些灵魂会暂时认你为主人，\n重现生前战斗的模样。: The spirits will obey thine command but briefly, as they recall battles past.
……哎，照你的意思使用吧。: Now it is thine. To do with as thou wishest.
我想不会再见面了，\n仔细品尝交界地的滋味吧。: I doubt we shall again meet. But all the same, learn well the Lands Between.
……我很期待啊──: How long will it be, I wonder...
你们褪色者会服从双指到什么时候？: Before the Tarnished tire of obeisance to the Two Fingers?
忘了那匹灵马的名字。: The name of the spectral steed thou callest?
……倒有趣了，想否定到底吗？: Quite the stubborn one, aren't we?
哎，这也无妨。\n交界地本来就充斥着谎言。: Wise, in a way. The Lands Between are home to liars and cheats aplenty.
不信任他人，反而是有益无害啊。: Perhaps thine ample mistrust will be to thy benefit.
托雷特的前主人托付的物品，我放在这。: I shall leave this for thee, at the behest of Torrent's former master.
等你有兴趣了，再捡起来吧。: Take it, shouldst thou overcome thy suspicion.
……不分青红皂白吗？: No sense in arguing, I see.
托雷特怎会选了如此匹夫……: Torrent hath quite the ruffian chosen...
……稍微聊聊过去的事吧。: Let us speak of the past, a while.
半神之中只有我、米凯拉，还有玛莲妮亚是神人。: Of the demigods, only I, Miquella, and Malenia could claim that title.
……但是我拒绝了双指。: But I would not acquiesce to the Two Fingers.
我窃走死亡卢恩，杀害、抛弃自己身为神人的身体，: I stole the Rune of Death, slew mine own Empyrean flesh, casting it away.
因为我拒绝受那种存在操控。: I would not be controlled by that thing.
……从那之后，我和双指诅咒彼此，: The Two Fingers and I have been cursing each other ever since...
而灾厄影子就是祂送来的刺客。: And the Baleful Shadows...are their assassins.
记得当时我自称蕾娜。: I believe I said my name was Renna, when last we met.
很高兴看到托雷特过得不错。: It pleaseth me to see Torrent hale and hearty...
那么，褪色者啊。你是为了什么而来？: But Tarnished, what business hast thou here?
你是为了什么，来到这里？: Thou must have some business in mind, to come all this way.
……原来如此，调查得真仔细。: I see. Quite the sleuth, aren't we.
没错，我是魔女菈妮。: Indeed, I am the witch Ranni.
曾经窃走部分死亡卢恩，\n再经由仪式，化成弒神用的黑刀──: I stole a fragment of the Rune of Death, and used it to forge the godslaying black knives through fearsome rite.
……再来，你想找的咒痕，不在这里。: But sadly for thee, the cursemark thou seekest is not to be found here.
我杀害、抛弃与生俱来的身体──: I have slain the body I was born into, and cast it away.
而咒痕就刻在那身体上。: And it is upon that flesh the cursemark is carved.
……为什么非得告诉你？: And why should I reveal that to thee?
我不隐瞒过去，不为此感到后悔，: I performed the act not to bury the past, nor in shame of the deed,
但也不会有人乞讨就乐于施舍。: but all the same, thy begging compels me not a jot.
……你想找的咒痕不在这里，我言尽于此。: The cursemark thou seekest is not here. That is all I will say.
你的意思是，要替我做事？: Thou wouldst render me aid, is that thy proposal?
你认为这么做，就能找到咒痕的所在地？: Affording thyself opportunity to grope about for the cursemark's location, no doubt?
我不讨厌心怀鬼胎的人。: There's nothing wrong with a well-laid scheme.
况且，如果是以前的作为──\n那伤痕将你带来……: What's more, if my past and past wounds beckon to thee,
这命运也颇有意思。: I am curious enough to see what thy destiny portends...
我准许你替我做事。: I'll allow it. Enter my service.
没事吗？这样啊。: No reason in particular, thou claimest?
倒有趣了。那我们在此重逢，可说是命运从中牵线。: Intriguing. Then mayhaps fate hath steered thee to this reunion.
倒有趣了。那我们在此邂逅，可说是命运从中牵线。: Intriguing. Then mayhaps fate hath steered thee to this encounter.
你要替我做事吗？: Wilt thou enter into my service?
我是魔女菈妮。\n过去窃走死亡，如今找寻深入黑暗的路。: I am the witch Ranni. I stole Death long ago, and search now for the dark path.
总有一天，我会背叛一切，也会舍弃一切。: That I might one day upend the whole of it, and rid the world of all that came before.
……怎么样？听起来有趣吧？: Well? Has that roused thy interest?
……这样啊，那很好。: I see. A choice well made.
你真是奇人，那种邀请也肯答应。: Thou'rt a rare sort. Not many would have accepted the offer.
但我的门槛也不过如此。: But I require as much of those under my command.
期待你往后的表现。: I anticipate good work from thee.
等你改变心意了，再回头也不迟。: Come to me again, shouldst thou change thy heart.
顺着命运的牵动，替人偶魔女做事──: Surrendering thyself into the service of a doll-witch...
可能也是不错的安排啊。: Is not as frightful as thou fearest...
哦？改变心意了？: Ah, art thou persuaded to my cause?
那我再问一次。你要替我做事吗？: Then, again I shall ask, wilt thou enter into my service?
……那么，立刻有事派给你。: Good, then I ask we proceed with haste.
有一位名叫布莱泽的半狼战士，他也在替我做事。: There is, in my service, a half-wolven warrior by the name of Blaidd.
我要你和他联手，\n找出“永恒之城”诺克隆恩的秘密宝藏。: I would have thee join him in searching for the hidden treasure of Nokron, the Eternal City.
我已经召来布莱泽，他人在楼下。\n详情去问他吧。: I have called for Blaidd to greet thee below. Take from him the particulars.
对，还有，军师伊吉、魔法教授赛尔维斯应该也在。: Ah, and there wilt thou find Iji, my war counselor, and Seluvis, preceptor in the sorcerous arts, also.
他们颇为特立独行，有必要时善加利用吧。: Heed not their peculiarities; feel secure in gaining from them what advantage thou canst.
……各取所需，他们肯定也不会客气。: I am sure the others will be doing just the same.
……去和楼下的那三个人聊几句吧。: Speak with the three who await thee below.
不要求你融入，但你免不了受他们打量。: Thou needst not indulge them unduly, but they too wish to appraise thy worth.
……毕竟很久没有新人加入了。: It hath been a passing long time since a newcomer entered my service, after all.
宁姆格福地区有星星坠落，这事你知道了吧？: Art thou aware of the star that struck Limgrave?
星星打穿地面，形成大洞──\n“永恒之城”诺克隆恩就在大洞的前头。: It left a vast crater, and through it lieth the Eternal City of Nokron.
我要你从大洞下去，找出诺克隆恩的秘密宝藏。: Go there to find the city's hidden treasure.
对，还有，军师伊吉、魔法教授赛尔维斯\n应该都在楼下。: Ah, yes. Iji, my war counselor, and Seluvis, preceptor in the sorcerous arts, can be found below.
那两位也在替我做事。: Like thee, they are in my service.
……啊，还有一件事。: Ah, allow me to forewarn thee.
我就要进入深眠，: I shall soon enter my slumber.
短时间内不会醒来。: And it will be some time before I wake.
人偶的身体也不如想象中地自由。: This doll's body is not without its hindrances...
下一次睁眼的时候，能听见好消息。: I look forward to the good news when I arise.
我知道。即使在深眠之中，我还是感觉得到。: Even in my slumber, I sensed it.
你拿到诺克隆恩的秘密宝藏了，对吧？: It is in thy possession, is it not? The hidden treasure of Nokron?
谢谢。这么一来，所有条件都凑齐了。: My thanks. Finally, all the pieces are in place.
接着只需要我动身──\n踏上只有我能走的，深入黑暗的路。: Soon must I begin my journey. Upon the dark path only I may tread.
……在踏上旅途以前，有样物品必须交给你。: Ah, but before I leave, I must entrust thee with this.
用那物品解除封印之后，我抛弃的身体就在前头。: My discarded flesh lieth beyond the seal unlocked by it.
你想找的咒痕，刻在那身体上。: Upon which is carved the cursemark of thy desire.
……至于你想做什么，我大致料想得到。: I can fathom what thy purpose might be.
看来我们都无缘走在光明道路上。: Neither of us is welcomed by the brighter path, I see.
时间不长，但你表现得很好。: It was but brief, but thou gavest me fine service.
你是因为咒痕才接近我，对吧？: Thy purpose in approaching me was to obtain the cursemark, was it not?
我也要踏上旅途了──\n走上属于我的，深入黑暗的路。: I, too, am to depart on a journey. Upon the dark path only I may tread.
……在踏上旅途以前，这物品先交给你。: Ah, but before I leave, I shall entrust thee with this.
你带来了丰硕成果，这是谢礼。: My thanks, for thy sterling efforts.
……那物品颇为奇特，\n但送给你这奇人，肯定会爱不释手。: A strange gift, perhaps, but a rare sort such as thee would welcome it, I am sure.
话说回来，这次重逢真的是命运牵线。: I am certain now, fate steered us to our reunion.
话说回来，这次邂逅真的是命运牵线。: I am certain now, fate steered us to our first encounter.
我也该谢谢托雷特。: I must thank Torrent too, for his part.
……怎么了？你可以离开了。: What is it? You may go.
……唉，没想到你这么缠人。: Oh? A dogged fellow, aren't we?
还是说，你有和人偶说话的习惯？: Or is it merely thy habit, to talk to dolls?
原本不打算让这模样公诸于世……: I hadn't expected any soul to recognise me in this guise.
既然被发现了，你也别想全身而退。: But now the cat is out the bag, I cannot allow thee thy freedoms.
我要你助我一臂之力──: Perform for me a service, as recompense.
去寻找、消灭这块土地上的灾厄影子。: Eliminate the Baleful Shadows which prowl these lands.
……你让魔女菈妮蒙羞，: The name of Ranni the Witch is already sullied by thee.
我不允许你回绝。: I will not brook disobedience in this matter.
……我要你助我一臂之力，: Perform for me a service, as recompense.
我因此得到了布莱泽，他是神人的特殊随从。: Which is when I received Blaidd. In the form of a vassal tailored for an Empyrean.
……我拒绝了双指。\n从那之后，我和双指诅咒彼此。: I turned my back on the Two Fingers and we have each been cursing the other since.
……当我拒绝双指的那个时候，: Even when I turned my back upon the Two Fingers.
他明明是神人的特殊随从。: Though he was created a vassal for an Empyrean,
以双指的角度来看，这想必是非常严重的瑕疵。: He was a colossal failure, on the part of the Two Fingers.
……对布莱泽、伊吉，我真的无以回报。: Blaidd, and Iji both... Art willing to give too much to me.
他们明明知道，\n我要走上的黑暗道路，终点会有什么。: Yet they both understand. What lieth beyond the dark path...
也知道我总有一天会背叛一切、舍弃一切。: That I must betray everything, and rid the world of what came before.
……啊，也许我该把你算进去？: Ah, should I add thee to the list?
在滥好人这一点上，你们可说是不分轩轾。: Another one, kind of heart. As kind of heart as they.
……用这模样，心情就是会比较放松。: Ach, this form hath loosened my tongue.
魔女菈妮就要替你刻下伤痕──: That Ranni the Witch cometh, to rend thy flesh.
那永不愈合的命定伤痕。: With a fateful wound, ne'er to heal.
劳烦你了，谢谢。: My thanks. 'Twas more of a challenge than I envisioned.
如此一来，我总算能见到祂。: Now I can finally stand before them.
……你是我的王吗？: So, it was thee, who would become my Lord.
我送出警告，看来是徒劳。: Perhaps I needn't have warned thee.

吃了一记攻击就裂开，内容物也漏了很多……: One hit was all it took to crack me, and for my insides to come spilling out...
在那之后，也只能当个胆小鬼……: After that, I hid like a coward.
真的没脸见你。: And as such, I can hardly stand to face one such as you.
……不过，我还没有放弃。: ...But don't you think I've given up just yet.
幸运的是，这里有很多战士的尸体，: As luck would have it, there's a veritable mountain of warriors' bodies right here.
收集他们、放进体内之后，\n我又能变回战士壶。: If I can just squeeze this bunch down inside me, I'll be a mighty warrior again in no time.
……而且这附近的尸体，各个都非常出色，: And you know... The bodies found here are exceedingly fine.
不愧是曾经参与破碎战争的战士。: Who could expect any less from the very warriors who fought in the Shattering, the greatest of all wars!
我会变得更强，: Just you wait and see, friend. I'll grow even stronger!
敬请期待再会的那一刻吧。: Just you wait, when next we meet!
……战士啊，进到我的体内，: Alright lads, I'm going to take you on a little journey.
成为我的内容物吧。: You'll all be inside me, and be part of me.
我们一起携手实现吧──: From now on, we're all in it together.
那当上英雄的美梦。: So let's all of us dream big.
……这附近的尸体，各个都非常出色，: The bodies found here are exceedingly fine.
哦哦，是你，好久不见啦！来得正好！: Ahh, hello! How nice it is to see a friendly face!
如你所见，我又被卡住了。: As you can surmise, I've got myself stuck in another hole.
希望你能再帮我脱离困境。: Would you mind helping me out, again?
那你知道该怎么做吧？: You know what to do, hm?
用随便一个比较大的东西，打向我的底部吧。: Give me a good smack from behind with something nice and big.
哦，不用担心我在战斗祭典受到的伤，: Don't worry about my wound sustained at the festival.
伤口已经漂亮密合了。: I'm stuck back together good and proper!
等一下！我有不好的预感！: P-please! Wait. I have a terrible feeling about this!
拜托先停下来！: Would you stop hitting me for a minute!
……我的下半身好像被什么地方卡住了。: I can feel my lower half is stuck on something.
继续打下去，我也没办法脱身……: I don't think you can get me out just by hitting me, this time.
不知道……有没有让我滑出去的方法？: Let's think... Perhaps there's a way to slide me out a little more smoothly...
如你所见，我被卡住了。: As you can surmise, I've got myself stuck in a hole.
希望你能帮我脱离困境。: Would you mind helping me out?
啊，谢谢你，多亏有你脑筋动得快。: My thanks! To you and your razor-sharp wits.
想用这东西表达我的谢意，再请笑纳。: As a token of my thanks, I'd like you to have this.
哎呀，这下变得全身滑不溜丢了。: Deary me, I'm oilier than a toad!
在我的故乡有好几个壶是油壶……: There were countless oil jars back where I'm from, actually.
现在总算能感同身受了。: And now I know what it's like to be one of them!
……对啊，我也有故乡。: Yes, indeed, I too have a home.
只是下定决心，不再回去了。: Though it is one to which I have vowed not to return.
哎呀，我想说从悬崖上眺望一下还行，\n漫不经心一靠近。: So, I thought I might look out from atop the cliff, but as I drew closer and closer...
结果直接被洞卡得正着。: Pow! Wouldn't you know it, I was perfectly stuck in that blasted hole.
……我在想，体内的这些战士，\n也许会斥责我这种软弱心态。: I can feel the warriors inside admonishing me for my mawkishness.
“想当上英雄，就要割舍想家的念头”之类的。: To walk the path of champions, one cannot cleave to the past!
……我打算朝北边的火山前进。: I'm headed to the fiery mount in the north.
从那之后我想了好久──\n壶如果要变强，强到不会裂开的话，: I can strengthen myself there, without fear of cracking this vessel.
那就必须焚烧这副身体。: I will forge myself anew in its flames!
火山啊！焚烧我亚历山大吧！: O mountain of fire! Bake me in your flames!
焚烧肉身也不会变强啊？: I hardly think you're here to temper yourself with flame, considering that fleshly form of yours.
啊，不过，来得正好。: Your timing though, is impeccable as ever!
这个是我一边旅行的时候，一边做的。: I've been making just the thing for you on my journey here.
请笑纳，我觉得一定很适合你。: Take it, I'm sure it'll suit you to a tee.
话说回来，这温度比我想得还要低呢。: But oh, it's hardly more than lukewarm here.
看来光靠这里，\n不可能让我的身体练成绝不破裂。: I won't be able to temper my body such that it'll never crack again.
就是那个，传承下来的故事有提过啊，: There's an old saying I've caught wind of.
在云海之上，积着厚雪的巨人山顶，\n有道灰灭火焰永不熄灭……: "Above the lofty clouds, the icy giant's peak doth soar, here lieth the flame of ruin, which ever burning roars."
……哦，你也抵达这里啦。: Ah, I see you've finally made it here yourself.
漂在空中的城市渐渐崩落……\n这个地方真的很神秘。: The city hanging in the air is slowly crumbling. What an incredible place we find ourselves.
……话说回来，你刚才的战斗，打得真是精彩。: But that aside, you're certainly a force to be reckoned with, eh.
那个跟神祇一样威严的巨人，\n想必除了你以外，没有人能打倒。: I doubt there's a single soul who could've handled that giant, other than you. It was practically a god...
……当然，我亚历山大也没办法。: Of course I count myself, the great Alexander, among the many.
……所以啊，有一件事情想要拜托你。: Which means, I've but one thing to ask of you.
你能不能成为磨练我的试炼？: Would you kindly undertake my ordeal?
……等你准备好了，再告诉我吧。: Come and tell me when you're ready.
我想要和做好万全准备的你战斗。: I've been longing to fight a warrior as accomplished as you.
准备好了吧？: You are ready then, I take it?
我正是壶中战士，“铁拳”亚历山大！: I am the great jar warrior, Iron Fist Alexander!
在我体内的诸位战士啊，把力量借给我吧！: Lend me strength, O warriors within!
一起成为英雄吧！: Let us become one champion, together!
……话说回来，那个跟神祇一样威严的巨人，: But that aside, I can't believe you felled that giant. It was practically a god...
想必除了你以外，没有人能打倒。: I doubt there's another soul out there who could've done the same.
谢谢，你真的是我认定的英雄。: My thanks. I knew you were the stuff of champions.
请务必收下我体内的内容物。: I implore you, take what I bequeath...from inside me...
壶逃不过毁坏的命运，: All vessels are destined to one day break.
而我亚历山大直到最后一刻，都是战士壶！: But the great Alexander lived as a warrior to his last!
这下子真的滑不溜丢了。: This will have me as slippery as a toad.
感觉应该有办法脱困。: I have a good feeling about this, my friend.
好，快拿够大的东西打我的底部吧！: Right! Give me a good smack from behind with something nice and big!
等等！快住手！: Just stop a moment, I beg!
下半身好像被什么地方卡住了！: My lower half is stuck on something down there!
继续打也脱不了身！会裂开！: I'll break! I'll break before I'm out!
我求你了！: I beg! I beg of you!
我还以为会裂成两半……: I thought I was apt to split in half...
只是说，还真伤脑筋。\n下半身好像被什么地方卡住了。: Mm, I can feel my lower half is stuck on something.
继续打下去也没办法脱身……: I don't think you can get me out just by hitting me, this time.
快点住手！: This is no time for games!
原来是这么一回事──: Wait, I see. I see it now.
人逃不过发疯的命运。: Humans all lose their wits, eventually.
既然如此，不必多说。: Then there's nothing left to say, except...
……这是一场精彩的战斗，: A finer battle was never witnessed.
你愿意成为我的内容物吗？: How do you fancy joining the lads inside, eh?
我是没用的壶吗……？: Was my whole existence... just a crock?
帮帮我吧。: Could you help us out, cully?
为什么要装作没看见？: Stop pretending you can't see me!
……为什么所有人都这样？: Why won't anyone look me in the eye?
难道我就真的那么丑陋？: I-I'm not that ugly, am I?
你怎么突然打人啊，很过分耶！: What'd you go and do that for!
因为我被施魔法，变成树了。: Some clod turned me into a tree.
你是为了帮我破除魔法啊。: You were just breaking the spell, weren't you.
不受洞窟的其他人欢迎，被赶了出来……: I was pushed out of the cave. Told not to come back, not ever.
然后还被变成了树。: Then I ended up as a tree.
在被赶出洞窟的时候，\n身上重要的东西都被拿走了，: When they threw me out of the cave, they took everything I owned,
所以只能拿这种东西答谢你。: and so this is all I have to express my thanks.
真的很对不起。: I hope you can forgive me.
……再等我一下下，: Or, if you can afford to wait for a while,
我想偷偷回洞窟，拿回重要的东西。: I could sneak back into the cave, and bring back something of actual value.
这样我就一定能帮到你的忙。: Then I'd be of some real use to you, I reckon.
……嗯，但是要再等一下。: Right, but I'll need a moment.
我还是……很怕他们……\n需要一点时间做心理准备。: I-I'm frightened of them... So I have to gather myself.
……一想到他们，还有那座海岸的洞窟，\n我就怕得脚都动不了……: My knees start knockin'...just thinking about that god-awful cave on the shore...
……你怎么会来这里？: Oh, what are you doing here?
这里很危险，快点逃吧。\n他们肯定会跑过来攻击你。: You must leave this place at once. They'll rush in and beat you to a pulp.
……最后落得跟我一样的下场。: You'll end up just like me.
……咦？这该不会……: Wait, is that what I think it is?
我的缝衣针！是你帮我拿回来的吗？: You got it back for me? My sewing needle!
你为什么要对我这么好？: What made you go and do a thing like that...
这是她的遗物。: ...and that sewing kit was all I had to remember her by.
您还记得我吗？我是亚人柏克。: Do you remember me? Boc, the demi-human.
之前因为有主子的帮忙，才能顺利拿回缝衣针。: You helped me before, and retrieved my sewing needle.
请您让我作为裁缝师，替您工作。: Allow me to serve you, as your seamster.
我还没办法从零开始缝制衣服，: I can't make nothing from scratch, but…
但如果需要修改衣服，请您尽管吩咐。: I'm happy to make adjustments to your garments.
主子，裁缝师柏克为您服务。: Boc the seamster, at your service, Master.
需要修改衣服的话，请尽管吩咐。: Ready to make adjustments to your garments.
请一路上小心安全。: Please, do be safe on your journeys.
主子会自己修改服装吗？: Do you ever...make adjustments to your garb yourself?
那个，如果您有修改服装的需要，\n希望能尽可能交给我处理。: I would, well, rather you let me do the job when possible, please.
我不求任何回报，毕竟……: I don't ask anything in return, you know, and, well...
柏克是主子的裁缝师啊！: I am your personal seamster, after all!
因为柏克是主子的裁缝师啊！: I am your personal seamster, after all!
老实说，您带来的东西里，\n我发现有属于古老半神的衣物。: Your wardrobe includes the garb of old demigods,
我没有能力修改这类衣物。: and I'm afraid I can't make adjustments to them.
如果是王室的裁缝师，\n修改这类衣物是轻而易举的事情……: That a royal seamster would do them up in a jiffy.
主子，我也会加油，\n努力成为那么厉害的裁缝师！: Just wait, master. Before long, I'll be that good, too!
……您要送礼给柏克？: Is that a gift for my undeserving self?
谢谢您。是什么东西呢……？: Thank you kindly. But what on earth could it...
好棒！是黄金缝衣针，我第一次看到！: Amazing! I've never seen a golden needle, not in all my life!
还有这么威武的王室徽章在上头……: With a spectacular royal crest, to boot...
这东西真的要送给我吗？: Are you certain that this is for me?
……啊啊，真的好棒……: Oh, I can hardly believe it.
我一定会成为厉害的裁缝师，\n不会让您送缝衣针的美意白费。: I'll polish my craft enough that I deserve this golden gift!
我是“黄金裁缝师”柏克！: I'll be the golden seamster, Boc!
不会再说自己不能修改半神的衣物了！: Now I'll be able to sew anything, even the threads of the demigods!
……如果母亲知道了，会不会替我高兴呢？: Do you think that Mum would be pleased if she knew?
我已经不输王室的裁缝师了。: That I'm as good as any royal seamster, now.
得先像母亲一样，有能力从零开始缝制衣服。: I need to learn how to sew from scratch, like her.
……主子，我有一件请求。: Master, may I ask you something?
我能改称呼您为“吾王”吗？: Would you mind if I called you lord?
……主子是褪色者，而我听说\n褪色者的目标是成为艾尔登之王。: I heard that you and the other Tarnished seek the throne of the Elden Lord.
我认为主子能当上艾尔登之王……: Well, I know that you will be the one,
我也希望像您这么温柔的人，\n能够当上艾尔登之王。: and you'd make just the manner of kind-hearted lord that I'd wish for.
让我称呼您为“吾王”。: Allow me to call you lord.
真的吗！谢谢您！: You don't say! Thank you, thank you!
请允许裁缝师柏克，终生随侍身旁。: And please, let I, Boc the seamster, remain at your side.
竟然提出令人不快的请求，\n请您当作没发生过吧。: Forgive me, for overstepping my bounds. I didn't mean it.
吾王啊，裁缝师柏克在此。: Boc the seamster, at your service, m'lord.
我没有办法好好表达出来……: I, oh, I don't really have the words for this...
那看起来非常、非常耀眼，我好感动。: But I was so...so dazzled, I felt something stir, in my breast.
……而且，那棵黄金树在等主子找它。: The Erdtree is waiting for you, master.
我很清楚，肯定不会有错。: I know it, I do. I feel it in my bones.
……而且，那棵黄金树在等您找它。: The Erdtree is waiting for you, m'lord.
……请您当上艾尔登之王。: O please, take the throne of Elden Lord.
吾王啊，您有想过重生吗？: M'lord... Have you ever wished you might be born again?
我听说雷亚卢卡利亚的蕾娜菈大人，: Well, they say that Rennala of Raya Lucaria
拥有使人重生的力量喔。: has the power to help people be reborn.
……您也知道，我的外表奇丑无比。: Oh, look at me. When you're this ugly...
我想即使有办法重生，一定也是无药可救。: well, being reborn? It would hardly make a difference, I'm afraid.
这该不会是重生用的必需品？: It can't be… For my rebirth?
要给我这么贵重的东西吗？: But these are precious, are you certain that it's for me?
我打从心底一直这么想──\n希望自己的外表能够不丢您的脸……: It was my only wish, that I might honour you with a decent appearance.
……吾王啊，请您稍待。: M'lord, it shouldn't take me long.
我准备前往雷亚卢卡利亚的蕾娜菈大人身边，: I'm off to see Rennala of Raya Lucaria.
一定会重生成理想的外表。: I'll be reborn, fresh and new.
您是怎么想的呢？: In all honesty, what do you think of me?
是否不论结果，都该试试看重生呢？: Must I be reborn, no matter what ill fate awaits me?
这种理所当然的事情，竟然还不懂。: I don't even have answers to the simplest of questions.
主子，您有想过重生吗？: Master... Have you ever wished you might be born again?
……主子，请您稍待。: Master, it shouldn't take me long.
……我刚才听到了母亲的声音。: Did I just hear my mum speaking?
我这副外表也只有母亲会夸我好看，: Mum was always the only one who said I was beautiful.
……啊啊，如果我的想法逾矩，请您见谅。: Please, if I may dream, just once...
那道声音的背后，是否也存在吾王的想法？: Do you feel the same way my mum did, m'lord?
对奇丑无比的我，您是否也夸我好看？: Do you think I'm beautiful, despite these looks?
请让裁缝师柏克终生随侍您身旁。: I, Boc the seamster, am forever in your service.
……这、天经地义啊……: No, why on earth would you...
我说了不切实际的话了，请您当作没发生过吧。: It was silly of me to ask. Please, forget that I did.
但拜托您，千万不要抛弃丑陋的我。: But I beg, don't renounce me for my appearance.
我一定会变成不让您丢脸的外表……: One day, I'll look every bit the servant.
那道声音的背后，是否也存在主子的想法？: Do you feel the same way my mum did, master?
……怎么可以，这样太浪费了。我不能收。: Oh no, I can't. It would be wasted on the likes of me.
请主子享用就好。: You should drink it yourself, master.
对柏克而言，这样最幸福。: I would be far happier knowing you enjoyed it yourself.
请吾王享用就好。: You should drink it yourself, m'lord.
柏克一定、一定会好好珍惜。: I don't deserve it, but I'll savour every last drop.
你干么打我啦！: Why'd you go and do that?
就因为我长得很丑吗？: It's because I'm ugly, isn't it?
……哦，果然是这样吗？: Oh, now, you too, is it?
怎么都是我……: The story of my rotten life...
还是说，是因为我太过丑陋了？: Or is it just...because I'm ugly?
被主子这么说……我、我……: Master, is that the truth, your heart of hearts? My, oh my...
……啊，我对主子做了什么……: Oh, master, what have I done...
被吾王这么说……我、我……: M'lord, is that the truth, your heart of hearts? My, oh my...
……哦，有访客啊？太难得了。: Well, look at you. We don't receive many visitors.
你看起来是褪色者，请问有什么事？: I presume you are a Tarnished. What brings you here?
啊，抱歉。\n用这种刨根究底的口吻，是不太礼貌。: Oh, pardon me. It's hardly my place to ask, is it.

……然后，即使锻造的工夫退步了，: An old codger who refuses to retire his rusty hammer.
还不愿退休，继续留在这里默默当铁匠。: So, here I am, still quietly plying my trade, on this spot.
……我这老头子还有多少能耐，要不要一探究竟？: Perhaps you'd like a display? These bones are old, but still able.
你又过来了，真令我高兴。: Well, it's kind of you to speak to me again.
这代表我锻造的工夫还不算太差？: Then I presume these old bones served their purpose, more or less?
褪色者啊，又想找老头子锻造吗？: Brave Tarnished. Here to put my old bones to work again?
褪色者啊，请听听我的忠告。: Brave Tarnished. A word of warning, if you please.
这块土地原本是卡利亚王室的领地，\n再往前的地方，有王室成员居住的城寨。: This territory once belonged to the Carian royal family. Their manor lies not far beyond this point.
在雷亚卢卡利亚学院背叛王室以后，\n众多杜鹃骑士前来攻击此地……: When the Raya Lucaria Academy turned on the Carians, the Knights of the Cuckoo descended on this tract.
在摧毁这里之后，步步逼近城寨。: After leveling it, they carried on to the manor.
不过，即使遭受出其不意的攻击，\n卡利亚王室仍有能力击退骑士，: The Carians were taken off guard, but their strength had not waned, and they repelled the knights' onslaught...
只是当时使用的那些恐怖魔法陷阱，\n就直接维持原状，留在原地。: By conjuring an enchanted snare that remains potent to this day.
所以说，褪色者啊，别靠近城寨。: That is why I say, Tarnished. Don't go near the manor.
你也不想踏上那些愚蠢杜鹃的后路吧？: Unless you wish to lie with the corpses of the heedless Knights of the Cuckoo.
我一旦全神贯注地锻造，就无法留意周遭事物。: When I'm absorbed in my smithing, I lose sight of all else.
靠太近的话，有可能会让你受伤。: If you come too close, I'm apt to cause you harm.
而且我的体型比你们褪色者大上非常多，: I am, after all, terribly large compared to you, Tarnished.
要我不碰坏东西行动，实在困难重重。: You don't know how hard it is not to break anything while I work.
卡利亚王室的城寨里，\n还留着当时使用的恐怖魔法陷阱。: Of the enchanted snare that remains at the royal Carian Manor.
