这场战斗毫无意义……: What am I to make of this?
……好了，这次真的该成为复仇的祭品──: Prepare to become an offering, once and for all.
嗯，我有听说。: Yes, yes, I've heard all about you.
我是赛尔维斯，是魔法教授。: I am Seluvis, preceptor in the sorcerous arts.
这种没见过世面的褪色者，\n真不知道她抱有什么期待。: I don't know what it is the mistress sees in a provincial Tarnished like you,
只是偏偏那么巧，很不幸地共事一主，: but since we have the misfortune of serving the same Lady,
希望你能有点用处。: I ask that you kindly try not to drag us all down with you.
……我待在这附近的另一座塔。: I reside...in another tower, close by.
如果你希望自己对菈妮有点用处，: Come and pay me a visit...
就过来找我吧。: Should you wish to be of actual service to Mistress Ranni.
照道理而言，\n我是不可能为你这种角色花时间，: If it were up to me, I wouldn't waste my time on the likes of you.
但我也不能无视她的意思……: But who am I to stand against the wishes of my Lady?
……哦，你还真的过来找我？: Well, well. You took me at my word.
连场面话都听不懂，\n所以我才受不了井底之蛙。: Did you not realise I was merely being polite? You provincials never cease to amaze...
……唉，既然人来都来了，: Hmm, I suppose you're here now.
那就麻烦你办一件事吧。: Perhaps I'll give you something to do.
找出名叫涅斐丽的女人，让她喝下药水。: I'd like you to find a woman called Nepheli, to administer a potion.
才这点事情，你办得到吧？: Even you can do that much, can't you?
那这瓶药你收着。: Now I shall hand over the potion in question.
找出涅斐丽，让她喝下。: Find Nepheli, and ensure she drinks it.
……我等你的好消息。: I expect glad tidings. And soon.
所以我才说，褪色者就是没眼界。: What a wretched bunch you Tarnished are.
我是在给你机会，你明不明白？: Do you understand? I've given you a very fine chance.
要你去办个事，事成之后，\n你就有机会接受我的指导。: If you complete this simple task, I will graciously permit you to learn from me.
你也想为菈妮出一己之力吧？: Even you wish to serve our Lady well, do you not?
想好之后再给出回答。: Turn those little cogs upstairs, and return with the correct answer.
……好啦，让我听听你深思熟虑后的回答吧。: Have you fumbled out the correct answer now?
你愿意替我办事吗？: Then you will undertake my task?
你真的是无药可救的蠢蛋。: You are peerless in your dullardry.
够了，和你对话只会消耗我的脑力，: Fine. I can feel my wits evaporating in your mere presence.
不要再向我搭话。: Don't bother wasting your breath on me again.
……我都说了，不要再向我搭话……: I could have sworn I told you to trouble me no more...
难道你是真心悔过，想为我办事？: Are you here to tender your sincere apology, and undertake my task?
我为人宽大为怀，愿意接受你的悔过。: As a man of abundant charity, I accept your apology.
这瓶药你收着。: Now I shall hand over the potion in question.
……我不想听废话。: I've no time for idle chit chat.
我想听的是事情办妥了没。: The only thing I will hear from you is a report of your task's completion.
听懂了就快点出去，: Are we understood? Then off you trot.
我忙得很。: I have enough on my plate.
……哦？这样啊。涅斐丽喝下去了？: Ahh, so you made Nepheli drink the potion?
很好，那我就赐予你天大的名誉，: Very well. Then you shall have your gift.
允许你接受我魔法教授，赛尔维斯的指导。: Knowledge of the sorcerous arts, under the tutelage of the great Preceptor Seluvis.
绝大部分都是褪色者无法掌握的知识，: I doubt much of it will lay within the grasp of a mere Tarnished, but...
你就尽力学，努力为菈妮尽一份力吧。: If you put your mind to it, perhaps you won't embarrass our Lady.
……这么快就想求人指教？: You wish to begin right this moment?
真是肤浅，虽然我能体会这种心情。: Well, your impatience, though boorish, is understandable. Let's have at it.
……又来求人指教了？: Begging for another lesson so soon?
我很忙啊……: There remains much to be done. Make it quick.
……想假装自己都学会了是无妨，: Come now, the pretence of comprehension becomes you not.
但要记住，所谓的棒打出头鸟啊。: Bend over backwards any further and you're apt to break.
……哦，这件事你拿来问我？: Well, well. You're asking me about that, are you?
那不是你跟那只蠢狗的任务吗？: The task was left to you and the mongrel, was it not?
无能就算了，你们还这么不知耻？: Not only are you incompetent, but shameless to boot.
时机也成熟了，我告诉你。: Now's as good a time as any. I'll let you in on it.
在宁姆格福，\n那里应该有位名叫瑟濂的辉石魔法师。: There's a glintstone sorcerer by the name of Sellen in Limgrave.
在她被逐出学院的时候，我关照过她。: She owes me for the help I gave her when she was expelled from the academy.
以前也很常委托她调查事情。: I asked her to look into the matter some time ago.
我帮你写介绍信，带着过去问她吧。: I'll write you a letter of introduction. Go ask her.
……你是真的有让涅斐丽喝下药水？: So, you had Nepheli drink the potion? Truly?
……嗯，既然如此，代表那瓶药有问题。: Hmm. Then perhaps something was amiss with it.
那是用稀有材料制成的药水，\n看来需要重新检验一遍。: It's concocted from the finest ingredients. But perhaps I should review the recipe.
但也有可能，是我对那女人的期望过高……: I may have expected too much of her, to begin with.
……你不经同意，擅自溜进别人的房间翻箱倒柜？: You break into a man's private chambers, rooting about as you please?
你欺骗涅斐丽，让她喝下那瓶药──: You tricked Nepheli, and had her drink the potion.
仔细一想，你我早就是共犯。: I believe that makes you my accomplice.
你也想拥有自己的傀儡吧？: You yearn for a puppet of your own, hmm?
真是不知天高地厚的奢望，: Well, normally one of your stature would never be allowed.
但我可以特别开恩，实现你的愿望。: But perhaps I can make a very special exception.
啊，我就相信你会这么做。: Ah, I knew you'd see things my way.
你我已经是共犯，而且我知道……: You knew you were already my accomplice, and as such...
你也很想品味傀儡的美吧？: You wanted one for yourself, hmm? A puppet, to cherish.
……好久没有收这方面的学生了，: Well, it's been some time since a pupil of mine last walked this road.
就给你特别的傀儡当作纪念。: To mark the occasion, I shall grant you the puppet you so desire.
在你诓骗涅斐丽，让她喝下那酒……\n那瓶我拿给你的药酒。: The tipple you fooled Nepheli into drinking, yes, my little draught.
既然如此，你还能有其他答案吗？: Are you ready to change your mind, now?
……我说啊。\n品味傀儡的美，是非常美好的一件事。: It's no sin, pining for a puppet to cherish.
……好了，快点归还那物品吧。: Now, hand it over, and don't make a fuss.
我不会加害于你。\n除此之外，我还可以给你一具傀儡。: Nothing bad will happen. I'll even consider giving you a puppet of your own.
那就免谈了。\n快点离开，不要再让我见到你。: Fine. Leave this place, and never darken my doorstep again.
这是最后一次见到神智清楚的你。: This is the last time I'll see you, in your present state.
……我有说过，不要再让我见到你……: I thought I told you never to show your face again.
难道你是真心悔过，想归还那物品？: Have you decided to return what's mine, and proffer a sincere apology?
……况且，你应该有自觉了吧？: And well, you finally realised, did you?
自己打从心底，想要品味傀儡的美。: All you really wanted was a puppet to cherish. To fill that hole deep in your heart.
……傀儡的状况如何？: How's the puppet I gave you?
那孩子很棒，对吧……？: A thing of exquisite craft, is it not?
……哦？你想要新的傀儡？: What's that? You want another puppet?
但那些全是我心爱的孩子，: But, I'm afraid each and every one is like a child to me.
不能白白让出……: I can hardly just give them away.
……嗯，该怎么办才好……: Oh dear, what's to be done?
好，你去准备星光碎片吧。: Why don't you...fetch me some starlight shards?
那可不是普通的酒，是形似琥珀的老酒。: It's no mere booze, but a refined old drink of amber hue.
把那交给我，我很乐意送你新的傀儡。: If you can manage it, I'll gladly prepare a new puppet for you.
……拥有的傀儡一多就会明白，\n每个灵魂各有千秋。: The soul of every puppet has its own ambience. You'll soon come to know, once you possess a few.
在理解到这一点之后，就会更加疼爱每个孩子。: And once each's predilections are known to you, the better you'll be able to love them.
只是你现在还不能体会……: Oh yes, you have much to look forward to, further down this road.
……你在傀儡师的领域十分上进啊。: You're proving to be quite the puppeteer.
好久没有收这方面的学生了。: I've not had an apprentice for…a very long time indeed.
……有个秘密，你有没有兴趣听？: Perhaps, you'd be interested in a little scheme of mine?
那是关于能亲自品味上乘傀儡的美……: It will produce the finest of puppets.
但是连带着，会蒙骗菈妮的秘密。: Which I aspire to cherish with these very hands.
怎么样？我想你一定有兴趣吧？: A ploy to fool even Lady Ranni... How does that sound?
我想要你去准备一样东西。: Then I'd like you to procure something.
闪耀着琥珀色光芒的，特殊的星光碎片。: A rather unique starlight shard that glistens with amber.
只要有它，我的药水就能散发出柔美光泽……: With that, my special draught will gleam with nectar-sweetness.
肯定连半神也会为之心醉。: And even a demigod would be slave to its charms...
那闪耀着琥珀色光芒的，特殊的星光碎片。: The rather unique starlight shard that glistens with amber.
……对，我是在考验你。: You passed my little test with flying colours.
测试你身为侍奉菈妮的人，到底称职与否。: I was merely gauging your loyalty to Lady Ranni.
你及格了，我也与有荣焉。: Well done, I'm very proud of you.
继续为了她鞠躬尽瘁吧。: Let's both do our utmost in service of our Lady.
……难道说，你有兴趣吗？: Ah ha. Might you be interested after all?
那个会蒙骗菈妮的秘密？: In a fine scheme to sport with Lady Ranni?
考验已经结束了。: Your test is well and truly over.
对主人摇尾巴、展现忠诚是无妨，\n但是不是也该适时遵循自己的渴望？: Wag your tail for master all you like, but your loyalty is merely blind.
那股藏也藏不住的肤浅，欲盖弥彰啊。: I fear your wretched provinciality is apt to burst. You're oozing at the seams.
……你拿到了吗！: Well, well, you managed to lay your hands on it!
这就是我梦寐以求的……: The blessed day is finally upon us...
哦、哦哦，多么魅惑的光芒啊……: Goodness gracious, the way it glistens...utterly enchanting.
这曾是半神的命运啊……: To think, this was once a demigod's very fate...
想起来，我还没有给你奖励。: Oh yes, I should give you your reward.
你做得非常好，收下吧。: Please, it's all yours. Splendid work. Just marvellous.
……还有，慢慢期待吧。: Now, just you wait. The merriment is soon to begin.
那“秘密”已经推进到最后阶段了。: The scheme I promised is to be revealed very shortly...
……啊，等你很久了。: Good, I've been waiting for you.
终于完成了──\n我的药水发出了堪称完美的柔美光泽。: It's finally complete. The perfection of my draught, gleaming nectar-sweet.
好啦，让菈妮喝下吧。: Give it to Ranni and ensure she drinks it.
……没什么好担心的。\n那冷冰冰的人偶，不知怎地，对你特别有兴趣。: The dead-eyed doll lets down her guard in your presence, rather remarkably.
即使背负罪孽，举止岸然──\n她也不过是个娇弱的可爱女孩。: Though she might dip her hands in the dirt, and feign that icy persona…she's a frail, gentle girl at heart.
即使背负罪孽，举止岸然──\n菈妮也不过是个娇弱的可爱女孩。: Though she might dip her hands in the dirt, and feign that icy persona...she's still just a feeble, pampered little girl when it comes down to it.
所以你应该能成功，: Which is why you're the only one for the job.
让菈妮喝下我制成的药酒吧。: Now do it. Make Ranni drink my draught.
让菈妮喝下药水，就能实现“秘密”了──: That once you have Ranni drink my draught, my scheme will come to fruition.
你我就能得到上乘的傀儡，尽情品味她的美。: And we, well, we'll be in a position to claim the very finest puppet ever crafted.
……啊，不要让我等太久……: Come now, don't make me wait.
我快要等不及了……: I can barely contain myself as it is...
……慢慢期待吧。: You'll be flabbergasted, I can assure you.
受不了，你是从哪偷来的？: I won't bother to ask where you pilfered it, but...
……但确实，大概要到我这种水准的人，\n才有办法解读内容。: You're correct to assume I'm one of the few who can decipher it.
我就收下了。: So, I'm perfectly happy to take it off your hands.
别抱太大的期待啊。: That said, don't you dare get your hopes up.
接触新事物通常是发觉自身的平庸，: More often than not, new knowledge is merely an opportunity to reflect…
这几天夜里有时会听见狼嚎，相当扰人。: The nightly wolf howling that's been disturbing the peace here.
如果你在附近见到那只蠢狗，布莱泽，: If that bothersome mutt, Blaidd, is back in town,
帮我传话给他，叫他快滚。: then tell him to pack up and ship out.
……畜生的吠声实在恼人，受不了。: I never liked the din of a dog's howl.
更别提是那种不上不下的家伙。: From a mongrel like him, it's simply agony.
要我喝酒吗？: Are you proposing that I partake?
你认为我有那么愚蠢？: Do I appear such a gormless tomfool to you?
会沉浸在一时的快乐，吐露自己的秘密？: A slow-wit who'd divulge his secrets for a moment of bliss?
……给你一个建议。: Well, let me give you some advice.
用计谋算人是无妨，但要看清对手的底细。: Scheming has its place, but consider the one you're scheming against.
不然总有一天，你会吃尽苦头。: You might find yourself on the wrong end of a proper beating one day.
没、没有注意到您，万分抱歉。: I-I apologise for any offence given.
小的名叫毕迪，是卡利亚王室的仆人。: I am Pidia. Servant to the Carian royal family.
负责打理这些恶、恶心的人偶。: I am charged with maintaining these g-ghastly dolls.
除了人偶以外，这座仓库还有各式稀奇的物品，: Other than the puppets, there are some very fine things up here in this storeroom.
看过之后有属意的，也请别吝啬带走。: Why not pick something out, before you go?
只、只是，还请您可怜、可怜小的，: But please, can you offer poor ill-starred Pidia...
带走之余，也请留下相对的钱财……: A little something by way of compensation?
毕迪已经竭尽所能了，请您见谅。: I can't be of further use to you. Please, forgive me.
啊啊，请您见谅、请您见谅……: Please, find it in your heart... Forgive me...
你们是我的傀儡，我都投注这么多爱给你们了，: Y-you're my puppets! I loved you with all I have!
求求你们了，不要这么残忍。: Please, I beg you, cease this cruelty!
这么稀罕的珍品，毕迪实在不能收。: Poor Pidia could never accept such a precious brew.
非、非常抱歉，无法接受您的好意。: Very sorry, really, if I... I've disappointed you,
请您见谅。: If you will, please forget this matter entirely.
再怎么说，你我还算是共事一主的人。: Have you forgotten that we both serve the same Lady?
不要再让我见到你。: Don't you dare waltz back here ever again.
想偷偷摸摸拿走别人的东西喔？: Thought you'd just help yourself to a man's personal belongings?
不要脸的小偷就活该遭天谴！: You scheming little thief. The gods demand repentance!
把值钱的东西全部留下，滚吧！: Cough up your coin, all of it!
我投降！投降！: I surrender! White flag and all!
你打算攻击手无寸铁的人喔？: I yield, yield! You can't harm a yielding man!
做坏事还理直气壮，指的就是你这种人！: We're about to make out like Bandits, boys!
仔细一看，你不也是褪色者吗？: Well, what do you know? You're Tarnished, like me.
哎呀，我完全误会了说，: Now, how did I get that wrong?
总而言之，这种不幸的误会常有啦。: An innocent mistake, I assure you.
话说开之后，恩怨就放水流吧。\n之后再多多关照啦，如何？: Well, water under the bridge. Now we're squared up, how about we play nice from now on?
和你一样都是褪色者，也是到处旅行的漂泊者。: Tarnished, like you, only, free-spirited. Nomadic, you might say.
总之，我有在罩他们就对了。: In exchange for my, well, showing them the ropes.
不过啊……抢夺财物这一行，风险也不小嘛。: But honestly... this looting racket is bloody terrifying.
所以说，有空再过来喔。: So, don't be a stranger, eh?
我会做好准备，等待你大驾光临。: I'll be ready to wheel and deal, come next time.
怎么啦？你应该很讲理的啊。: What's the matter? This simply isn't like you.
明明知道这只是一场不幸的误会。: You've always known an innocent mistake when you see one.
……有空再过来吧。: Don't forget to pop back for another visit, friend.
我会做好开店准备，等你大驾光临。: I'll be ready to wheel and deal, come next time.
都是些临时进货的商品，别嫌弃来看看吧。: It's all a bit ad hoc, but I'm sure you'll find something.
嗨，你好啊。\n欢迎光临帕奇商店。: Hello, again. Welcome to Patches' Emporium.
哦，之前那个强盗团，全都金盆洗手啦。: Yeah, I had those bandits make a clean break.
现在他们的专职是进货。: Now they're all suppliers, and good ones at that.
……哎呀，虽然完全无法沟通，: I mean, they don't understand a word I'm saying,
但我就是觉得和他们合得来。: but it hardly matters, we have a natural connection.
乍看之下，他们好像是战败的士兵。: They're all foot soldiers. Survivors of a defeated army.
替某个大人物做牛做马，压榨完了就被随便一扔──\n反正八九不离十，就是这回事吧。: Worked to the bone by their high-and-mighty lord, only to be thrown out with the rubbish.
……走到哪都在玩历史重演啊，混账东西。: ...It's the same old story, everywhere I go. Ah, to hell with it all.
嗯？你注意到那个宝箱了？: Hm? Wondering what's inside the treasure chest?
那宝箱，嗯……放了特殊的宝物。: Well, it's uh, nothing too special.
我想说之后可以把那东西\n送给我们店的贵客，当作谢礼。: Just something I'm saving as thanks, for a very valuable customer...
但是又觉得送出去很舍不得……: But then again, it would fetch some spectacular coin...
唉，还不是贵客的话，这件事也不好说。: And besides, this valuable customer could be a long time coming...
你是明事理的人，应该也知道吧？\n就是所谓的人要互相、各取所需嘛。: Eh? Everything is give and take, give and take.
哦，漏了东西没买吗？: Forgot something on your shopping list?
感谢你时常光顾。: You've really been there for me, through thick and thin.
我决定啦，那个宝箱就送给你吧。: And so, I've made up my mind. I bequeath that chest to you.
特殊宝物就送给你这位大贵客了。: An extra-special thanks, for an extra-special customer.
怎么啦？我都下定决心了。: What's wrong? I've made up my mind.
那个宝箱是你的了。: The treasure chest is yours, in word and deed.
……舍不得，说实话真舍不得，: Sure, it may be worth its weight in gold.
但我男子汉帕奇一言既出，驷马难追！: But a Patches Promise? Well, that's priceless!
哦、哦……你平安无事啊。: Ah, oh... How in blazes... You're alive.
我真的吓坏了，你突然就消失不见。: You had me proper scared. Poofing away in a flash like that.
说不定是因为你乱碰别人的东西，\n才会遭到这种天谴。: Maybe it's a sign to keep your mitts off what's not rightly yours, hmm?
唉，但我愿意原谅你。之后不要再犯了。: But I'll forgive you. View it as a learning experience.
总而言之，你人没事就好。: At any rate, it's nice just to see you safe.
来逛一逛帕奇商店吧。: And don't miss all the bargains, here at Patches' Emporium!
万万没想到那个宝箱会藏着那种陷阱。: Who on earth spends their time booby-trapping treasure chests?
就算我不知情，还是万分抱歉。\n竟然发生这种不幸的意外。: No way I could've known, but still, I apologise. It's all very unfortunate.
哦，你来啦。\n我差不多要离开这座洞窟了。: Oh yes, by the way. I'm saying goodbye to the old cave.
我生来居无定所，疯癫度世──时候差不多到了。: I'm untethered, by nature, and It's about time that I moved on.
帕奇商店会交由他们继续经营，: No worries, the old gang will inherit the shop.
沟通是没办法沟通，但他们认得你。: They may not speak a word, but they never forget a face.
之后再请多惠顾啦。: Spare them some coin after I'm gone, eh?
哦，好久不见。: Oh, well! It's been a long while.
其实我还是有继续做生意。: I'm still in business, if you can believe it.
现在连进货都是我自己包办，\n品项稍微少了点，但绝对买到不吃亏。: Now I'm my only supplier, so I haven't got much, but everything here is top notch.
来逛一逛帕奇商店，雷亚卢卡利亚分店吧。: Patches' Emporium, now open in Raya Lucaria.
你很有眼光喔。: You have yourself a discerning eye, I can tell.
那尊小雕像一定能卖很多钱。: That statuette will net you a small fortune, no doubt.
比如说卖给那边那群……\n穿着破烂衣服的流浪商人。: In fact, I'll bet any of those scruffy merchants would leap at the chance to buy it...
哦？你不买小雕像吗？: Oh, really? No interest in the statuette?
你那么有眼光，这不寻常喔。: I was sure it would catch your eye.
唉，我也不强迫推销啦……: Well, I can't force it on you, but...
但那东西真的不错，不买可惜啦……: Incomparable craftsmanship, you know. I'd hate to see it go to someone else...
话说回来，你有见过一个叫菈雅的女孩吗？: By the way, have you met that girl Rya?
前阵子我有在大道附近看到她……: I spotted her somewhere along the highroad not long ago.
那女孩子有点奇特，看起来好像需要人帮忙。: She's a strange one, but I believe she was in need of help.
嗯，反正不关我的事……: Not that it's any of my business, but...
如果你想管闲事，要不要跑一趟找她？: If she rings your bell, why not lend her an ear?
那个叫菈雅的女孩子，应该还在大道附近吧？: Looking for Rya? Still hanging around on the high road, I suppose.
嗨，你好，还是全身而退啊。: Oh, hello. I knew it'd all be fine...
没事，我自言自语。\n欢迎光临帕奇商店。: Oh, it's nothing, don't mind me. Welcome to Patches' Emporium!
……你想到那棵黄金树的所在地，是吧？: You're...making your way to the Erdtree, no?
是的话正好，我知道一个好方法。\n有一个特殊的方法可以到那里。: Well I heard something that might help. A special means of reaching your destination.
你有看过铁少女人偶吗？: Have you ever seen an iron virgin?
就是那个拿着锁镰和刺轮挥舞，\n很奇怪的自动人偶……: The clunky contraptions are whirlwinds of sickles and spiked wheels.
……听说在以前啊，\n它身上会搭载传送魔法的装置喔。: ...but long ago, they were endowed with a spell of transposition.
然后啊，在雷亚卢卡利亚学院里面，\n有座大水车的底部，那里有一尊少女人偶。: And get this. A surviving virgin sits at the bottom of the big waterwheel in the Academy of Raya Lucaria.
……所以啊，只要故意被它抓到，: So, right, if you get caught in it on purpose...
就有办法到黄金树的树脚下喔……: It'll chuck you out straight at the base of the Erdtree... Or so I'm told...
哦，那个好方法啊。多听几次也好。: Oh yeah, great story isn't it. I'll tell you as many times as you like.
在雷亚卢卡利亚学院里面有座大水车，\n它的底部有一尊少女人偶。: There's a surviving Iron Virgin at the bottom of the big waterwheel in the Academy of Raya Lucaria.
……然后啊，只要故意被它抓到，\n就有办法到黄金树的树脚下。: And I heard...if you let yourself get caught in it, it'll chuck you out straight at the base of the Erdtree.
哦，我大概知道你想说什么，: Hold on, don't you say a word, my friend.
但是我可没说谎喔。: I spoke no lie, not a one.
只要被抓去火山再逃出来的话，: You were trapped inside a volcano, no mistake,
那边就是黄金树的树脚下啊。: but the Erdtree was right outside. You just had to spring yourself out.
对、对啦……\n可能是我解释得不够清楚啦……: I'm willing to admit. I could have been more clear.
但我没说谎啊，你也平安无事。\n这就是圆满落幕、皆大欢喜啊，对不对？: But I did not lie, and you're perfectly unscathed. All's well that ends well, right?
好巧啊，在这里遇见你。: Strange place for a chance encounter, eh?
我正在休息。\n不用管我，你先走吧。: Thought I could use a rest. Don't mind me, go about your business.
……怎、怎样啦，不用管我，你先走吧。: What is it? Oh, don't mind me. Off you trot.
嗨、嗨，你回来啦。: Oh, my, well, here you are again.
刚才抱歉啦，我本来想要警告你，\n没想到你竟然掉下去了。: So sorry for that. I meant to warn you, but whoops! There you went.
虽然说是弄巧成拙，抱歉给你添了麻烦。: Despite my best intentions, I've done you wrong, I have.
但是啊，你也平安无事嘛。\n这样不算数啊，不算数。: But here you are, standing tall and proud. All's well that ends well, eh.
而且我说的警告是真的。: And my warning was spot-on, you tell me different!
劝你别靠近火山官邸，: Stay clear of Volcano Manor, end of discussion.
听说那群人正在狩猎褪色者啊。: I heard the brutes there hunt Tarnished like animals.
……我说的警告是真的。: You didn't listen last time, but I'm warning you again.
……哦，你变成火山官邸的一员啦？: Well, you've joined the Manor, eh?
没想过你会加入这一边，吓我一跳。: I don't believe it. Didn't think you had it in you.
菈雅的眼光算是马马虎虎吧。: And here I thought Rya was barking up the wrong tree...
唉，也好啦，总之就是同伴了。: All good, though. We're on the same side, now.
啊，对了。\n想买东西的话，我可以卖你喔。: Oh, and of course, we can do business, if you like.
帕奇商店，火山官邸分店，\n特别为你敞开大门。: Patches' Emporium at the Volcano Manor. Specially for you.
你在火山官邸还是个菜鸟──: You're new here at the Manor.
好好完成委托，提升对自己的信任，\n这样比较有利喔。: But if you complete the request, you can improve your standing.
不用客气啦，我们这么熟。\n而且前辈要提携后进嘛。: Relax, we're old friends. Time's come to pass the torch, right?
唉，加油啦。: Go on, break a leg, then.
怎么啦？那份委托太棘手了吗？: What's the matter? Having trouble nabbing your prey?
不过，该怎么说呢？才刚开始就要人帮忙，: Well, I wouldn't go asking for help so soon.
那你不适合待在火山官邸吧。: We're not here to make your life easier.
你不是在塔妮丝面前发过誓了吗？\n说要对黄金树举剑相向。: Do you remember your vow to Tanith? To rise against the Erdtree.
这样不就代表，你的决心根本不够吗？: Dare I say your heart was never in it to begin with?
这样不就代表，你还有那个叫狄亚罗斯的，\n你们的决心根本不够吗？: You and Diallos both. Perhaps your hearts were never in it to begin with?
不，没事，这样很好。\n你做得很好。: No, it's quite alright, fine work, indeed.
你好好休息。: Have some rest, by all means.
……我是火山官邸的一员，你很意外吗？: Are you surprised? That I belong to the Volcano Manor.
那个什么赐福的指引，还有双指之类的，\n我很认同那根本就是狗屁。: I always hated the gibberish about lost grace and the laughable Two Fingers.
既然有人心有二意，打算攻其不备，\n我就觉得助阵一下也不坏。: I thought I could lend a hand in unmasking the charade.
……而且啊，我觉得塔妮丝颇有意思的。: Not to mention Tanith has always made me curious.
不清楚她背后的主人是多厉害的角色，\n但就看她自信满满的，: I guess her master must really be something, cause she's pretty damn smug about it.
公开宣告亵渎的意图与野心就算了，\n还一副凛然的态度。: Even after announcing her blasphemous ambitions, she still stands proud.
我还是第一次遇到那种女人……: I've never seen a woman quite like her...
你还挺会计较的嘛。: Sharper than you seem, aren't you...
对啦，塔妮丝是有给我报酬。: I was just holding onto it for you, you know.
给你，狩猎忒拉格斯的奖励。收下吧。: Here you go. The reward for hunting Tragoth. All yours.
……你干掉拉卡德啦？: Now you've gone and killed Rykard?
看了你这个人，\n就觉得那句话不是空穴来风──: Cripes, you make this nonsense seem, well, less nonsensical...
褪色者能当上艾尔登之王啊……: Perhaps a Tarnished will be Elden Lord after all...
……这座官邸也差不多完蛋了。: But for now, this Manor is finished.
半神怪物被打败，\n塔妮丝也失去了自我……: The demigod beast is slain, and Tanith has lost her head.
心存亵渎的意图与野心，\n最后落得这种烂下场还真适合喔。: A fine mess, but how else could it end when daddy ambition is head over heels courting lady blasphemy.
我打算回到疯癫度世的生活，: Well, here I am. Untethered, once again.
打算为帕奇商店来个最后的送别吗？: Oh, come to make a parting donation to Patches' Emporium?
这么巧，在栽了斤斗的时候遇见你……: A shame you had to see me like this...
……嗯，我一闪神就这副德性了。: Ohh, I had a bit of a slip-up, that's all.
人真的不该做超出本分的事……: I should have stuck to what I know best...
……唉，也好啦。我信得过你。: No matter. I know I-I can trust you.
你是个烂好人嘛……: Gullible, yes, but a good soul.
把这东西交给塔妮丝吧。: Make certain that Tanith gets this.
那不是多厉害的东西……\n我只是看那个失去自我的女人不顺眼。: Oh, it's nothing, it's just... Makes me sick to see her all bent out of shape.
想要她恢复自信满满的样子……: C'mon, Tanith, back on your high horse, where you belong.
就拜托你了……: Then I can rest easy, my friend...
……嗯？欸，是你喔？: Hm? Wait, don't tell me, is that you?
投降啦！我说投降啦！: I surrender! I surrender, I swear!
你的耳朵是怎样？我说投降了耶！: Do you even hear me? I said "surrender", loud and clear!
你打算伤害朋友喔？: You'd clobber your old mate, then, would you?
你到底是哪根筋不对啦？: What in the world has gotten into you!
劝你不要看扁我！: Don't go thinking I'm a soft touch!
要我跟你打，我还真百般不情愿咧。: I'd never cross you, not even close.
好久不见了啊。: It's been ages since I've seen you.
我完全误会了说，: I didn't even realise it was you.
唉，这种不幸的误会常有嘛。: You know how it is, just an innocent mistake.
话说开之后，恩怨放水流。\n再多多关照啦。: Water under the bridge, eh, back to business as usual?
抢夺财物这一行，风险真的不小。: This bandit business is hardly what it's cracked up to be...
要是运气差抢到像你这种人，\n完全就会赔了夫人又折兵。: Especially if we keep running into the likes of you...
也许该和他们再开始做生意吧……: ...Maybe I'll set up another shop with the lads...
帕奇商店重新开幕。: For the grand reopening of Patches' Emporium.
……哦，是酒啊？看起来挺赞的。: Booze, eh? Good stuff, by the look of it.
我家的祖母最常讲：“免费的东西最贵”。: As my dear nan used to say, "there's no such thing as a free lunch"...
痛死啦！你干么啦！: What are you playing at? That bloody well hurts!
……我就知道迟早会这样，: Well... It was bound to happen some day...
不听人话，小心惹人嫌啊……: Try not to be so slow on the uptake, eh.
不要脸的小偷，活该遭天谴啊……: There's a special circle, for rotten thieves like you.
……你好像有在反省嘛。: Well, it looks like you've seen the error of your ways.
那就当作没发生吧。: Water under the bridge. Am I wrong?
……跪得真标准啊。: Okay, I can see you mean it.
事情就当作没发生吧。: Consider it water under the bridge.
拜托您，请听我说。: Might I bend your ear for a moment, please.
我的名字是伊蕾娜，\n是从南方的摩恩城逃出来的。: My name is Irina. I've escaped from Castle Morne, to the south.
我生来眼睛不方便，没办法全盘了解发生什么事，: I-I can't be sure what it is; my eyesight's been weak since birth you see...
但是我听到恐怖的嘶吼声从四方传来。: But I swear I heard frightful howling from all over.
父亲让我逃了出来……: My good father secreted me out the castle,
但是他还留在那座城里面，\n认为那是掌权者应尽的职责。: but decided himself to stay. He says it's his duty, as commander.
……说不定那些仆人还在附近徘徊，: I fear some of the castle's servants are still prowling nearby.
请您一路小心，\n希望您在旅途的终点能如愿以偿。: Do take care on the road. I pray your journey comes to fruition.
……还有如果您改变心意了，: And if you happen to change your mind...
请再和我说一声。: Please come to see me again.
难道是刚才那位吗？: Ah, you're the one from before, aren't you?
能不能把这封信交给留在城里的父亲？: Would you mind taking a letter to my father, at the castle?
就算会背负弃城懦夫的骂名，\n我也希望父亲离开那座城。:
My sole wish is that he escape,
even if his honour should be the price.
拜托您，请交给留在城里的父亲。: Deliver it to my father, who remains in the castle, if you please.
拜托您了，请把那封信交给留在城里的父亲。: Please, if you wouldn't mind. Deliver the letter to my father at the castle.
他的个性顽固，但看过信之后一定会改变心意。: He can be stubborn, but I'm sure he'll come around.
仆人非常愤怒，恨着我们所有人，: The servants are full wroth. Filled with hatred for every one of us.
那些一起逃出来的人都受他们攻击……全部消失了。:
They've since come for every one of the companions I escaped with.
They haven't spared a soul.
摩恩城会不会也是同样情况……: I fear it's no different at Castle Morne...
能不能把这封信交给留在城里的父亲呢？: Would you mind taking a letter to my father, at the castle?
初次见面，您好。我的名字是海妲，\n正为了找寻彼岸灯火而旅行。: My name is Hyetta, and I'm journeying in search of the distant light.
在此，我有一个不情之请……: If I might be so bold as to ask...
如果您有夏玻利利葡萄，能不能请您让给我呢？: Would you donate any Shabriri grapes in your possession to me?
我自出生眼睛就不方便，看不清该何去何从，:
My eyesight has been weak since birth, you see.
I can't tell which way I'm supposed to go next.
但只要吃了那葡萄，\n就能从眼睛深处感觉到彼岸灯火。:
But when I eat one of those grapes, I can feel a distant light
in the back of my eyes.
朝着灯火前进，成为指头女巫──就是我的使命。: It will lead me, to my true duty, as a Finger Maiden.
我正为了找寻彼岸灯火而旅行。: I'm on a pilgrimage in search of the distant light.
只要吃了那葡萄，\n就能从眼睛深处感觉到它。:
And when I eat one of those grapes, I can feel the light
in the back of my eyes.
这么一来，我就能再次感受到彼岸灯火了。: Now I can feel the distant light once more.
愿您也有指头的庇护。: May the blessing of the Fingers be upon you.
……您真的很特别。: You're not like the others who give me grapes, are you...
其他给我葡萄的人，\n每个人都颤抖着手碰触我，: They rest their trembling hands upon me.
一边发出不成话语的嘶喊，\n一边轻轻地摸过我的眼睛。: Howling wordlessly, they gently stroke my eyes.
那些非常干瘦的手给了我葡萄。: Their frail fingers, emaciated... Yet still, they give me the grapes.
话说回来，夏玻利利葡萄到底是什么模样呢？: That aside, I wonder what Shabriri grapes really are?
咬起来粘稠又柔软，甘甜又有些烫口……: Delectably tender and sweet, yet searing...
那肯定是很美丽的果实吧？: What a sight they must be to behold.
……可是那代表……大家……: Not all of those people... Their own...
那声音……: So those noises I heard were...
……您让我察觉了很棒的事情：: I've gleaned something very important indeed, thanks to you.
葡萄等同眼眸，以及我吃下它有什么意义。: The reason why it was eyes I had to eat.
彼岸灯火距离遥远，火光细小。: The distant light is far and frail.
所以单靠一个人的眼眸，实在无法分辨。: So faint it can't be seen by the naked eye.
……将大家的眼眸集中起来，就能感觉到它了。: But with everyone's eyes together, it appears.
我一定能够成为指头女巫。: I'm certain now. I will be a Finger Maiden.
……夏玻利利葡萄到底是什么模样呢？: I wonder, what are Shabriri grapes?
……不好意思，您特意告诉我，我还这种反应。: I apologise. You only did as I asked.
已经没事了，请您不必挂心……: I'll be fine. Think no more of it.
……您让我察觉了很棒的事情。: I've gleaned something very important indeed, thanks to you.
您知道指痕葡萄吗？: Have you ever heard of fingerprint grapes?
那是只长在烧伤手指抓过的生物身上，\n很特殊的葡萄……:
They're special grapes which only grow on those
who've been clasped by the burnt Fingers...
我想要尝尝那种葡萄。: I would truly love to try one...
彼岸灯火已经比之前更加靠近了，: The distant light seems far closer than before,
但是以普通的葡萄，我感觉不到任何改变。: But I can't sense a thing from the usual grapes anymore...
拜托您，请将指痕葡萄带来给我。: Please, could you donate a fingerprint grape to me?
如果吃不到那葡萄，啊啊，我好像就快发疯了。: Without one I don't know, I feel like I might go mad.
指痕葡萄、指痕葡萄，这个就是，对吧？: A fingerprint grape, tried and true, what a wondrous thing! A fingerprint grape!
……啊，多么地甘甜，多么地烫口呀……: Ohh, how sweet, yet, how it burns...
……谢谢您。我的心总算平静下来了。: Thank you. I've composed myself again.
可以拜托您一件事情吗？: ...Might I ask a boon of you?
我想把这件物品托付给您。: Look after this for me, if you please.
它跟着我似乎有一阵子了，\n但我不知道属于谁，想找出它的所有人。:
It's been so long, I don't know how I came upon it,
but I've been looking for its owner.
只是我一直找不到。\n在成为女巫之后，就没办法一边旅行，一边寻找了。: Now I'm to be a Maiden though, it'll never find its way home.
所以我想要把它交给您。: Which is why I'd like you to have it.
这肯定是很重要的物品……: It must be very, very precious indeed.
我一定会成为指头女巫。: I'm sure I'll be a Finger Maiden.
……噢，您也抵达这里了。: Ah, so you're here as well, are you?
我是女巫，而您一定会成为王。: I'll be a Maiden, and you... Surely, a Lord.
请卸下一切，往前方的门前进。: Go to the door ahead, after divesting yourself of your possessions.
门一定会为您而开，您也会见到叁指大人。: It will surely open, and the Three Fingers will welcome you.
……愿浑沌火焰能深植于您。: May the flame of chaos find purchase within you.
……啊，浑沌火焰深植您的体内了。: Ahh, the flame of chaos has nestled within you.
可以请您碰触我吗？: Could you please rest your hand upon me?
请用那火焰燃烧我，让我成为您的女巫……: Burn me with the flame, to make me your maiden...
我的眼睛、我的眼睛要熔化了。: My eyes, my eyes, they're melting...
……我感应到叁指大人的话了。: I have touched them. The words of the Three Fingers.
身为您的女巫，请让我转达。: As your maiden, allow me to divine them.
“……万事始于巨大的一，由一产生区别。”: All that there is came from the One Great.
“产生区别后，生命诞生，也拥有了心智。”: Then came fractures, and births, and souls.
“然而这就是无上意志犯下的错误。”: But the Greater Will made a mistake.
“痛苦、绝望、诅咒──所有的罪恶与苦痛，”: Torment, despair, affliction. Every sin, every curse.
“全是由‘错误’而生。”: Every one, born of the mistake.
“所以我们必须重回起点──”: And so, what was borrowed must be returned.
“用浑沌的黄色火焰熔化一切，”: Melt it all away, with the yellow chaos flame.
……那些给我葡萄的人，\n虽然不成话语，但所有人在嘶喊。: Those who gave me grapes howled without words.
说着：自己不是自愿诞生世上。: Saying they wished they were never born.
成为痛苦、绝望、诅咒，所有的罪恶与苦痛──: Take their torment, despair. Their affliction. Every sin, every curse.
都能熔化消失的，浑沌之王……: And melt it all away. As the Lord of Chaos.
让所有人不再有区别，不再诞生……: No more fractures. No more birth...
我不想伤害任何人。: I do not wish to cause anyone harm.
……哦，我没见过你。: Ah, there's a face I've not seen before.
我是艾德格。\n奉葛瑞克大人之命，固守这座城……: I'm Edgar, warden of this castle as ordained by Lord Godrick himself.
但你也见识到现在的窘态。: But you can see how things have turned out.
才以为他们安份工作，没想到只是障眼法。:
They gave me good service, or so I thought,
but it seems it was all an act.
真是名副其实的玷污者，连心也一样污秽。:
Foul creatures, as it's said.
And true enough they're foul inside and out.
即使你有任何请托，摩恩城也无法回应。:
But whatever you've come here to do,
I'm afraid Castle Morne won't hold much longer.
这是表示歉意的薄礼，你收下吧。: Take this, by way of apology.
你没有理由在这里赌上性命。: You've no reason to risk your neck dawdling here, eh.
谢谢你，你照顾了我女儿。: Thank you. I'm in your debt.
即使城已经失守，身为掌权者还是有事得做。: Even if the castle should fall, as commander, I must remain.
那把剑，摩恩的无价之宝，\n绝不能落入玷污者手里……: To ensure the treasured sword of Morne does not fall into the wrong hands.
在你遇到伊蕾娜之后，帮我传话吧：: If you see Irina, do tell her.
等到该尽的责任完了，父亲一定会去接她。: That her father will come for her, once he's fulfilled his duty.
那把剑总算免除落入玷污者手中的命运。: For keeping the sword from those fallen creatures.
……我的责任已了。: I'm no longer bound by duty.
该动身去接伊蕾娜。从今以后，我要为她而活。: Once I've rescued Irina, I will spend my remaining days with her.
承蒙相助，我才有办法去接伊蕾娜。: Thanks to you, I will be reunited with Irina.
从今以后，我要为了女儿而活。: And devote my remaining days to her.
……只是伊蕾娜实在太过善良。: Irina has a gentle nature, though.
希望她没有被意图不轨的人算计。: I only hope it remains intact.
因为我把职责摆在最前头，: I chose duty over my daughter's safety.
才会受到这种报应……: And that is how fate has answered…
那群让你沦落这种下场的畜牲，: The foul wretches responsible for this.
我一定会全找出来，把他们杀得片甲不留……: I'll hunt them down, and exterminate every last one of them.
唉，伊蕾娜啊。为父肯定说到做到……: Rest assured, Irina. It will be done.
我们没有必要交战。: We need not fight, I assure you.
……我不了解你的意图。: I haven't a clue what's got into you,
但我艾德格不会轻饶！: but as Lord of this castle, I will stand for it no longer!
……连你这种分子都混了进来。: And now even your ilk have complicated matters.
你到底图的是什么？: What was the purpose of such folly?
杀害伊蕾娜这档事，你也有份吗！: You had a hand in Irina's undoing!
那孩子做了什么，必须有这种下场！: What could she have done to deserve that?
为父一定会将他们杀得片甲不留。: I will not rest until they are eliminated.
现在就去、接你……: I will join you soon enough…
城门早就关闭了，你从哪里混进来的吶？: How did you slip inside, with the gate closed?
有能耐打赢那群家伙，想必也有资格成为勇士。: If you can fell one of them, you're a champion, in my book.
我叫杰廉，只是个不起眼的老战士……还有见证人。: I am Jerren. Foolish old warrior, and witness.
我问你，你喜欢祭典吗？: Incidentally, do you like a good festival, from time to time?
目前这地方只是座败战军的要塞，: Well, it's true, this fortress houses only the vanquished.
等到天空布满繁星，就会化成祭典的舞台。: But when the stars align, we celebrate.
那是为了凭吊破碎战争中\n最为强大的半神──拉塔恩将军，: A war festival honoring the last battle and death of General Radahn,
纪念他的最后一战，还有继承大卢恩的战斗祭典。: the mightiest demigod of the Shattering, and bearer of a Great Rune.
也是啊，祭典能让战士获得名誉嘛。: As you should. The festival affords glory to warriors.
有兴趣的话，稍待片刻吧。: Then all you need is a little patience.
等到繁星出现，也会带来祭典开始的信号。: When the stars align, the festival will be declared.
哦，你这人还真没趣。: Well, you're not much fun, are you, chum?
算了，也罢。只是时间问题，你迟早会明白──: No matter. One day you will see.
参与祭典才能获得战士的名誉吶。: That true warriors bask in glory at the festival.
现在你哪有事情需要找我？: This old geezer hasn't any use for you just yet.
你迟早会明白──: One day you will see, chum.
哦，这名字真让人怀念吶。: Well, I haven't heard that name in an age.
你隶属菈妮大人吗？: Then you must serve Princess Ranni?
那帮我带话给伊吉吧：: The next time you speak to Iji, tell him this:
拉塔恩的战斗祭典\n肯定能带动菈妮大人的命运。: The festival of Radahn will surely set Ranni's fate back into motion.
……对了，那家伙还在锻造武器吗？: By the by… Is that old fool still hammering out weapons?
看他把巨大的身体缩得小小的，好像很不自在……: His enormous frame, cramped in that little place...
而且还啰唆得很，真是奇怪无比的巨人吶。: Bit of a haughty sort. Strange fella, when I knew him.
嗯，不过啊……他锻造的武器虽然钝到不行，: And funny thing, his swords were all blunt as stone.
但是在对上猩红腐败，却不会受到腐朽侵蚀……: But not one of them decayed when faced with the scarlet rot...
繁星布满天空，祭典的时刻到了！: The stars have aligned! The festival is nigh!
破碎战争中最强大的半神，拉塔恩将军正在等着你们。: General Radahn, mightiest demigod of the Shattering, awaits you!
勇士啊，战斗吧！\n满怀荣誉击败强敌，取得大卢恩吧！: Champions, prepare for battle! Defeat the General, claim glory, and grab that Great Rune!
……好啦，该开始了。: But now, we must make merry.
勇士啊，祭典拉开序幕啦！: O gathering of champions, the revels begin!
从前方的教堂进到要塞底下的海岸吧，\n战场就在那里。: You will find the field of battle past the church ahead, upon the shore under the fort.
拉塔恩将军还留在原地。: General Radahn is there, even now.
……依旧失去神智，啃食尸体。: Divested of his wits, devouring corpses…
等你准备好之后，再和我说一声吶。: When you are ready, come to me again.
……战斗祭典结束了，是吧？: At last, the war festival has ended.
勇士啊，我要对你表示谢意。: Brave champion, you have our gratitude.
这场战斗祭典很不错，将军肯定很满意。: The celebration was spectacular. General Radahn is surely pleased.
比起受腐败侵蚀，陷入发狂与腐朽的境地，\n这结果名誉得多。: Festering with rot, and crippled by madness, all he wanted was an honourable death.
没必要继续留在这座要塞了。: I am no longer bound to this fortress.
我打算出门旅行，: I have a task in mind.
我也有自己的过去吶。: Old business you could say. You wouldn't understand.
有缘再见吧，勇士。: May we meet again, if the fates deign it. Brave champion.
好啦，我要准备出门旅行了。: It's time I went on my way.
没想到会在这里和祭典的勇士相会。: I hardly expected to see the champion of the festival here of all places.
无论如何，这女人已经死了。: Well, whatever the case, she's dead now.
……她是“魔块魔女”──: She was known as the Graven Witch.
沉迷于起源论调，对无数魔法师狠下毒手，: Obsessed by the primeval current, countless sorcerers fell to her hand.
是雷亚卢卡利亚学院有史以来最为棘手的灾难。: The most dangerous mage in the entire history of Raya Lucaria's Academy.
这女人让我感觉，像是没了灵魂的空壳。: The woman, she was like a husk, her soul already fled.
瑟濂的实体可能还幸存，: I suspect Sellen lives on, elsewhere.
未来也许会透过其他身体，再一次现身……: I'm sure she'll turn up eventually, in another body.
真是不吉利，但我忍不住这么想。: A sickening thought, but one that won't stop gnawing at me.
……承蒙拔刀相助，感激不尽。: My thanks, for the aid given.
我有听伊吉提起，\n说菈妮大人可能遇见了英雄，: I heard from Iji that Lady Ranni might have found herself a champion.
没想到那个人就是你吶。: But I didn't know he was talking about you.
……有了你的帮忙，\n我才得以实现以前的约定。: You've helped me fulfil an old promise.
这是聊表谢意的薄礼，拿着吧。: This is the least I can do for you. Please, take it.
祭典的勇士果然不是省油的灯。: Always a pleasure to witness the festival champ put on a display.
……褪色者啊，承蒙拔刀相助，感激不尽。: My thanks, Tarnished, for the aid given.
……好啦，我要准备动身了。: Well, I must be leaving now.
勇士啊，有缘……: Brave warrior, if the fates deign it...
不对，在下一次的盛大祭典再会吧。: No, we shall indeed meet again, at the next glorious tourney.
有缘再见吧，褪色者。: If the fates deign it, may we meet again, Tarnished.
既然一心向着魔女，迟早也会是卡利亚的敌人。: If the Graven Witch put you under her spell, you must be eliminated...
趁早斩除祸根吧。: Before you can pose a threat to Caria.
……陪着魔女的身体一起安眠吧……: Rest now. Alongside the witch's corpse.
……“魔块魔女”瑟濂，卡利亚的敌对者啊。: Sellen, Graven Witch, enemy of Caria.
这一次，我会连同源辉石一起粉碎。: I vow this time to crush both your frame and your primal glintstone.
牢牢记住──我杰廉的存在，就代表你的死亡。: I am Jerren, bringer of your death. Do not forget.
这附近有一点冷呢。: It's rather chilly here, isn't it?
我奉主人的命令，出外旅行……: My mistress sent me off on an errand...
但是受到流氓攻击，正在发愁。: But I was accosted by a ruffian, and now I'm in a bind.
……我能不能拜托您一件事？: Could I ask you lend a hand, perhaps?
刚才说的流氓，他拿走了我重要的项链，\n想请您帮忙拿回来。: That thug made off with a precious necklace. I need someone to retrieve it.
当然，我会给出应有的谢礼。: I would be sure to provide ample reward.
如果您不愿与同胞战斗，我也不会勉强……: If you've any qualms confronting your own, I shall find another...
我很庆幸能遇见您。: What a blessing that we've met like this.
……那位流氓可能在前面的空屋休息。: The thug should be resting at an abandoned home down the way...
拜托了，请帮我把项链拿回来。: Please, I must have the necklace back.
……这样啊。虽然遗憾，但也只能接受。: Yes, I see. Most unfortunate, but I'll have to make do.
我想也是有人不愿与同胞战斗。: I know that some Tarnished balk at the thought of harming their own.
如果您改变想法了，请再告诉我。: But if you should change your mind, do not hesitate to speak to me again.
您改变想法了吗？: Have you had a change of heart?
对，这的确是我被抢走的项链。: Oh, yes, that is my missing necklace.
谢谢，您是我的恩人。: Thank you kindly. I am in your debt.
……我还没有自我介绍吧？: Did I forget to announce myself?
我是菈雅，侍奉火山官邸的主人，塔妮丝大人。: I am Rya, in the service of Lady Tanith of the Volcano Manor.
邀请拥有英雄资质的褪色者前往官邸，\n是我身为招募者的职责。: I seek stalwart Tarnished who might join our house.
……您很强，这不单指擅长战斗，: You are very brave yourself. Not only a steady hand,
您还拥有强韧的心，勇于和同胞刀剑相向。: but a steady heart, merciless, even to your own kind.
我的主人渴求的，就是这些特质。: Such strength is precisely what my mistress seeks.
……拥有英雄资质的褪色者啊，\n请您朝着黄金树大地的亚坛高原前进。: Brave Tarnished, seek the Altus Plateau, the realm of the Erdtree.
受到赐福引导，却只能在交界地边陲徘徊，\n眺望远方的黄金树……: Most Tarnished are doomed to wander the outskirts of the Lands Between, peering wistfully at the towering Erdtree...
您绝对不是这种凡夫俗子。\n只要您的强大获得证实，: But you are no ordinary Tarnished. And once that is proven,
火山官邸肯定会正式邀请您，\n成为并肩作战的英雄──成为族人。: the Volcano Manor will fully extend its invitation. To fight, amongst a family of champions.
……对了，还有……我个人想要告诉您一件事。: Ohh, and... One more thing, only for you...
这个地方，利耶尼亚地区原本和亚坛高原，\n能透过街道尽头的迪可达斯大升降机往来，: This land of Liurnia is connected to the Altus Plateau by the Grand Lift of Dectus, beyond the High Road.
但是大升降机已经很久没有运转，\n道路也早就年久失修。: But the lift has been defunct for an age, meaning there's no simple means of passage.
……所以，请先去找出古遗迹断崖吧。: Instead, you must seek the old ruins in the cliff.
那座古遗迹位在大升降机旁的谷底，\n是一座古老的坑道……: At the base of the valley near the Grand Lift, there's an old tunnel.
听说是从利耶尼亚与亚坛高原，\n两个方向共同开采而成的坑道。: It was excavated from both ends, linking Liurnia to the Altus Plateau.
……您一定会是英雄，我相信您。: I have faith in you. A champion, through and through.
期待下次与您相见。: I do hope that we can meet again.
果然和我说得一样，您就是英雄。: I knew you had the stuff of champions.
我想正式邀请您前往火山官邸。: I hereby invite you to the Volcano Manor.
请牵住我的手，会见我的主人吧。: Take my hand, and have audience with my mistress.
那么在您准备好之后，请告诉我。: Speak to me again once you are ready.
那么，我想正式邀请您前往火山官邸。: I hereby invite you to the Volcano Manor.
……但是我对他的印象，实在算不上太好。: But I hardly hold him in high regard.
我感觉得到，那个人的心中有着对火山官邸的敌意，: He seems to bear animosity toward the Volcano Manor.
还有就是，我时不时会感觉到……: Perhaps it is to be expected, only...
那敌意带有英勇的意念，\n却又有股淡淡的，犹疑不定的味道。: his intent, while vicious, is also tenuous, as if his heart is not in it.
这样的人有资格称为英雄吗……？: Doesn't really seem like champion material, to me...
……褪色者大人，您怎么会在这里？: Brave Tarnished, what is your business here?
各位的房间不是在这个方向……: I'm afraid this is not a guest room.
……为什么您的表情那么诧异？: What's that peculiar look upon your face?
不会吧，我还维持着蛇的模样吗？: Goodness, am I still a serpent?
即使看到我的模样，\n您待我依旧温暖，我太失礼了。: I ought to be thanking you for treating me as usual, despite this appearance.
这才是我真正的模样。\n我真正的名字是泽菈雅丝。: This is my true form. My real name is Zorayas.
但是请您相信我，虚假的只有我本身。: Do understand. This duplicity is my own doing.
关于火山官邸，不对，不只这样，\n还有塔妮丝大人说的一字一句，这些绝无虚假。: Lady Tanith speaks no falsehoods, and the Volcano Manor is just as it seems.
据说母亲受到伟大王者的恩宠，我因此诞生。: I am told I was born by the grace of a glorious king.
所以我这身模样，也是母亲喜悦的象征。: That my mother cherishes this form I inhabit.
……这模样是我的荣耀。: I am proud of what I am.
然而并不是所有人都这么认为──\n如果展现蛇的模样，他们就不愿再听我说话。: But people are cruel. If they saw my true form, they wouldn't speak to me.
所以我才会伪装真面目，好善尽招募者的职责。: And so I assume a guise when seeking new recruits.
……但是您和他们不一样呢。: But you are not like the rest.
……这身蛇的模样，还有泽菈雅丝这个名字，: My serpentine form, and the name Zorayas,
是我和塔妮丝大人之间的秘密。: were secrets known only to Lady Tanith and I.
……现在您也共享了这个秘密。: Now I share the secrets with you, as well.
这件事，请不要向他人张扬。: Please keep them safe from anyone else.
……请先去找出古遗迹断崖。: Seek the old ruins in the cliff.
能够在火山官邸与您相会，身为招募者喜不自胜。: As a scout, I am pleased to see you again here at the Volcano Manor.
请您与塔妮丝大人同行，走在英雄的路上。: Under Lady Tanith's guidance, may you tread the path of valour.
您在这座官邸里，有没有听过奇怪的声音？: heard any strange sounds here at the manor?
那声音从墙壁另一侧传来，\n还有类似呼吸声、鳞片摩擦的声音？: Something beyond the walls, like breathing, or slithering scales...
……抱歉，问了这么奇怪的问题。: Oh fie, what am I saying?
怎么可能有这种事，应该是我太累了吧。: It just isn't possible. I must be tired.
不好意思，我正在想事情。: Forgive me. My mind never ceases to churn of late.
还是和您说吧。: I know I can trust you...
我在晚上的时候，看到走廊上有蠕动的黑影……: I saw something, slithering in the pitch black of night.
那黑影走进对面的房间之后，就没有出来了。: It entered the room across the hall, and never came out.
那黑影有着蛇的轮廓，和我一样。: it took the form of a serpent, just like me...
……火山官邸有着我不知道的秘密……: Does the Volcano Manor hide some secret,
塔妮丝大人到底对我隐瞒了什么？: that Lady Tanith has kept from me?
……这件事情本来不该请求您，: I realise that I shouldn't impose but,
但如果您有任何发现，能不能告诉我？: if you discover anything, would you please share?
那黑影走进隔壁的房间之后，就没有出来了。: It entered the room next to this one, and never came out.
……那天夜里出现的蛇形黑影……: The serpent that lurked in the shadows that night...
走进对面的房间之后就没有出来。: It entered the room across the hall, and never came out.
……火山官邸可能有着我不知道的秘密。: Perhaps the manor yet holds some secrets.
如果您有任何发现，能不能告诉我？: If you discover anything, would you please share?
走进隔壁的房间之后就没有出来。: It entered the room next to this one, and never came out.
果真有秘密啊……: Oh, so there was a secret after all...
塔妮丝大人──母亲她对我说了谎……: Lady Tanith, my own mother, has deceived me...
因为母亲受到恩宠而诞生的吗？: born by the grace of a king?
无法亲自邀请您前来火山官邸，虽然略感遗憾……: It is a shame that I did not beckon you here with my own hand,
但能够在此与您相会，我依旧喜不自胜。: but I am pleased that we meet again, here at the Volcano Manor.
您还记得吗？我是菈雅。\n我们曾经在利耶尼亚交谈过一次。: Do you remember me? I am Rya. We spoke once in Liurnia.
能够在火山官邸与您相会，实在喜不自胜。: I am pleased that we meet again, here at the Volcano Manor.
褪色者大人，初次见面，您好。: A pleasure to meet you. Brave Tarnished.
我是“招募者”菈雅。\n能够在火山官邸见到您，我深感荣幸。: I am Rya, the scout. Very pleased to welcome you to the Volcano Manor.
我曾经听过墙壁另一侧传来奇怪的声音。: Sometimes I hear strange sounds beyond the walls.
……应该是我太累了吧。: Oh, perhaps I'm just feeling tired.
我明白了，这是我出生的地方……: I am certain of it. I was born inside this.
是生母的一部分。: It's a part of my birth mother.
多亏有您的帮忙，我终于下定决心。: Thanks to you, I am no longer afraid.
我想知道自己的出身，\n也想知道是如何与塔妮丝大人相遇。: I want to know. How I was born, and met Lady Tanith.
……还有，我想要打从心底，\n再一次称呼那位大人“母亲”。: One day, I hope to call her mother once again, this time from the bottom of my heart.

很久没有遇见志同道合的人了……: It's been far too long since I found a fellow kindred spirit.

……他以前是位优秀的魔法剑士。: He was a formidable spellblade, in times past.
天资聪颖，看似一派从容，\n但意志坚定，不会受外力影响。: Don't let his easy air deceive you. He was wise beyond his years, stout of heart and clear of mind.
被玷污荆棘贯穿，不停讲些没用的废话──: You see him now, ravaged by thorns, muttering and rambling...
不堪入目，犹如半具尸体的东西。: Like he's half dead already. I can't stomach to watch.
那就是受死诞者魅惑的下场。: That's how you end up, when seduced by Those Who Live in Death.
当引导受到玷污，必会侵蚀人……毁了人。: When grace is sullied, it rots people from the inside. Breaks them.
你怎么拿到那把短剑的？: How did you get your hands on that dagger?
我熟识那把短剑的主人，: I know very well whose dagger it is.
由我代为归还吧？: Why don't I return it to them for you?
……辛苦你了……: Good work, bringing this to me.
还是说，你这么想平白送命？: Unless you want to die like a dog?
……褪色者里的无聊之辈也多了不少……: I swear, there's a blight spreading amongst the Tarnished.
玷污黄金律法之辈，我要替哥哥报仇！: A defiler of the Golden Order, and murderer of my brother!
我要把你的尸体刺进那骯脏娼妓的尸块里。: I'll grind your corpse into that vile wench's rotting remains.
这样就能永远被它抱在怀里了！\n不是你梦寐以求的吗！: A witch's eternal embrace, just as you wished!
……玷污者，这就是我哥哥带来的报应！: You defiled cretin. My brother is now avenged!
和我一起来到交界地，为我而战的那些人……: Everyone who came with me. They crossed the sea for me. They fought, for me.
手、脚、头全部被砍断，变成蜘蛛的一部分了。:
Only to have their arms taken. Their legs taken. Even their heads...taken.
Taken and stuck to the spider.
你知道吗？被接到蜘蛛身上之后，\n人就会长得像是虫蛹喔。: Did you know? If you're grafted by the spider, you become a chrysalid.
真的很奇妙，对不对？: It's quite the lark, when you think about it.
你一个人行动吗？: You're all on your own, are you?
是因为听信那位白面具先生的好听话？\n还是说，你想要变成蜘蛛的一部分呢？: Enticed by the one in the white mask, I suppose. Oh, you've come to be one with the spider?
如果是的话，那就和我一样了。: Well, that makes us two peas in a pod.
可是我没有勇气──: But I don't have your courage.
要被砍断手脚、砍断头，太可怕了。: It's scary, you know. Having your arms cut off. Or legs. Or your head.
我很想和大家变得一样，但实在怕得不得了。: I want to be like everyone else, but I'm just too scared.
能请你带着这孩子一起旅行吗？: Can you take this little one along with you?
能请你带着这些孩子一起旅行吗？: Can you take these little ones along with you?
要他陪着这么懦弱的我，太可怜了……: The poor thing deserves someone braver than myself…
我想这孩子也会很开心。: It'll be glad of your company, I think, the little'un.
我想这些孩子也会很开心。: They'd be glad of your company, I think, the little'uns.
要他们陪着这么懦弱的我，太可怜了……: The poor things deserve someone braver than myself…
那么，请多保重。: It was a pleasure to see you.
如果你准备前往史东薇尔城，\n请帮忙转达给成为虫蛹的大家：: Oh, can you pass on a message for me, if you see the little chrysalids in Stormveil Castle?
……我终于比较不怕痛了。: I'm finally getting the hang of this whole "pain" thing, you know.
你帮我转达给大家了吗？: Did you give the little chrysalids the message?
即使现在什么事都办不到，\n还是相信在未来，我能够成就些什么。: They all thought I'd make something of myself. Me! Who can't do anything...
……我想前往圆桌厅堂。: I think I'll head to the Roundtable Hold.
去找出自己能做些什么。: Perhaps I'll find my purpose there.
好久不见了。: Greetings. Nice to see you again.
我叫罗德莉卡。\n抱歉，这么晚才告诉你名字。: My name is Roderika. I should have told you sooner.
既是双指的藏身处，\n也是想当上王的英雄群集的地方……: The Roundtable Hold, covert quarters of the Two Fingers, and gathering place of champions who vie to become Elden Lord.
真没想到褪色者的指引，背后竟然充满着奥秘。: I never knew the guidance bestowed upon us Tarnished had such fantastic roots.
……只是对我而言，\n圆桌厅堂的指引过于伟大。: Although, it's all a bit much for me, in truth.
我想找找其他自己能做的事。: I'm still looking for my own purpose.
……我有那方面的潜力吗？: You're telling me I possess some kind of gift?
……如果是真的，就算我不够优秀，: If I do have this talent, and goodness knows it would be my first...
我也想去学习，想去磨练。: I suppose I should try to hone it. Shouldn't I?
……我想请修古先生指导我。: I'll ask Master Hewg to teach me.
那位先生外表恐怖，被束缚在圆桌厅堂，\n厌恶我们褪色者。: Certainly, he does appear intimidating, and holds no love for us Tarnished...
会被讨厌是理所当然，但是……: But I know he's trapped here, at the Roundtable Hold... So...
我却认为，那位先生其实非常温柔。: I can tell. He's a gentle soul, underneath it all.
请让我向你道谢。: Please, allow to me to express my thanks.
如果你没有将大家的遗物转交给我，: For giving me that keepsake from my men.
我肯定会一直坐在原地，自怨自艾，\n继续背叛大家的期待。: It was as if I was frozen with self-pity. I failed them at every turn.
我很感谢你，请收下这个。: You have my gratitude. Please, take this.
我叫罗德莉卡，刚来到这里。: My name is Roderika. I'm a recent arrival.
对我而言，圆桌厅堂的指引过于伟大。: It's all a bit much for me, in truth.
……我还在寻找自己能做的事。: I'm still looking for my own purpose.
这没有办法马上找到。\n但我想，这是目前的我该做的事情。: It's not easy, by any means, but it's what I must do.
……如果我真的有调灵的潜力，\n即使不够优秀也好。: If I do have a talent for spirit tuning, and goodness knows that would be a surprise…
……我再去请修古先生指导我。: I'll ask Master Hewg to teach me.
啊，谢谢你。: Good to see you again. Thank you very much!
你替我说服修古先生了，对吧？: I have you to thank, don't I? For persuading Master Hewg?
多亏如此，修古先生愿意教导我\n关于调灵的学问。: I can happily announce that he has taught me the noble toil of spirit tuning.
……我还不知道自己能走得多远，: I'm as yet unsure of what I might be able to accomplish,
但只要一想到自己能尽棉薄之力帮助你们，: but if I might be any help to you all, I'd certainly like to try.
也能慰藉被“接肢”的大家──: And if there's any chance to ease the suffering of my dear men who were grafted...
调灵实习生罗德莉卡，今后请多多指教。: Roderika the spirit tuner prentice. Pleased to make your acquaintance.
要委托调灵吗？: Are you here for spirit tuning?
这阵子，我开始熟悉调灵的工作了──: I feel like I'm really coming to grips with spirit tuning of late.
灵魂具有的不死特质，在律法之下会是如何运作，: I can see how and why immortal essence exists as spirit under the Golden Order.
而他们渴望着什么，以及会被什么吸引。: I can understand their yearnings, what they become drawn to...
……修古先生说了，我已经不算实习生了。: Master Hewg said it himself, actually, that I'm no mere prentice any longer.
那么，调灵师罗德莉卡，再请你多多关照了。: Once again, I'm pleased to make your acquaintance. Roderika the certified spirit tuner.
……我可以拜托你一件事吗？: I'd like to ask you a small favour.
我想请你带着这孩子一起旅行。: Can you take this little one along with you?
我想请你带着这些孩子一起旅行。: Can you take these little ones along with you?
……有件事情，我想和你说一声。: I need to warn you about something.
在不久以前，隔着圆桌的另一侧，\n更往里面走的地方，好像有人来了。: A little while ago someone started lurking in the wing on the opposite side of the roundtable.
……即使隔了这么远的距离，我还是能听到──: And I can hear, from all the way over there...
那群灵魂为数众多，声音也不曾停息。: A plethora of spirits in an unceasing cacophony...
我实在无法想象──会有这种情况，\n到底是什么样的人，做了什么样的事情？: I can't even imagine. How much suffering, inflicted to who knows how many souls...
……即使做出“接肢”恶行，也不会如此。: Not even the grafting caused anything like this to happen...
就算你很强大，也不该贸然接近。: I know you're strong, but please...
……我听到声音，从圆桌的另一侧\n更往里面走的地方传来。: I can hear it from across the wing, past the roundtable...
之前和你提过的，灵魂害怕诅咒发出的声音，\n现在已经听不见了。: I can't hear them any more; the voices of the spirits cowering from the curse...
食粪者先生已经离开圆桌厅堂了吗？: I suppose the Dung Eater must have left the Roundtable.
希望不会再有坏事发生……: I just pray nothing ill comes of this.
……请多加小心。: Be on your guard, I beg you.
那位食粪者先生，好像又回来了。: He's back. The Dung Eater. Again.
我能听见，灵魂发出的悲叹、哭喊，害怕诅咒的声音。: I can hear them; the spirits as they howl and lament in fear of the curse.
还能感觉到那恐怖、疯狂的诅咒，又增强了几分。: And worse than ever, the reverberations of the twisted malison itself.
……只是听着听着，我也感觉到了──: But after all this time, I've started to grasp it now.
那诅咒是一种无法撼动的律法。: I can hear, in the malison, another fearsome Order.
……现在又听不见灵魂害怕诅咒的声音了。: The voices of the tormented spirits are silent again...
但是这一次和上一次的情况不同，: But it isn't like last time.
我觉得灵魂一定是摆脱禁锢，逃出来了。: I'm almost certain...the spirits have escaped their confinement.
是不是你从中助了一臂之力呢？: Did you...have anything to do with it, I wonder?
……请看，祝融肆虐，圆桌厅堂就快烧毁。: Take a look around. The Roundtable Hold is burned. Razed to the ground.
双指陷入疯狂，褪色者的大家都已经离开，: The Two Fingers went mad, and the Tarnished have all left.
只剩我和修古先生留下来。: Myself and Master Hewg are the only ones who remain.
……我没有指责你的意思。: Don't worry, I don't blame you.
调灵的工作，我也会继续做──: I'll continue spirit tuning just the same as before.
但是可以拜托你，劝劝修古先生吗？: Which is why I need your help persuading Master Hewg to leave.
他与圆桌厅堂之间的缘分太深，: His roots are so knotted in this place.
再继续留在这里，\n会跟着圆桌厅堂一起陪葬的。: He won't last much longer if he stays here...
……修古先生的俘虏枷锁已经损毁，\n他早已获得自由。: His shackles are broken. He's a free man, now.
我希望他离开圆桌厅堂。: It's high time he put the Roundtable behind him.
我知道了，想要委托调灵，是吗？: I see. You're here for some spirit tuning?
即使由你开口，修古先生还是这么坚持。: So Master Hewg won't listen to you, either.
我再去说服他看看。: I'll try and talk him round next time.
……关于弒神武器，: I know he was given this great entreaty;
修古先生一直挂念着那件事，\n我觉得那就像是个诅咒──: To craft a weapon which could slay a god. Though I can't help but think of it as a curse.
玛莉卡女王施加的恐怖诅咒。: A fearsome curse, put on him by Queen Marika.
真是如此，我们有任何对抗的手段吗？: And if that's the case, I'm not sure there's anything we can do...
……唉，果然不只有我。: Ah. So it wasn't just me this happened to...
修古先生连你都忘了，: To think he'd forget who you were, as well.
真的已经回天乏术了……: I knew he'd burn himself out, old Hewg.
现在就有可能说服他离开圆桌厅堂……: I think we could talk him into leaving the Roundtable Hold, now.
但我决定放弃了。: But maybe it's better that we don't.
因为不离开，是出自修古先生的选择。: It's only proper that we respect his choice to stay.
修古先生让我的生命有了意义，: He made me who I am today.
所以轮到我回报他了。\n即使力量绵薄，我也想要帮助他。: I'd like to return the kindness, in whatever small way I can.
修古先生总是挂在嘴上，说你才是他的王。: Hewg was always saying that you were a Lord, to him.
还有，请你用修古先生锻造的武器杀害神祇吧。: So slay her, with the weapons he smithed.
杀害那诅咒我们的玛莉卡女王。: Slay the god, Marika, who cursed us all.
但我已经不是小孩子了，会挑战喝喝看。: I'm no longer a child. It's about time I took this step.
你想把我变成虫蛹吗？: You're willing to make me a chrysalid?
唉，但我太过胆小、懦弱，: Ah, but I'm still a milksop craven...
没有勇气踏出这层防护障壁。: I can't even govern myself to step beyond the bounds of this ward...
所以，请你放弃吧。: Please. You're only wasting your strength.
我了解你的想法，: I know how you must feel.
难道说，你的心里很害怕吗？: Or are you like me? You're so far out of your mind with fear...
所以才会表现得如此疯狂？: You've divested yourself of all reason?
这么做也不会冲淡你的恐惧。: Even if you persist, your fear will not abate.
任何能帮助我──肯尼斯·海德的人啊！: Someone who might be interested in rescuing the great Kenneth Haight?
志愿屏除不合理，维护正当秩序的人啊！: Servant to the true Order, and celebrated repudiator of the false!
……你还在这里做什么？: What are you waiting for? A kiss goodbye?
快点往南走，穿过雾林，夺回我的要塞。: My fort lies to the south, beyond the Mistwood. Take it back for me.
……啊，原来如此。你想问报酬吧？: Oh I see. You wish to know the reward?
别小看我肯尼斯·海德，打赏我绝不吝啬。: Fret not, the great Kenneth Haight is known for his considerable largesse.
只要确实夺回要塞，肯定大大有赏。: The celebrations will be lavish indeed, upon the dawn of my fort's retrieval.
啊，对，给你一个建议。: Hmph, yes, now allow me to furnish you with a little advice.
最好小心葛瑞克的褪色者猎人。: I would take great care to avoid Godrick's Tarnished hunts, were I in your shoes.
那群家伙一心想抓到你们褪色者，\n当作恐怖“接肢”的祭品。: That depraved lot are obsessed with sacrificing Tarnished like you for the sake of "grafting".
……只是凭葛瑞克那种格局，\n根本不配挤身君王之流。: Honestly, Godrick's nothing more than a jumped up country bumpkin. Lord? Don't make me laugh.
战败之后混在女人堆里逃出王城，\n忌惮拉塔恩，躲在城里一个气也不敢吭。: First he hid himself amongst the womenfolk to flee the capital, then hid from Radahn in that castle...
小看玛莲妮亚，结果输得落花流水，\n还跪地亲吻她的脚表示服从。: Then he insulted Malenia, lost to her in battle, only to lick her boots rather than die like a man.
实在是软弱无比，不知羞耻的男人。: Has he no shame, the big girl's blouse?
即便出身名门黄金一族，\n也看得出来葛孚雷的血统淡了许多。: And to think, he's the blood of Godfrey! Last of the golden lineage, though you almost wouldn't know it to look at him.
仔细一想，还真是可悲。: I almost feel sorry for the chap the more I think of it.
……哦哦，出现了啊。: Ah, you've come to lend me your aid, have you?
但是，嗯……: Well, that's very kind, but, um...
……不，即便是褪色者，也值得欢迎。: No, no. Th-the help is very much appreciated. Even from a Tarnished.
“不限身分尊贵与否，皆能维护正当秩序。”: Despite appearances, nobility is no prerequisite to serving the true Order.
我名为肯尼斯·海德，\n是宁姆格福领主的嫡长子。: You might have heard of me. Kenneth Haight. Next in line as the rightful ruler of Limgrave.
褪色者啊，我有事要你帮忙。: Young Tarnished, I would have a boon of you.
从这里往南走，穿过雾林有一座要塞──\n那是我的要塞，希望你帮忙夺回来。: I want you to take back my fort. It lies to the south, beyond the Mistwood.
都怪史东薇尔派来的骑士长\n实在过于驽钝，竟然会为血痴狂。: A Knight commander from Stormveil took it. A fool, and plumb mad to boot. Simply obsessed with blood!
什么！骑士长已经死了吗！: Remarkable! The Knight Commander, dead. Already!
哈哈！实在天助我也。: A blessing, if ever I chanced upon one.
虽然你意不在领赏，但实在值得嘉许。: I doubt that it was your intention, but the deed is done, and I commend you.
尽管大方收下吧。: Go on, it is yours, for the keeping.
哦哦，是你啊，我等好久了！: Ah-ha! I've been waiting for you with baited breath!
你成功夺回我的要塞了？: Did you manage to recapture my fort?
成功了吗！骑士长死了啊！: Oh excellent news, just wonderful. And the knight's dead to boot!
我的眼光果然够精准。: I knew I was right to trust you!
……好，这是说好的报酬。: Now, here's your reward, as promised.
我要准备回去要塞了。: Right then. Time for me to head to the fort.
该做的事情堆积如山。\n首先，必须重启与亚人之间的交流。: I've much to do. First I'll have to reestablish communication with the demi-humans.
……瞧你一脸狐疑。: What's that look? You don't believe me?
只要身在黄金树之下，\n即便是亚人也会是芳邻。: Well, under the Erdtree, commingling with the demi-humans is made possible.
“那些卑贱的，正当秩序不会屏除在外。”: Even the vulgar shall not be left behind, under the rule of true Order.
这也是宁姆格福的正统政权后代──\n我肯尼斯·海德应尽的使命。: Which is why I, Kenneth Haight, next in line as the rightful ruler of Limgrave, have sworn to uphold it.
你就好好见证一切吧。: Just you watch, my friend. Just you watch.
啊，是你啊。我看时机也成熟了……: Ah, yes. I've been meaning to ask.
有没有意思在我底下工作？: Would you like to enter my service?
我很看好你的能力。: I see bright things in your future, stout warrior.
在我这里工作，学习何谓黄金树之下的正当秩序，: Enter into my service and learn the workings of the Erdtree's true Order.
说不定有一天，赐福也会重回你那对褪色的双眼。: And who knows, perhaps some time down the line, the grace of gold will return to those Tarnished eyes of yours.
你怎么想？在我看来，是个不错的提案。: What say you? A fine accord, is it not?
你果然前途无量。: I knew I saw something in you.
我在要塞等你，: I shall await you at my fort.
届时封你为骑士。: We shall hold the ceremony for your knighting there, I think.
……多么美好的未来。\n名副其实“黄金树赐福我等”啊。: I see great things ahead of us. We are truly by the Erdtree blessed.
你是认真的吗？真是不智。: Such foolishness have I never seen!
……不过，我也能理解，: Well...not that I can't sympathise with your choice.
毕竟幸运从天而降，遇见了当然会踌躇。: Such a miraculous manifestation of felicity is like to startle one such as yourself.
如果你改变心意，随时造访我的要塞。: Should you change your mind, do visit me at my fort.
怎么样？心里的踌躇已经化解了吗？: What is it? Have you put your misgivings to rest?
……是吗？我能理解。: Well...not that I can't sympathise with your choice.
这对你来说真的是天大的幸运。: Such a miraculous manifestation of felicity is like to startle one such as yourself.
没关系，不急一时。: Oh don't fret, there's no hurry.
为什么对女王……为时、已晚……: Why the queen... Now all hope is...
要塞的现况，你也看到了。: I suppose you must have seen it by now, yes, the sorry state of my fort?
……没有王的土地，实在惨不忍睹。: Oh, indeed, it is a foul fate for a land, to be without a ruler.
我必须找到王，但绝非葛瑞克之流，: One must be found, with haste. And not that awful Godrick.
是能将宁姆格福的正统政权托付于他，\n走在正道上的强大王者。: But a true and stalwart Lord of the proper lineage to take the reigns of Limgrave.
……抱歉在你满心期待的时候泼冷水。: I am sorry to have lifted your hopes...
现况如此，我没有资格封你为骑士。: But I haven't the authority to raise you to knighthood as things stand.
我肯尼斯·海德，由衷地向你致歉。: The great Kenneth Haight issues his sincerest apology.
能将宁姆格福的正统政权托付于他，\n走在正道上的强大王者。: For a true and stalwart Lord of the proper lineage to take the reigns of Limgrave.
……啊，是你啊。好久不见。: Ah, nice to see you after so long.
别来无恙？: Safe and sound, I take it, yes? Good.
……没错，我找到王了──: Ah, quite. I have indeed selected a new ruler.
涅斐丽王。她目视正道、强大，\n值得我将宁姆格福的正统政权托付于她。: Lady Nepheli is strong and just. Worthy of the burden of Limgrave's lineage.
我肯尼斯·海德有十二万分的肯定。: Such is the sincere opinion of I, Kenneth Haight, no less.
我将从旁协助涅斐丽王治理这座城，\n随后回到我的要塞。: For the time being, I share command of the castle with my Lady, but I plan on returning to my fort afterwards.
……届时，我会实现先前的承诺──: At which time I can fulfil my old promise.
封你为骑士。: By raising you to the glory of knighthood.
好好期待吧。: I hope it is just as wonderful as you imagine.
不准小看我肯尼斯·海德！: I am Kenneth Haight, and I have seen quite enough!
秩序已经破坏到这种程度了吗……？: I fear for the integrity of the Order...
黄金树啊，为何弃我于不顾……: O Erdtree, why have you forsaken me...?
受赐福指引而来的英雄啊，\n初次见面，幸会。: Greetings, great champion called by grace.
因故栖身在圆桌厅堂。: Circumstances have compelled my stay at the Roundtable Hold.
英雄啊，片刻就好，能否让我抱紧你呢？: Great champion, would you allow me to hold you, but briefly?
希望你能分给我生存的力量与意志力。: Perhaps you might share with me some of your lifely vigour, and your stout-heartedness.
在抱紧英雄之余，我能感受到你的温暖，: Doing so will grant me the warmth of a champion.
也能带给你床帘恩泽。: And you, I am sure, will bear a baldachin's blessing.
……你会不齿这种行为吗？: Do you think it vulgar, perhaps?
但是在我的故乡，这是具有神圣意义的做法。: Where I come from, it is a sacred act.
现在在你体内深处点亮的，是床帘恩泽。: What you felt light up inside you was a baldachin's blessing.
但那非常短暂易逝……: Though it is but a fleeting thing, I am afraid.
在你需要恩泽的时候，请来找我。: Come back to me, should you require another.
不论几次，我都会再抱紧你。: I will take you in my arms as often as you need.
但如果你改变了心意……: But should you change your mind...
难道你改变心意了？: Had a change of heart already?
欢迎你来找我。: I am pleased to see you again.
需要我再抱紧你吗？: Would you like me to hold you, once more?
但是你的恩泽还没有熄灭……: The blessing is still aflame in your breast, dear.
这样还要继续吗？: Would you like to be held, regardless?
……请多保重。: Then good day to you, my dear.
……我在故乡的时候，被称呼为“死眠少女”。: I was known as a Deathbed Companion, where I come from.
在我得到无数英雄的温暖，以及生存的力量之后，: After I received the warmth and lifely vigour from a number of champions,
再与伟人的尸体同床，\n就能让尊贵的生命重回于他──: I lay with the remains of an exalted noble, to grant him another chance at life.
我是为了这个目的而在。: To do so is the purpose of my being.
……但是在让伟人重新获得生命之前，: But before I could bear the noble into new life,
我却因为赐福而觉醒……被赶出故乡。: I was awakened by the guidance of grace, and chased from my birthplace.
即使如此，我还是想当个死眠少女。: Despite all that, I still wish to be a Deathbed Companion.
所以不论几次都好，请让我像这样抱紧你吧。: So please, let me hold you like this, as often as it takes.
你愿意听听我的请求吗？: Might I ask something of you?
我想请你找出这把短剑的主人，再把短剑还给对方。: Could you please find the owner of this dagger, and return it to them?
那是某位大人送给我的礼物，: A certain person gave it to me, as a gift.
但那非常地贵重……\n而且好像是具有纪念价值的物品。: It's a very precious thing. It must have a special place in the owner's heart.
所以我希望能将它物归原主。: So I would like for the original owner to have it back, if you wouldn't mind.
那把交给你的短剑，\n可以帮我找出它的主人，物归原主吗？: I'd like you to find the owner of the dagger I gave you, and return it to them.
那非常地贵重……\n而且好像是具有纪念价值的物品。: It's a very precious thing. It must have a special place in the owner's heart.
你知道什么是黑刀烙印吗？: Have you ever heard of black knifeprints?
那些动手暗杀的刺客持有的黑刀，: The black knives wielded by the assassins who committed the act,
上头肯定藏有烙印，还有阴谋背后的真相。: along with the impressions they made, somehow hide the truth of the conspiracy.
……太过复杂的事情，我也是听得一知半解，: These grand affairs are hardly my forté...
但罗杰尔先生那时说着说着，就哭出来了。: But dear Rogier began to weep as he spoke...
……你帮了罗杰尔先生，对不对？: I heard that you lent a hand to dear Rogier.
罗杰尔先生的心中，肯定有坚强的意志。: He must be possessed of great mental fortitude.
所以即使身体伤痕累累，\n还是有办法贯彻自己的信念。: It anchors his will, and sustains him, despite his grievous wounds.
尤其对罗杰尔先生，还有对我而言……: To dear Rogier, and myself, too.
……但其实，罗杰尔先生说的黑刀烙印，: In truth I've heard tell from someone else,
我曾经听某位大人说过。: about the black knifeprints that fascinate dear Rogier so.
……罗杰尔先生没有办法离开圆桌厅堂，\n所以这张纸条不能交给他。: But It wouldn't be right to give this to him, stuck as he is in the Roundtable Hold.
我想把它交给你，你能好好利用它吗？: Perhaps you could make use of it?
……总算物归原主了。: Finally, it is returned to its rightful place.
那位伟人被夺走的圣痕，总算回来了。: The stolen hallowbrand, of the exalted noble.
……该和你道别了。: And now, I must bid you goodbye as well.
最后，请替我转达给圆桌厅堂的所有人：: Though I ask you deliver this message to the Roundtable Hold.
圆桌厅堂啊，请勿干扰伟人葛德文的死亡。: Hark, Roundtable. Disturb not the Death of Godwyn, the exalted.
我们仅仅因为死亡而诞生──: We, who humbly live in Death...
总有一天，我们会得到王。: Live in waiting, to one day welcome our Lord.
人民、弱者拥戴自己的王，: What right does anyone have to object?
会有谁出声指责？: Our Lord will rise. The Lord of the many, and the meek.
要像那群粗鲁的黄金律法基本主义者，: To deny us, and our ways?
否定我们的一切吗？: Like the dogmatic brutes of the Golden Order?
……我明白了，那么，请你动手。: I see. Then you must kill me.
我是葛德文──死王子的同床者。: For I am the companion of Godwyn, Prince of Death.
自认为是众多死诞者的母亲。: I wished to be a mother to Those Who Live in Death.
你对他们的憎恨，: So it is, that any loathing, any hatred that overshadows them...
应该由我全盘承受。: I must bear, as a matter of duty, with my own flesh.
你不是否定我们吗？: You deny us, do you not?
即使我们不过是因为死亡而诞生，\n想要拥戴属于自己的王。: Because we deign to live in Death, and wish our Lord to rise to glory.
我是保护死诞者的人，: I am the guardian of Those Who Live in Death.
甚至被咒骂成骯脏的魔女呢。: They call me a foul and rotten witch.
你是知情之后，还这么要求吗？: Yet you still wish to be held by me?
……我就快和葛德文同床了。: I will soon lay with Godwyn.
一切肯定都会开花结果──: And it will surely stir within me.
黄金王子、半神的初始死者，他将重新获得生命。: the new life of the golden prince, and first Dead of the demigods,
那为了死诞者而生的卢恩，也要孕育而出。: as the rune of Those Who Live in Death.
我想要拜托你。: Please, do one thing for me.
能不能展现我的孩子，\n也就是那卢恩，当上王呢？: Brandish this child, my rune, and take for yourself the throne.
成为允许死诞者存在的，: Stay the persecution of Those Who Live in Death.
而且肯定会怀上孩子，也就是卢恩。: To conceive my child, the rune.
你能不能展现那个卢恩，当上王呢？: Brandish my rune, and take for yourself the throne.
因为我不是被迫与某具尸体，\n而是自愿与葛德文同床……: I choose to lie with Godwyn of my own will. Not the remains of one chosen for me.
然后怀上孩子。: And I will bear a child.
我想那孩子肯定会继承你的温暖。: Who will inherit your warmth, too.
生为死眠少女，还有什么会比这样更幸福呢？: What greater blessing could there be, but to be born a Deathbed Companion?
……你看过圣痕吗？: Have you ever seen a hallowbrand?
那是在半神的初次死亡时，\n被刻下的、缺半的百足伤环。: When the first of the demigods died, his flesh was marked with the half-wheel wound of the centipede.
我在圆桌厅堂拿回了葛德文的圣痕，: Godwyn's hallowbrand has since been recovered at the Roundtable Hold.
但还有另外一个圣痕。: But there is another hallowbrand out there somewhere.
在拥戴我们的王以前，必须要找到。: Before the time comes we receive our Lord.
……葛德文死亡的时候，被刻下了圣痕，: When Godwyn died, a hallowbrand scored his flesh.
但应该还有另外一个缺半的百足伤环。: But another exists. Another mark in the shape of the half-wheel wound of the centipede.
……我很有可能会再弄脏这双手。: My hands will be dirtied once more by the deed.
即使如此，你还愿意接受我的拥抱吗？: Will you still let me hold you, even then?
这么一来，葛德文就能成为纯粹的初始死者，: With this, Godwyn can take his rightful place as First of the Dead.
一定能让尊贵的生命重回于他。: And claim a second, illustrious life.
你是我的……不对，你是我们的英雄。: You are my-- our true champion.
我能做的事情非常有限……: And though I can't be of any use to you...
只有一瞬间也好，让我紧紧拥抱你吧。: Can I hold you tight, if only for a moment?
……你曾经感应过诅咒吗──: Have you ever felt the curse, with your whole being?
那受人恐惧、嫌恶的生命宿疾，那丑陋的赐福？: The pox upon life itself, feared and despised by all. The reviled blessing.
你还是稚子──\n不知污秽，也浑然不觉自身的无知。: You are but a lamb. A stranger to defilement. Ignorant of your own ignorance.
难得这么宁静……不要打扰我。: I've been long without peace. Don't spoil my quietude.
……我都说了，不要打扰我。: I asked you not to disturb me.
你要感谢圆桌厅堂不得械斗的规矩，: Be thankful of the Hold's serenity.
因此你才留住一命，得以不受玷污。: It is all that keeps your death and defilement at bay.
那湿润的宿疾气味，扑鼻而来啊。: I can smell it on you. The pox, yet tender.
……看来，我的温床已经熟成了，: Apparently my seedbed is ripe and waiting.
这份宁静真短暂。: Twas a brief respite, I must say.
……你来释放我的身体吧。: Go, and unshackle my corporeal flesh.
我的身体被关在王城地底的下水道监牢。: Trapped in the sewer gaol, below the capital.
到时候，我会杀了你、玷污你，: I can kill you, and defile your corpse.
让那宿疾完全转化，变成属于你的东西。: Then the pox will truly be your own.
让我出去！让我从这里出去！: Let me out! Let me out of here!
……我要杀，还要仔仔细细玷污，: I will kill again. And defile each corpse with care.
让所有人都变成在诅咒下诞生，: Just to be sure. That when they're reborn…
让子孙，后代的诅咒源源不绝。: They'll be cursed. Along with their children, and their children's children, for all time to come…
让我吃，让我玷污……: I must eat more. Defile more...
……我要出去，让我出去。: Let me out. Let me out of here.
……我要杀了你、玷污你，: I will kill you, and defile your corpse.
……赐福降临了──: I'll give you a good blessing.
变成宿疾的温床吧。: You'll be nourishment for the pox.
你明明感应得到诅咒，: Despite the curse stirring within you.
那无人能敌的赐福，你却拒绝了。: No one has succeeded in that before.
为什么？\n……背后的原因，我终于想通了。: How? I thought. Then it hit me.
你，就是我。而我，是“食粪者”。: That you are, in fact, me. And I...am the Dung Eater.
我的身体蒙受赐福的时刻，总算来到。: It is my flesh that must receive the blessing.
让温床的诅咒侵蚀我的身体。: Defile my flesh with the seedbed curse.
周而复始、巡回不断地，侵蚀我吧──: Again and again. Until it is done.
玷污律法，直到诅咒法环降临于世。: Until a cursed ring coalesces, that may one day defile Order itself.
……我杀人无数，玷污更不在话下，: Countless, I have killed. And countless, I have defiled.
一切总算开花结果。: And soon the fruits will be borne.
数以百计的诅咒应运而生，数以千计的诅咒之子降世，\n再之后，数以万计，受诅咒的后: Hundreds will be reborn cursed, and they'll bear thousands of cursed children, who'll bear tens of thousands more.
从那之中再诞生几个我一般的存在──\n无止尽地杀害、玷污、降下赐福。: A few of those will be born just like me, and they'll kill, and defile, and bless in my stead!
……好好看仔细了。\n我们受到的引导有多么美妙。: The rotten fools. My fate was the grandest, most brilliant of them all!
……我的身体在王城地底的下水道监牢。: My corporeal flesh lies in the sewer gaol beneath the Capital.
对我降下赐福吧──让温床的诅咒侵蚀我的身体。: Give it your blessing. Defile my flesh with the seedbed curse.
诅咒，我要诅咒……: A curse... A curse upon them all.
让所有人在诅咒之下诞生……: They'll be born cursed, all of them.
让子孙，后代的诅咒源源不绝……: Along with their children, and their children's children, heh, for all time to come…
我一定要玷污你……: One day, you'll get what's coming.
住手……我、我是……“食粪者”……: No... I am... the Dung Eater...
……哦，有新的褪色者来到圆桌厅堂。: Oh, this is a rare occasion.
上一次有新人来，是很久以前了。: I can't remember the last time a new Tarnished made their way to the Roundtable.
很好。作为圆桌厅堂的前辈，\n欢迎后生晚辈来到这里。: Very well. As your senior, I bid you welcome.
这里很安全……好好放松吧。: It is safe here. You may let down your guard.
……前辈我想先给你一个建议。: Allow me a word of advice, as your senior.
现在的你只是有办法出入圆桌厅堂。: You are a mere visitor to the Roundtable, nothing more.
换句话说，就只是个过客。: A house guest, yet to earn their keep.
……我该说的都说完了。好好放松吧。: There's nothing left to say. Be at your leisure.
……有什么事吗？我还有事要忙……: What do you need? I have little time to spare.
……哦，说你是圆桌厅堂的过客，不高兴吗？: Oh, are you aggrieved? At the notion you are but a visitant here?
那你回想一下吧──\n得到赐福指引的最一开始，自己听到了什么。: Then you would do well to remember the first words of grace given to you.
如果不想把那些话当作天方夜谭，: Stand before the Elden Ring, and become the Elden Lord.
想要觐见艾尔登法环，成为艾尔登之王……: If those words held any meaning to you...
就遵从赐福的指引，打倒碎片君王，\n成为大卢恩的持有者吧。: Follow the guidance of grace, lay low the shardbearers, and claim for yourself a Great Rune.
成功之后，圆桌厅堂最深处的房间──\n它的门也会为你敞开。: Do so, and the doors to the Roundtable's inner chamber will open.
你就能听到双指的建言。: And you will receive the wisdom of the Two Fingers.
在你听过双指的建言之后，我会欣然欢迎你──: Once the wisdom of the Two Fingers becomes your own, I'll impart to you a proper welcome.
成为圆桌厅堂真正的一员。: As a true member of the Roundtable.
……我很期待你的表现。: I have high hopes for you.
老实说，我已经受够了那群人──: I'm sick and tired of them.
误以为圆桌厅堂是避难所的，褪色者冒牌货。: These namby-pamby Tarnished think us no more than a shelter from the rain...
……该说的都说完了，我还有事要忙。: We've spoken long enough. I have matters to attend to.
……既然无话可说，就不要搭话。: If you haven't anything to say, I would prefer you didn't pester me for attention.
自己胸无点墨，用不着昭告天下。: Try not to make a spectacle of yourself either. Or are you as irredeemably foolish as you appear?
……你听过双指的建言了。: You've received the wisdom of the Two Fingers, have you not?
那么，如同我承诺的──\n欢迎你加入，成为圆桌厅堂真正的一员。: Then just as promised, I bid you welcome, as a true member of the Roundtable.
我是基甸·奥夫尼尔。: I am known as Gideon Ofnir.
作为一名褪色者，\n为了觐见艾尔登法环，成为艾尔登之王，: As a Tarnished who wishes to stand before the Elden Ring and become Elden Lord,
求知若渴，渴望全知的人。: I am accumulating knowledge. To be all-knowing.
……为数不多的同志啊，希望我们能长久合作。: You now belong to a select group of fellows. As such, I ask that you remain constant.
……你应该想得到更多大卢恩吧？: You'll be after more Great Runes, now eh?
看在彼此的同志情谊，我共享一些情报。: Then as your fellow, allow me to divulge a little knowledge.
拥有大卢恩的碎片君王──: The inheritors of the Great Runes; the shardbearers.
包含你打倒的在内，\n圆桌厅堂已经掌握了其中５位的所在地。: We of the Roundtable know the location of five of them, including the one you defeated.
史东薇尔之主，“接肢”葛瑞克。: Godrick the Grafted, Lord of Stormveil.
在盖利德原野与玛莲妮亚战成平手的拉塔恩将军。: General Radahn, who fought Malenia and her rot to a standstill in the Caelid Wilds.
格密尔的火山官邸之主，拉卡德司法官。: Praetor Rykard, Lord of the Volcano Manor of Mt. Gelmir.
王城罗德尔的城主，不见形影的王，“赐福”蒙葛特。: Morgott the Grace-Given, Veiled Monarch and Lord of Leyndell.
还有魔法学院雷亚卢卡利亚，“满月女王”蕾娜菈。: And Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon, ruler of Raya Lucaria's Academy.
……他们之中，你想得到谁的大卢恩？: ...You'll still be after more Great Runes, won't you?
史东薇尔之主“接肢”葛瑞克，: So. Godrick the Grafted, Lord of Stormveil.
他是“初始艾尔登之王”葛孚雷的后代，\n却是又老又丑，汲汲营营、贪得力量的异形。: Despite being the blood of Godfrey, first Elden Lord, he's a grotesque old fool, grasping for power.
那座城就在宁姆格福地区，西北方的断崖上。: His castle lies upon the cliff to Limgrave's northwest.
……这些，我想你很熟悉。: ...but I suspect you know that well enough already.
“碎星红狮子”拉塔恩将军，是万夫莫敌的习武之人，: General Radahn, the famed Red Lion and scourge of the stars, is a ferocious warrior.
然而他在宁姆格福往东，那辽阔的盖利德原野上，\n和玛莲妮亚的腐败战成平手。: He fought Malenia and her rot to a standstill in the Caelid Wilds to Limgrave's east.
……从那之后，盖利德就被猩红腐败吞噬，\n无法轻易靠近。: And now Caelid has been engulfed by the scarlet rot, even approaching the region is no mean feat.
我听说拉塔恩军队的残兵还留在原地，\n用火焰对付腐败。: I've heard survivors of Radahn's army are still in the wilds, staving off the rot with fire.
看样子，拉塔恩应该还在盖利德。: And if it's true, I suspect Radahn is still there as well, in Caelid.
……但他现在的模样，可能让人不敢领教。: Though I doubt he much resembles his former self anymore...
拉卡德司法官是格密尔火山官邸的主人，: Praetor Rykard is the Lord of the Volcano Manor on Mt. Gelmir.
是个毫无怜悯心的法官，也是众多拷问官的长官。\n如蛇一般，令人感冒的男人。: He is a ruthless justiciar who commands a company of inquisitors, reviled for his serpentine demeanour.
格密尔火山在黄金树大地，亚坛高原的西边。: The volcano, Mt. Gelmir, lies in the west of the Altus Plateau; the realm of the Erdtree.
那里是破碎战争中，战况最为惨烈的地方。: It was the stage of the most appalling battle in the entirety of the Shattering.
……拉卡德犯下了亵渎罪，是罪无可赦的敌人。: Rykard has committed the grave sin of blasphemy. Marking himself as an enemy, never to be forgiven.
“赐福”蒙葛特是王城罗德尔的主人。: Morgott the Grace-Given is Lord of Leyndell, the capital city.
那座城就在亚坛高原以东的黄金树树脚……: It lies at the foot of the Erdtree, in the east of the Altus Plateau.
但双指不允许我们靠近该处。: But the Two Fingers forbid us from venturing there.
直到获得多个大卢恩，\n得以修复艾尔登法环之后，才有可能靠近。: Until we've acquired enough Great Runes to repair the Elden Ring.
