之前我曾跟你说过黑刀阴谋之夜……: You recall our conversation about the Night of the Black Knives, yes?
听说动手的人是永恒之城的后裔──: They say the assassins who carried out the deed were scions of the Eternal City.
一群穿着具有隐身效果的衣服，\n披上银色盔甲，只有女性成员的刺客集团。: A group entirely of women, arrayed in armour of silver under cloaks which fooled the eye.
而她们使用的武器黑刀，\n则是透过仪式注入死亡卢恩的力量。: The knives they wielded though, were imparted with the power of the Rune of Death through sinister rite.
……我拜托你，能不能将那烙印暂时借给我？: Please, I beg of you, lend me the knifeprint for a time.
我想要花一些时间仔细调查。: I'd love nothing more than to tease out its secrets.
想要注入死亡卢恩的力量，\n虽说只是碎片，还是需要一定规模的仪式才办得到。: Though only a fragment, a very specific ritual had to be performed to impart the power of the Rune of Death.
而仪式的烙印，肯定会留下主导者的蛛丝马迹……: Traces of the one who performed the rite are sure to remain in the imprint...
像我这样半身受死亡侵蚀的人，一定能找得到线索。: Half my body has been suffused with Death. I'm certain it will help me see.
我们都在探寻死亡，所以一起旅行过。: We found ourselves journeying together for a time, bound by our exploration of Death.
但最后我们分道扬镳了，从那之后不曾再有交集。: But our paths have since diverged. Never again to cross.
……所谓的朋友，大概都是如此吧。: Though that's hardly an uncommon fate for two friends.
我是罗杰尔，是魔法师。: The name's Rogier. A sorcerer, by trade.
……说是这么说，但现在是这副模样。: But now I'm in this sorry state.
因为事情发展不如我的预期，身体变得无法动弹了。: I had a little mishap, and now I can't move.
唉，真是伤脑筋……: As you might guess, it's far from ideal...
我知道几招魔法相关的战技。: I'm privy to a few magical battle arts.
一直待在这种地方，其实心情有点闷。: Time can move rather slowly, stuck here, you know.
也想要找人说说话。: A little conversation goes a long way.
……嗨，你好。久候多时啰。: Ahh, hello. I was hoping to see you.
调查完毕了，烙印还给你。: My examination is complete. Here's the knifeprint back, with my thanks.
……我也查到了关于仪式的主导者，\n也就是阴谋之夜的主谋身分。: Now, I have a fairly good idea who performed the rite upon the blade. The person who orchestrated the Night of the Black Knives.
“月之公主”菈妮──\n王夫拉达冈与第一任妻子蕾娜菈生下的其中一位孩子，: Lunar Princess Ranni. One of the children born to King Consort Radagon and his first wife, Rennala.
她与拉塔恩将军、拉卡德司法官之间是兄妹关系。: Demigod and sister to General Radahn and Praetor Rykard.
她的名字被隐藏在烙印里面。: Her's was the name I discovered in the imprint.
还有就是，我可以向你提出不情之请吗？: But, if I might be so bold, I would also like to ask something more of you.
那她的身体一定有“命定之死”留下的咒痕。: then she should bear the cursemark of Destined Death somewhere upon her flesh.
……这么一来，我应该就能豁然开朗，\n得到一直以来追求的答案。: And then all will be laid bare. I will have the answers I have sought for so long.
而且如果你想要遵从赐福的指引，: Don't fret, it is entirely in accordance with the guidance of grace.
觐见艾尔登法环，成为艾尔登之王的话，: If you seek to stand before the Elden Ring and become Elden Lord,
我所追求的答案，肯定也能助一臂之力。: The answers you find will surely bolster your chances.
……菈妮的所在地，我有些头绪。: I have some idea of Ranni's potential whereabouts.
在雷亚卢卡利亚学院的北方，有一座城寨。: There's a manor to the north of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.
那里是菈妮的原生家庭──卡利亚王室的故乡。: It is the familial home of the Carian royals from whom Ranni descends.
有传闻说最近几年，王室的老臣陆陆续续前往那座城寨。: There's been talk of the old royals' vassals gathering there in recent years
在破碎战争的时候，菈妮销声匿迹，\n从那之后就没有人见过她的身影。: Ranni's whereabouts since the Shattering are a well-kept secret. She hasn't been seen even once.
我在猜想，她有可能回到了故乡，也就是那座城寨。: But I suspect she might have returned to the manor in which she was born...
……她有可能回到了故乡，也就是那座城寨。: She may have returned to the manor that is her home.
位在雷亚卢卡利亚学院的北方，那座卡利亚王室的城寨。: The Royal Carian residence to the north of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.
……我想，还是该和你说吧。: I'm afraid there's something I must tell you.
你知道“死诞者”吗？: Do you know of Those Who Live in Death?
他们是被排除在黄金律法的法则之外，\n因为死亡而诞生的人。: The very notion of life in death defies the Golden Order.
套用Ｄ的话来说，\n那些人是不允许存在世上的玷污者。: By D's account, these defiled fiends must be expunged.
……我之所以想找到咒痕，就是想要拯救他们。: But truth be told, I seek the cursemark to save them.
但是我在调查阴谋之夜的过程中，明白了一件事：: but I discovered something in my examination of the Night of the Black Knives.
死诞者没有侵害任何事物。\n他们只是拚命生存，也就因此冒犯了律法。: These souls have committed no offence. They have every right to life, only, they happened to touch upon a flaw in the Order.
如果Ｄ知道了，我現在想要做什麼，: If D knew what drives me now,
肯定會氣得怒不可遏。: he would surely boil over with rage.
……還是說，他會感到一絲絲哀傷呢？: Or perhaps, he would even feel some pity.
不管怎麼樣，這些情況都不會發生──: But no need to fret, none of that will come to pass.
因為我很會說謊啊。: I can tell a good lie when I need to.
……唉，结果现在落得这副模样就是了。: And...that thing is to blame for the shape I'm in now...
你也要小心喔，不要长时间接触那副异形身体。: I urge the utmost caution. Don't disturb the corpse more than necessary...
菈妮抛弃身体的同时，\n连带抛弃了咒痕，原来是这样啊。: When Ranni shed her flesh, she shed the cursemark, too.
乍听之下难以置信，: You know, not everyone would trust such a tale...
但如果她现在的外表，\n如你所说，是有着少女外貌的人偶……: But, if she in her current form is nothing more than the living doll you profess...
也不是完全不可能。: Then perhaps it's true after all.
如果这提议冒犯到你，请你见谅……: Forgive the bluntness of the notion, but...
你愿意成为菈妮的臣子吗？: How would you like to become one of Ranni's vassals?
啊，当然，只是为了方便行事。: Ah, only in order to get what we want, of course.
现在还不知道她抛弃的身体在什么地方，: The location of the body which bore the cursemark, which right now I haven't the faintest.
所以说，我希望你成为她的臣子，\n待在她身边刺探，找出身体的所在地。: And the best way to find out is for you to enter her service and take a poke around on the sly.
我相信你办得到。: I know you've got what it takes.
因为你不只是一名优秀的战士，\n还有一种特质，让人容易相信你。: Not only are you a superb fighter, but people want to trust you. I've seen it.
……为了方便行事，可以请你成为菈妮的臣子吗？: Can you become Ranni's vassal to advance our agenda?
希望你成为她的臣子，\n待在她身边刺探，找出身体的所在地──: While in her service, you'll be able to take a poke around on the sly.
那连同咒痕一起抛弃的，原本身体的所在地。: And determine the location of her original body that bears the cursemark.
……我知道这要求会让你身处险境，: I realise that I'm asking you to put yourself in grave danger.
但我相信你办得到……\n不对，我认为也只有你办得到。: But I know you've got what it takes. Quite possibly the only one, in fact.
他好像发现了百足环的烙印。: That he discovered the mark of the centipede.
百足环是和咒痕有密切关系的古老烙印。: The centipede is an ancient symbol of the cursemark.
那知情而使用的人，如果不是坏人……: As long as whoever finds and uses it is not nefarious by nature,
也许我们可以互相帮助。: then we may be able to form an alliance.
……真希望能够见面聊一聊啊。: If only I could speak to them in person.
对方是类似你这样的人就好了。: And if they were like you, all the better.
……我想了想，还是和你说一声。: Hmm. Maybe I should tell you.
老实说，我最近的睡意非常浓。: Lately, I feel I'm on the precipice...
……感觉会睡得很沉、很沉的那种睡意。: Of falling into a deep...fathomless slumber.
我想可能会给你添麻烦，: And I have an inkling it could spell trouble for you, somehow.
所以先和你说声抱歉。: So I just wanted to get the apology out of the way, beforehand.
……毕竟，你很凶嘛。: Since you're so scary and all.
抱歉，你明明是一番好意。: Sorry. You were only trying to be nice.
我欣然收下了，谢谢你。: It would be my pleasure to take it. My thanks.
我不打算和你为敌……: I am no foe of yours, far from it.
既然已经穷途末路……: I don't normally find myself cornered like a rat.
……我认为真人不露相才是上策喔。: No need to grandstand; you're not even on stage.
……请不要一厢情愿了，: If you think I am helpless,
我还是有能力抵抗。: you are quite mistaken, I'm afraid.
……你都不觉得丢脸吗？: If this doesn't cause you shame, nothing will.
我是贝纳尔，和你一样是褪色者。: Name's Bernahl. Tarnished, just like you.
你会待在这块交界地，不停战斗下去吗？: Are you here in the Lands Between to take up the fight?
即使黄金律法破碎到难以修复的境界，: Does your faith in the guidance of grace hold firm,
还会继续相信赐福的指引吗？: despite the collapse of the Golden Order?
……嗯，堪称褪色者的楷模。: Yes, you're a Tarnished through and through.
真让人怀念。\n放眼现下，有这种想法很珍贵。: Takes me back, but that's a quality needed now more than ever.
那么，你有意思继承我的战技吗？: Any interest in bearing the torch, of my battle arts?
我只懂得用剑，心血全投注在战技上。: All I know is the sword. Picked up a fair few tricks in my time, too.
我想把战技传承下去，\n传给像你这种模范褪色者。: Now's the time to pass 'em on. To a good and proper Tarnished, like you.
……哦，还学得不够吗？\n很好，我奉陪到底。: Oh, not had your fill, eh? Worry not, I've enough to keep you busy.
……是你啊，平安无事就好。: Ah, hello. Glad to see you safe.
那么，再来学习战技吧。: Here to learn a battle art or two?
……这块土地上，还有很多我没见过的战技。: There's a myriad of battle arts in these lands that I've yet to discover.
战技是战士持武而战、败北、丧命的证明，: Mementos of all the warriors who raised their arms in battle, lost, and died.
是最为鲜明的英雄故事。: A fine tale, all told, of true chivalric romance.
所以我才会对剑，还有战技爱不释手──: That's how I fell in love with the sword, and the arts of combat.
那传达、赋予了战败与死亡的意义。: It grants meaning even to falling in battle, to death itself.
……你还真老实。: Honest to a fault, I see.
就褪色者而言，这确实是缺点……: Such thoughts won't behove you, as a Tarnished.
但这种态度，我不反感。: But there's nothing wrong with that.
你有意思继承我的战技吗？: Any interest in bearing the torch, of my battle arts?
我想把战技传承下去，传给像你这样的褪色者。: Now's the time to pass 'em on. To a good Tarnished, like you.
不急于一时。\n等有意愿的时候，再来找我。: Well, there's no rush. Knowledge of the arts can wait another day.
……是你啊。有兴趣继承战技了？: There you are. Decided to bear the torch of my battle arts?
火山官邸是亵渎赐福、\n狩猎同胞的叛律者聚集的巢穴。: The Volcano Manor is a pit of recusants who spit at grace and hunt our own kind.
你懂这代表什么吗？: I hope you understand the weight of my words.
……明白的话，我不多说。: Well. As long as you understand what you're saying.
我还以为你是褪色者中的楷模……: I thought you a Tarnished bred by virtue.
也可能正因为如此，才会感到疑惑。: Perhaps playing that part led you to your doubts, I wonder.
劝你狩猎同胞之前，先仔细思考。: Before you consider hunting any of your own kind, think on that.
……你狩猎同胞了。: So. You've bloodied your sword in the hunt.
那是该重新介绍自己──: Then I shall introduce myself once more.
我是贝纳尔，和你一样是叛律者。: Bernahl, a recusant, just like you.
……而叛律者自然有叛律者的战法，\n也就是所谓的战技。: Recusants have particular battle arts, styled to our methods of slaughter.
学了是有备无患。: Why not add some to your repertoire?
……哦，还学得不够吗？: Oh, not had your fill, eh?
那再来学习战技吧。: Why not learn another battle art, see if we can't keep it that way.
……我想你也很明了。: You've come to understand, now, eh?
抢夺他人的力量、化为己有──: To take power and make it his own,
就是叛律者狩猎同胞的目的。: The recusant must hunt his own kind.
为了那被迫互相残杀的恶令，叛律者揭竿而起。: To raise the flag of revolt against this sanctified pillaging,
但到头来，却变成最为肤浅的掠食者。: We recusants must become the most wretched of predators.
……真可笑。: All you can do is laugh.
……你越来越有叛律者的味道了。: Look at you. A recusant through and through.
正所谓适才适所吧。: I knew you had it in you.
那是特殊的邀请函──\n邀请你狩猎圆桌厅堂的创始褪色者，其中的幸存者。: A special invitation, to hunt some of the first Tarnished who sat at the Roundtable Hold.
有意思出席的话，届时在战场会合吧。: If you should accept, I'll next see you on the field of battle.
我等你很久了。: Ah, I had hoped you'd soon return.
塔妮丝女士拿给我先前那场狩猎的谢礼。: I have the reward from Lady Tanith.
但这谢礼该由你收下。: Take it. It's yours, by right.
……一起在叛律的路上前进吧，: Let us tread the path of the recusant together.
直到不得善终的时刻到来。: Till we reach the miserable death that awaits us.
我无意出言责备，\n弱肉强食是我们的规矩。: I harbour you no ill will. The strong take. Such is our code.
在投身亵渎之中的那一刻起，\n他应该也做好不得善终的心理准备。: Even he was prepared to meet a wretched end when he first took blasphemy unto his very flesh.
……但这样一来，火山官邸也就此落幕。: But anyroad, the Volcano Manor is no more.
我该履行以前许下的约定了。: Though we may yet fulfil an old promise.
……我狩猎了不少同胞，也抢夺了不少力量。: We hunted our own kind, and took what was theirs.
这一切都是为了对黄金树举剑相向，\n时机已经成熟。: And with everything in hand, the time has come to rise, against the Erdtree.
……无上意志啊，仔细听好。: O Greater Will, hear my voice.
我“叛律者”贝纳尔继承了挚友的遗志，\n决意要让你溃不成形。: I am the recusant Bernahl, inheritor of my brother's will, and you will fall to my blade.
我们不会沦为你手掌心的傀儡，\n你很快就能亲身领教。: We refuse to become your pawns. Consider this fair warning.
原本你就心存迷惘，: You have harboured doubts from the very beginning.
会走到这一步也是必然吧。: Perhaps this day was always lurking on the horizon.
但参与亵渎，最后只会不得善终，: But know that the path you walk is blasphemy, and leads only to a miserable death.
没有决心叛律的家伙，只会碍手碍脚。: Those with weak stomachs have no place here.
……我说了立刻离开吧？: I thought I told you to leave.
……还是你真的明白？: Or do you claim to understand?
成为亵渎赐福、狩猎同胞的叛律者，代表着什么？: What it means to be a recusant, renouncing grace and hunting down one's own.
这是传承战技给你的谢礼吗？: Thanking me for the battle arts?
礼数真周到，那我不客气了。: You're one of the good ones. Thank you.
酒说不定是很适合的礼物。: For a recusant already drunk on blasphemy.
好话不说第二遍，住手吧。: I won't say it twice. Stop this.
……不得不战吗？: I suppose I have no choice, then.
赐福啊，这也是指引吗？: Is this what grace would have of us?
又是互相残杀的肤浅作为，\n这就是我们褪色者……: Dog eat dog, once again. A sad lot, we Tarnished.
……你这人有意思……: You are an enigma, to be certain.
欢迎来到结缘教堂。: I welcome you, to the Church of Vows.
我名叫米利耶，负责管理这座教堂。: I am Miriel, steward of this sacred chamber.
只是任它荒废成这副模样，着实令人汗颜……: My apologies, for the unseemly state of affairs.
在这里，想请教阁下是否听过？: Do you know the origin of this place?
关于这座结缘教堂，背后有什么样的故事。: How it came to be known as the Church of Vows?
啊，阁下不清楚啊。这也是很自然的事情。: Well, that is a shame. But who can blame you?
毕竟在爆发破碎战争之后，\n人们都遗忘了那些重要的事情。: The Shattering has caused us - all of us - to lose sight of something very dear.
过去黄金树与月，双方王室为求和平共存──: It is here, at the Church of Vows, that the great houses of the Erdtree and the Moon were joined.
“红发”拉达冈与“满月”蕾娜菈，\n两位大人就是在这座教堂缔结契约。: By the matrimonial bond between red-haired Radagon and Rennala of the Full Moon.
至今这座教堂与王城黄金树，\n以及雷亚卢卡利亚学院仍有所联系，: And so, our church holds in view the monuments of both houses.
也是出自这个原因。: The Erdtree of the Capital, and the Academy of Raya Lucaria.
啊，这么说来，阁下有什么事吗？: Oh, was there something you needed?
如果阁下的目的是参观，就请随意。: You are free to show yourself around.
我的脚已经不方便行走，\n没办法领着阁下四处介绍……: I would serve as your guide, only my legs aren't what they used to be...
如果看到需要的物品，不必介意，带走它吧。: If you find anything of use, you are free to take it with you.
还是说，阁下是为了学问而来呢？: Unless perhaps you are in search of instruction?
真是如此，我愿意倾囊相授。: In which case, I will share all that I know.
魔法也好，祷告也罢──学问不分高低。: Whether it be sorcery or incantations, learning should not fetter you to one side or the other.
在两者结合的地方，这道理更是自然。: This is, after all, a church celebrating the union of two such opposed practitioners.
……阁下持有星星泪滴吗？: Do you possess any celestial dew?
既然如此，那我需要告诉阁下──: Then I would like to share my knowledge with you.
关于这座结缘教堂所蕴藏的奇迹。: Concerning the miracle of this Church of Vows.
在过去，拉达冈大人用星星泪滴沐浴自身，: Radagon once cleansed himself with celestial dew,
此举是为侵略战争真心忏悔，\n同时也是立誓，对蕾娜菈大人的爱永志不渝。: repented his territorial aggressions, and swore his love to Rennala.
在黄金树律法与月之命运结合之际，\n所有的一切，包含纷争带来的伤害，就回归于零。: The Order of the Erdtree and the fate of the moon were conjoined, and all the wounds of war forgiven.
之后，那奇迹就一直留存在这座教堂里。: This miracle blesses the church to this day.
只要拉达冈大人做过的，阁下照着做──: And so, you need only follow Radagon's example,
那产生裂痕、难以修复的人际关系，\n想必也能重回安稳的状态吧。: to restore any bond, however strained or severed, to its rightful state of harmony.
总有一天，蕴藏在这块土地的奇迹，\n能够再一次将世界连系起来。: The miracle rooted in these grounds will, once again, mend the world.
而且这一次，毁约之事不会再发生。: And this time, its bounty will not be squandered.
褪色者啊，如果阁下当上了艾尔登之王，: If you would be Elden Lord, Tarnished,
请成为有如此作为的王者吧。: I hope that you, too, will share my faith.
……阁下想带走那把剑吗？: Are you taking the sword with you?
啊，不是，我没有责问的意思。: Oh, fear not, I don't wish to chide you.
阁下不可能是可鄙的梁上君子，: Clearly, you are no conniving thief.
既然如此，那肯定是剑本身想离开此处。: The sword is telling us something, no doubt.
与其被供奉在无人出入的地下室，: Rather than collect dust in the shadows underground,
那把剑更希望阁下正确地使用它。: it yearns to be wielded by your rightful hand.
我身为结缘教堂的神父，\n愿意解除剑的封印，把它交给阁下。: As the priest of the Church of Vows, I undo the sword's seal, and bequeath it unto you.
请大方地挥舞那把剑吧。: May you hold it high and proud.
请趁这次机会，学会控制自己的情绪。: Take this opportunity to learn to master your emotions.
我倒是无妨，但相同情况发生在其他人身上，: Worry not, I take no offence. But others are not always so forgiving.
有些人会生气，有些人会难过……\n人际关系会产生裂痕，或是陷入难以修复的境地。: Some take to anger, others sorrow... Bonds are fragile things, wont to break under strain.
这对阁下而言，绝对是有害无益。: And once they're broken, everything is lost, with naught to gain.
看到身形巨大的生物，想必让阁下吓了一跳。: I suppose my ample frame must have given you quite the fright.
请容我自我介绍──\n我名叫米利耶，负责管理这座教堂。: Allow me to introduce myself. Miriel, steward of this sacred chamber.
……如果阁下期盼奇迹发生，\n请到里头的水池中跪下，用星星泪滴沐浴自身。: To experience the miracle, kneel in the basin at the back, and cleanse yourself with celestial dew.
此举为赎罪──那产生裂痕、难以修复的人际关系，\n想必也能重回安稳的状态吧。: Absolution will be yours. Any bond, no matter how strained, or even severed, will be put to rights.
……我注意到阁下蒙受这块土地的奇迹，完成了赎罪。: Ah, I see you have undergone absolution, the miracle that blossoms from these grounds.
没错。如此一来，阁下那产生裂痕、难以修复的人际关系，: Good. As such, the bond you may have strained or severed...
想必已经重回安稳的状态。: Has been restored, to its rightful state of harmony.
……奇迹带来的安稳时光，: Be mindful, not to take for granted...
请阁下好好珍惜。: the serenity restored by this miracle.
并请多留意，别让憾事再次发生。: And take care. Never to break a bond again.
……您想知道关于拉达冈大人的事情啊。: You wish to know more of Lord Radagon?
拉达冈大人是有着一头飘逸红发的英雄。: Lord Radagon was a great champion, possessed of flowing red locks.
他率领黄金树的军队来到此地，\n在战场上邂逅了蕾娜菈大人。: He came to these lands at the head of a great golden host, when he met Lady Rennala in battle.
随后对发起侵略战争一事真心忏悔，\n和卡利亚女王，蕾娜菈大人结为伴侣。: He soon repented his territorial aggressions though, and became husband to the Carian Queen.
……但是在初始艾尔登之王，葛孚雷被逐出交界地之后，: However. When Godfrey, first Elden Lord, was hounded from the Lands Between,
拉达冈大人抛弃了蕾娜菈大人，回到黄金树王城，\n成为玛莉卡女王的王夫、第二任丈夫: Radagon left Rennala to return to the Erdtree Capital, becoming Queen Marika's second husband and King Consort.
也成为第二任的艾尔登之王。: Taking the title...of second Elden Lord.
这件事情依旧成谜──: The mystery endures, to this day...
为了什么原因，拉达冈大人抛弃蕾娜菈大人？: As to why Lord Radagon would cast Lady Rennala aside...
又话说从头，拉达冈大人不过是位英雄，\n为什么会被选为艾尔登之王呢？: And moreover...why a mere champion would be chosen for the seat of Elden Lord...
……不过，关于拉达冈大人……\n我曾听说一个关于他的秘密。: You know, it's said that Lord Radagon harboured a secret...
黄金树王城里有一位知名的雕刻家，\n受王室委托，制作拉达冈大人的大型雕像……: A famed sculptor of the Erdtree Capital was once summoned to render Lord Radagon's likeness in giant stature.
听说他因此窥见了那个秘密。: When he glimpsed the skeleton in Radagon's closet.
又听说，那座大型雕像藏着那个秘密。: And as such, it's said the great statue harbours his secret too.
……您想知道关于蕾娜菈大人的事情啊。: You wish to know more of Lady Rennala?
蕾娜菈大人是卡利亚王室的女王，\n也是雷亚卢卡利亚学院的掌权者。: She is Queen, head of the Carian royal family, and governor of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.
一名既伟大又美丽的“满月”魔法师。: The great and beautiful Full Moon Witch.
但是啊，自从丈夫拉达冈大人抛弃了她，\n她就失去了自己的心。: Sadly, her heart was broken when Lord Radagon left her.
在学院背叛王室的时候，她被囚禁在大书库里头。: And then, when the academy rebelled against the royals, she was locked away in the grand library.
……事情发生之后，蕾娜菈大人仰赖着\n拉达冈大人赠予的琥珀卵，度过每一日。: In the end, Lady Rennala was left alone, cradling the amber egg Lord Radagon bequeathed her.
将自己的一切奉献在不容于世的法术上──: Now she devotes herself to it through forbidden rite;
……希望阁下能记得，: You would do well to remember...
在结下缘分之后遭到反悔，\n所带来的伤害是难以估计啊。: Severing a vow, strongest of bonds, has consequences ever more dire.
……哦，这是……是甘露啊。: Why, this is nectar, is it not?
阁下要送给我吗？: And you're giving it to me?
老实说，我非常喜爱甘露。: Truth be told, I'm rather fond of the stuff.
恕我不推辞了。: I'll happily take it off your hands!
让我们一同学习，教学相长吧。: Very well, let us both learn together.
……这个世界原本没有异端，: Heresy is not native to the world; it is but a contrivance.
我的身体和石头没有两样。: My flesh is akin to stone.
我既不会受伤，也不会死亡。: I cannot be wounded. I cannot die.
当然，我更不会伤害阁下。: But nor will I cause any harm unto you.
你有事吗？看什么看？: You trying to start something, mate?
……哦，你想要那条项链啊？: Oh, that necklace what you're after, is it?
……那总该表现出一点诚意吧？: Show me what it's worth to you,
看情况，说不定我愿意卖给你喔。: and I'll consider parting ways with it.
反正那玩意儿也是随手拿到的。: I'm not in love with it or nothing.
先把卢恩交过来，劝你少耍花招。: First, you hand me the runes. And don't try nothin', neither.
那本来就是没路用的东西……: Thing's no damn use to anyone, anyway.
你自己找上门来谈的，不关我的事啊。: Your bloody idea, mate. Don't come crying to me later.
……啊？你又要干么？: Oh piss off, what is it now?
……啊，是喔。你想吃虾子啊？: Oh, I see. You want some of me prawn?
知道啦。东西我可以卖给你，\n但是该给我的，拿出来。: Alright then. It's yours, if you can meet me price.
还有其他想要的，可以问我。: I could be persuaded to sell you some other bits too, if you've got the runes.
……你是怎样？: What the hell is wrong with you.
……宰了你喔，滚啦。: Piss off. Before I crack you in 'alf.
想表现诚意了吗？: Decided to play ball now, 'ave you?
你不是想要那条项链吗？: You'll be wantin' the necklace, then?
……听不懂人家的意思喔？: Think you're bloody clever, do ya?
那就快滚。: Then how about you piss off?
哦，是你啊。又跑来买虾子了吗？: Alright mate. Want some more prawn, do ya?
……喜欢虾子的，绝对没坏人。: Never met someone with a taste for prawn I couldn't trust.
我应该跟你合得来。: We'd make good mates, I reckon.
……搞什么，你认识那女的喔？: Oh, so you met the girl, did ya?
……就不用往下讲了。: Alright, well, sod the particulars of the matter,
只是那女的真的怪怪的。: Anyway, she ain't all right, that one.
唉，也好啦，至少她没有死在路边。: Lucky she ain't died on the bloody roadside, I reckon.
那你看得到吗？那个赐福的指引。: Can you see it then? The guidance of grace, I mean.
我完全看不到。: I can't see it at all no more.
说起来，像我这种小混混因为指引跑来这，: Makes no bloody sense anyway, why some no-name shithead like me should get called to the Lands Between.
这件事本身就很可笑。: Cruel bloody joke, you ask me.
搞不好安排这些事的，早就没救了。: Maybe something went tits up with it. Maybe... it's been broke for a good long time.
……啊？不用往下问啦。: You what? Sod the particulars, mate.
不想买赃物？那就不要买啊。: Don't like that it's stolen? Don't sodding buy it...
这一次是螃蟹刚煮好喔。: I got crab, cooked up fresh.
哦，是你啊。又跑来买螃蟹了吗？: Alright mate. Want some more crab, do ya?
……会喜欢螃蟹的，全都是好人。: Never met someone with a taste for crab I couldn't trust.
我们同一挂的，以后交流一下啊。: We've got a real thing here, eh, and it's only gettin' better.
……还是跟你说一下好了。: Mate, there's somethin' I should probably tell ya.
就是那个穿着恶心、丑死人的铠甲，\n诅咒世间的疯子。: E's a madman, 'as it out for everyone. Curses 'em. Goes 'round in this rank armour, an' all.
要是碰到他，千万不要靠近他。: You see 'im though, stay well away.
……以前我跟他关在同一间牢房，所以我知道。: I was in the same gaol as him, once, so I know first 'and.
那家伙跟我这种小混混不一样，\n是很恐怖的男人。: E's a god-forsaken monster. Not just some petty thug like me.
……那家伙会为了对灵魂设下永恒诅咒而杀人，: E's a killer. Kills people and curses their souls...
会用自己的诅咒布满整个尸体，玷污尸体。: Does all sorts of shit to their corpses, to keep 'em cursed, forever.
……我不曾看过那么恶心的景象。: I ain't seen nothin' more disgustin' in all my years.
看得我怕到只能像小鬼头一样躲在旁边。: I ain't ever been more scared, neither. Rooted to the bloody spot...
……明明那个被玷污的，还是我朋友。: While 'e did all that, to my friend...
……对，我又看到了──: Yeah...and now I seen it 'ere, again.
被玷污的尸体。\n那绝对不想再看到第二次的东西。: Never thought I would. What 'e does to those bodies.
只有食粪者会干这种事，: It was... It was 'im, no question.
自以为是的小混混，\n最后的下场还不就这样？: Fitting bloody end, for a jumped up little shit with big ideas...
……喂，救救我啊。: Help me out, would ya, mate...
我不怕死，但我不想被诅咒，: I don't wanna get cursed. Just let me die...
我想在下辈子当个走在正路上的人啊……: I don't wanna live like this...not anymore...
知道我是“愚弄巨妖”，还动手吗！: You don't mess with Big Boggart, mate.
……看这样子，你是收钱帮那女的办事？: That bitch put you up to this, eh.
那就来打啊！混账！: Damn it! I'll rip you to shreds!
我“愚弄巨妖”的拳头有多大。: That's the fists of Big Boggart.
其实我本来，本来也想……: Why ain't it me, why ain't it ever...
是挑战半神的人吧？: Here to put the demigods to the sword.
拜托，快杀了大蛇。: Then please. Kill the great serpent.
快杀了吃掉拉卡德大人的大蛇。: The one that devoured Praetor Rykard.
弒蛇的矛就放在谒见厅。: I left the serpent-slaying spear in the Lord's Chamber.
褪色者啊，快用那把矛刺穿大蛇吧……: Worthy Tarnished, brandish the spear, and run him through.
……以前拉卡德大人抱有亵渎的野心，\n那是霸王的雄心壮志。: Praetor Rykard's ambitions, though blasphemous, marked him a worthy sovereign.
但是在大人被大蛇吃掉之后，\n那雄心壮志摇身一变，沦落成卑贱的贪欲。: But they were reduced to gluttonous depravity, once he gave himself to the serpent.
那东西已经不是拉卡德大人了……: Whatever that thing is, it is no longer Praetor Rykard.
不能再让那东西侮辱大人的名声与野心。: To spare him, and his ambitions, from further dishonour.
褪色者啊，弒蛇的矛就放在谒见厅。: Worthy Tarnished. I left the serpent-slaying spear in the Lord's Chamber.
用那把矛才能杀死大蛇。: It is the only thing that can kill that horror.
快刺穿那只大蛇吧……那可恶的怪物……: Run it through. The great serpent...that unspeakable monstrosity...
既然是的话，方便分一些卢恩给我吗？: Then, perhaps you could spare some runes?
俗话说人不可貌相，\n我曾待过雷亚卢卡利亚学院，在那学习辉石魔法。: Believe it or not, I studied glintstone sorceries at the Academy of Raya Lucaria.
只要你分卢恩给我，我可以教你魔法。: For a small donation, I'd be happy to share my knowledge.
照我们说好的，如果你有兴趣学，\n我愿意教你魔法。: Presuming you're interested, I can teach you sorceries, as promised.
只是我会的，也不是上得了台面的魔法……: Only, none of them are particularly great...
当然欢迎啊，只要你愿意学这些不起眼的魔法。: Wonderful. You're most welcome, to any of my anaemic little spells.
……好吧，那只能作罢……: Well, I can't blame you, I suppose.
但如果你改变心意了，: But, in the case that you do change your mind,
再过来找我吧。: just speak up, loud and clear.
难道说，你愿意分一些卢恩给我了？: Care to donate a few runes?
你好心分卢恩给我，\n我教的却是些上不了台面的魔法……: I'm afraid my meagre sorceries are no match for your generosity.
不如这样吧。关于这块土地的事情，\n我把所知道的一切，全部告诉你。: I can tell you what I know about this place. That should help a bit.
从这里往北边看，有看到伫立在水平面的建筑吧？: You've seen that structure to the north, towering over the water?
那里就是雷亚卢卡利亚学院，辉石魔法师的学问殿堂。: That's the Academy of Raya Lucaria. Where we study glintstone sorceries.
但是学院已经封闭了很长一段岁月。: Only, its doors have been closed for quite some time now.
为了贯彻不介入破碎战争的信条，: After they declared they wouldn't interfere with the Shattering,
学院在面向王城的东门，\n还有通往这块土地的南门一同设下了魔法封印。: the academy cast repelling seals on the east gate leading to the Capital and the south gate leading here.
……封印直到现在都还没解开。: As you might have guessed, the seals are still active,
只要没有辉石钥匙，就无法进入学院。: making entry to the academy impossible without a glintstone key.
……对，我也回不去。像我这种低阶魔法师，\n辉石钥匙不是我能奢求的物品。: And so I'm stuck here. A fledgling sorcerer, with little chance of acquiring a key.
施展封印的时候，我恰巧离开学院。\n我已经回不去那座学问殿堂了。: When they cast the seals, I'd just popped out, and now I'm uprooted from my place of learning.
……所以说，你先去找辉石钥匙吧。: Why not find yourself a glintstone key?
因为没有辉石钥匙，就进不了学院……: Without one, you can't pass through the academy,
进不了学院，就到不了黄金树王城。: and you'll never reach the Erdtree Capital.
然后，如果你除了自己要用的以外，\n还有找到另外一支辉石钥匙……: And if you find an extra glintstone key, perhaps...
不急，等到你的事情都办完之后就好……: Once you've tied up all your loose ends - and I can be very patient -
能不能把那支钥匙让给我？: would you consider donating it to me?
……我很明白自己只是颗废石，\n丝毫没有施展魔法的才能。: I know it. I'm a bluntstone. Nary a hint of talent for sorcery.
但我还是想再回到那座学问殿堂……: But still, my place is at the academy...
啊，还有就是……要注意白金之子。: Oh, one more thing... Beware the Albinaurics...
他们诞生自永恒之城的秘术，\n是一群受到诅咒的人──: ...accursed souls born of a forbidden rite of the Eternal City.
脚渐渐消失的长者，不能言语的“青蛙”，\n他们全部受到了诅咒……: The curse withered the legs of the old, and silenced the tongues of the Frogs.
也怨恨那些身体健全的人。: And now they hold deep grudges for anyone left untouched.
从来没想过像我这种废石，也有机会教人魔法。: I never imagined that a bluntstone like myself would have the chance to play teacher.
你真的要把辉石钥匙让给我？: You're willing to give your glintstone key to me?
我又能再回到那座学问殿堂了，: Now I can go back to the academy.
又能再探索辉石魔法……还有星星了……: To resume my study...of glintstone sorceries, and the very stars.
……你也有和瑟濂学习魔法啊？: You've taken an apprenticeship with Sellen?
我当然知道她，她是学院有史以来的才女啊。: Sellen was well known. The most promising sorceress in the history of the academy.
像我这种名不见经传的人，\n根本不会和她有交集。: I followed her at school, but there may as well have been an ocean between us.
……只是她被逐出学院了。: But Sellen was expelled from the academy.
因为“魔块魔女”的嫌疑──\n她被怀疑虐杀了大量人数的魔法师。: Accused of unthinkable treatment of certain sorcerers, under the name of the Graven Witch.
……这我实在无法置信。: I still don't believe the accusations.
那么惹人怜爱的女性，哪有可能做出那种事？: The illustrious Sellen would never do such things...
你要给我吗？这一定很珍贵吧？: For me, is it? But surely, that's a passing fine brew?
我那些不起眼的魔法和它相比，\n感觉价值不对等啊……: My meagre sorceries hardly warrant such a reward.
我会留在重要的时刻享用它。: I'll save it for a special occasion.
毕竟这辈子，这种酒可能就喝这么一次啊。: I may never have another drink like it for as long as I live.
……你找到辉石钥匙了啊。: So, you've found yourself a glintstone key.
但是那支钥匙，我不能收。: But I certainly can't take it from you.
为了你自己好，那该由你使用。: By rights, you should use it for yourself.
……没错，我很希望回到那座学问殿堂，: It's true, I wish to return to my place of study.
但我不愿意自己达成了目的，却妨碍到其他人。: But that's no excuse to impose upon others.
……唉，所以我才会一直都是废石吧。: Ah...is this why bluntstones always finish last?
……快出发去雷亚卢卡利亚学院吧。: Head to the Academy of Raya Lucaria.
踏上你的旅程，继续下一场战斗。: Carry on with your journey. Press forward with your fight.
不用把我的事放在心上。: Don't bother holding yourself up for my sake.
承蒙你的好意，我要动身前往雷亚卢卡利亚学院了。: With your blessing, I will depart for the Academy of Raya Lucaria.
……之后等你方便的时候，要不要再来学院一趟？: Perhaps, one day, you'll pay me a visit?
到时候，你的老师可能会变得更厉害一些。: Who knows, I may be a decorated sorcerer by then!
我是废石──\n意思是完全没有施展魔法的才能。: I'm a bluntstone. I don't even have a pebble's worth of power.
所以真的很不好意思……: So I'm afraid I can't help you decipher the scroll.
凭我的本事，没办法解读这个卷轴。: I'm sorry I'm so useless. I truly am.
……听不进我说的话了吗？: There's no getting through to you, is there.
为自己骄傲吧，\n你确实是名优秀的战士。: Be proud. You were a fine warrior.
只不过，跟随错了人。: Your only mistake was your choice of master.
……随风消逝，飘摇到遥远的巅峰吧。: Let the winds lift you, to a higher place.
……哦，你……: Well, who do we have here?
是褪色者啊，看起来不是葛瑞克的同伙。: Tarnished, are you? Clearly not one of Godrick's lot.
我叫涅斐丽·露。\n一样是褪色者，也是战士。: I am Nepheli Loux. Tarnished and warrior, like you.
可恶的葛瑞克，竟然做出“接肢”行径，\n这绝不是君王该有的作为。: This "grafting" of Godrick's ill befits a Lord.
……如果你准备挑战葛瑞克，: If you intend to challenge Godrick,
可以找我帮忙。: I ask you call upon me.
……他玷污风，玷污得太过分。: The winds run foul with his deeds.
即使我出手帮忙，\n义父肯定也会睁一只眼，闭一只眼。: I'm certain father would permit me aid the fight.
抱歉，我太多话了。: Apologies, but I've idled long enough.
同为褪色者，就各自相信指引，往前走吧。: As fellow Tarnished we must each follow our own guidance.
相信总有一天，\n路会通往艾尔登之王的宝座。: Down whatever road takes us to the throne of Elden Lord.
你果然也受邀到圆桌厅堂了。: I thought you'd receive a summons to the Roundtable.
我是涅斐丽·露，\n在史东薇尔之后就没见过面了。: Nepheli Loux. We met at Stormveil.
幸好碰面了，我有东西要给你。: I'm glad to see you here. I have something for you.
那是我在葛瑞克的接肢房找到的。: I found it in Godrick's grafting grounds.
既然打倒了葛瑞克，那就是你的。: You defeated him. You should have it.
我可不想变成战场拾荒者。: I don't intend to make a habit of scavenging corpses.
打倒了葛瑞克的人是你吧？: You were the one to defeat him, I would hazard?
你有见过我的义父吗？: I wonder if you've met my foster father?
他现在人在书房，\n书房的门旁有恩夏先生站岗。: He's in his study. The room Ensha's guarding just over there.
如果还没见过面，可以去见见他。: If you haven't already, I advise you introduce yourself.
义父是圆桌厅堂的领导人，: Father is leader of the Roundtable.
与他交谈，想必能获益良多。: I'm sure talking to him will be worth your while.
……那么，我该出发了。: It's about time I headed off.
战士啊，有缘再见。: I'll see you again, warrior, should the fates deign it.
你受邀到圆桌厅堂啊。: You received a summons to the Roundtable?
同样是被引导、来到圆桌厅堂的褪色者，\n今后多指教了。: The pleasure's mine, as a fellow Tarnished, guided by grace to the Roundtable Hold.
我第一次见到你。: I've not seen you here before.
……那是某种药品吗？: Is that some kind of medicine?
看起来是会对心理产生效用的类型。: One that affects the heart, I'd wager.
是的话，我不需要。: If it's what I think, I have no need of it.
都该由我独自承受。: Not to brave the horrors of battle. Nor to bolster my resolve.
这座村子的惨状，你怎么看？: Well, what do you make of it? What's happened to this village?
……我小时候，曾看过一样的景象。: I witnessed a sight much the same, in my infancy.
弱者惨遭蹂躏、掠夺、杀害……: The oppression of the weak. Murder and pillage unchecked.
人间炼狱的景象。: A waking nightmare, made by men.
……但我已经不是当时那年幼的孩子，: But this time, I'm a woman grown.
虽说为时已晚，但来报一箭之仇吧……: And though the suffering cannot be undone, I can still mete out justice.
让他们知道，我涅斐丽·露是战士。: Let the scars I carve remind them. I am Nepheli Loux. Warrior.
说来丢脸，我现在思绪很乱。: It's pathetic, I know, but I...need to think.
对，没错。我被义父抛弃了。: Right. It's true. My father cast me out.
这是沉浸在情绪里，忘记命令……\n害他手中的棋子折损的惩罚。: For indulging my emotions. Forgetting the mission. Punishment for offing his pawns.
……我的义父基甸爵士，一直是我的明灯。: Father...rather, Lord Gideon has offered me guidance all my life.
只要能让他当上艾尔登之王，\n我什么都愿意做。: I would have done anything for him, to place him on the throne of Elden Lord.
但是，我……: And yet I... Though it was not my intent...
……而且我已经无法完全信任义父……: I...can no longer trust in father...
既然那些人是遵从义父的命令，引发那桩惨剧，: To think he'd order his men to enact such tragedy...
那么，义父哪有正义可言？: Where is the justice he purports, in that?
义父曾说过，只要他当上艾尔登之王，: He once told me that if he became Elden Lord,
在他的治理之下，弱者将不再受欺凌──: he would never allow the downtrodden to be cheated ever again.
难道那句话是谎话？: Was he simply lying to me?
义父是我的明灯。: Father has always given me his guidance...
嗯，现在的我，可能会需要。: Fine. I'll take a dose. Perhaps it'll do me some good.
有一股古老风暴的味道。: I can smell the ancient storm in it...
谢谢，我收下了。: My thanks. I'll gladly take it.
我看不见，也感应不到灵魂。: I don't feel the presence of spirits, let alone see them.
还是会让我想起，我的第一只老鹰。: It reminds me of my first hawk.
……这个骨灰有一股古老风暴的味道。: In this ash, I can smell the ancient storm.
……让我想起，我的第一只老鹰。: It reminds me of my first hawk.
那个时候，谢谢你的关照。: I must thank you, for your aid.
没错，我已经告别了义父。: I told father I would be with him no longer.
因为我想起很久以前，\n当上战士的时候，立下的誓言。: I remembered the vow I took when I first became a warrior, so many moons ago.
……这块土地很像我的故乡。: This land is much like the one from which I hail.
我很想刮起风暴，吹散风中的污秽。: I will call upon the storm, to drive away the foulness that has settled on the winds.
再次报上名号。\n我是涅斐丽·露，是战士。: Again, I am Nepheli Loux. Warrior.
身边虽然有人唤我为王，\n但我的本质依旧不变。: Some call me by the title of Lady, but I remain the same woman underneath.
唯一改变的，是我舍弃了引导的明灯。: Though I have now abandoned my former guidance.
我愿意化作你的其中一片羽翼。: I would gladly lighten your burden.
我会继续待在这里，刮起风暴。: I will remain, to summon the storm.
那引导你前进、战斗的地方……: But your guidance, and your fight...
这不是战士该有的作为。: Such conduct ill befits a warrior.
……原来是凶恶盗匪之流。: I see. You are but a simple villain.
我涅斐丽·露，要让你明白是非。: Let the scars remind you; this lesson comes from Nepheli Loux!
……像你这种人，用不着义父动手。: You wouldn't even register as a threat to father.
不过来得正好，你对酒有没有兴趣啊？: Well, while you're here. Have you, too, been seduced by the good lady alcohol?
而且不是普通的酒，\n是过去只有半神才能喝的甘露，也就是粹酒喔。: Perhaps you've heard of dreambrew, the nectar of the demigods, once forbidden to we mortals?
世事难料啊，其实贫僧对粹酒了解得透彻。: Well, believe it or not, I know just how to make it.
如果你能帮忙收集制酒的原料，: And if you were to help me gather its ingredients,
贫僧可以分给你一些。: I'd gladly share some with you.
……交界地对我们褪色者实在不算亲切，: The Lands Between are no kind place for we Tarnished.
大概因为年纪有了吧，\n这阵子到战场找原料，身体实在吃不消吶。: And I'm getting too old to keep scavenging corpses on the battlefield...
那东西叫作托莉娜水晶球，: That, is St. Trina's Crystal Ball.
当你找到那群酣梦难醒的幸运儿，: It can be used to take slumber fog from those submerged in deepest sleep,
可以用水晶球收集深眠浓雾。: those merry fools sunk so low they will not awaken.
所谓的粹酒，是滤过深眠浓雾之后，\n生成的特殊液体吶。: Dreambrew, I should say, is a special filtration of slumber fog.
……帮个忙，去收集深眠浓雾吧。: Go ahead and bring me some slumber fog, my compeer.
嗯，再收集２个……: About two should do it, by my reckoning...
嗯，再收集３个……: About three should do it, by my reckoning...
嗯，再收集４个……: About four should do it, by my reckoning...
嗯，再收集５个……: About five should do it, by my reckoning...
嗯，再收集６个……: About six should do it, by my reckoning...
贫僧可以考虑分给你一些粹酒。: And then I'll have enough dreambrew to share.
……酒可是好东西，\n让人体会人生在世的喜悦，还有美妙之处吶。: Drink is a wonderful teacher. Imbibe and you will understand; this world's delights, and its futility.
怎么！你也太不知趣了吶！: You what? You hardly know what you're missing out on.
唉，也算啦。\n以后你会主动来问酒的事情。: Well, suit yourself. But I'm sure you'll be after a drink before long.
当你对逐渐步向毁灭的世间感到厌烦，或是……: Perhaps you'll tire of this crumbling world...
当你想知道其他人心底的秘密吶……: Or maybe you'll wish to uncover someone's deepest, darkest secrets...
怎么了吶？你有兴趣了吗？: What? Taken an interest in the finer things, after all?
那个只有半神才能喝的甘露，也就是粹酒。: Like dreambrew, the nectar of the demigods, once forbidden to we mortals?
贫僧可以考虑分给你一些。: I'd gladly share some with you.
哦，等你好久啦。: Ah, I've been eagerly awaiting your return.
事情办得怎么样？有收集到深眠浓雾吗？: How did you fare? Find any slumber fog?
贫僧也说了，想分到粹酒，\n还要再收集２个浓雾吶。: As I said, if you'd like me to share some dreambrew with you, we'll need two doses of slumber fog, or thereabouts.
贫僧也说了，想分到粹酒，\n还要再收集３个浓雾吶。: As I said, if you'd like me to share some dreambrew with you, we'll need three doses of slumber fog, or thereabouts.
贫僧也说了，想分到粹酒，\n还要再收集４个浓雾吶。: As I said, if you'd like me to share some dreambrew with you, we'll need four doses of slumber fog, or thereabouts.
贫僧也说了，想分到粹酒，\n还要再收集５个浓雾吶。: As I said, if you'd like me to share some dreambrew with you, we'll need five doses of slumber fog, or thereabouts.
贫僧也说了，想分到粹酒，\n还要再收集６个浓雾吶。: As I said, if you'd like me to share some dreambrew with you, we'll need six doses of slumber fog, or thereabouts.
……唔、嗯，这就对啦。: I see, I see. You have what I asked.
每个浓雾都很纯净无瑕，也有漂亮的沉淀物。: All splendid fogs of superior quality. Sediment firmly settled, mm.
来，这是说好要给你的粹酒，收下吧。: Here's the dreambrew I promised. All yours.
……再帮个忙，多收集一些深眠浓雾吧。: Bring me more slumber fog, my compeer.
这样贫僧就能再分给你粹酒喔。: Do so, and I'll have a bottle of dreambrew with your name on it.
……贫僧想给你一个建议。: Allow me a little advice, my compeer.
粹酒能揭露秘密。: Dreambrew is known to drag people's secrets into the daylight.
所以说，和获得短暂的愉悦相比，\n如果你更希望知道他人的秘密，: If that's what you seek, rather than the usual fleeting pleasures,
就让对方喝下粹酒吧。: Then treat them to some dreambrew.
……秘密就好比老酒──越陈是越香吶。: Secrets are like fine wine. The longer they mature in the dark, the richer the flavour...
懂了这个道理，一切都能随心所欲啦。\n想要友情，想要支配，想要欺骗都行啊……: Know that, and all will be as you desire. Friendship, rule, intrigue...
又带来深眠浓雾了吗？: Have you brought me some more slumber fog?
……你还真喜欢酒吶。: You certainly have a taste for spirits.
看来之后，我们会很常打交道啊……: I'm sure I'll be seeing a lot more of you.
你也知道，贫僧是虔诚的圣职人员。: As you surely know, my compeer, I am but a humble man of the cloth.
对酒有多了解，就等同是祷告有多虔敬吶。: And I must profess, the study of alcohol is but another form of worship.
哦，托莉娜。\n我的信仰生于酒，我的信仰生于人心吶。: Oh, St. Trina. My faith is in alcohol, and the hearts of men.
贫僧听说那通往圣树的路，\n原本封闭不通，现在再一次开放了。: I heard the path to the Haligtree had been reopened.
所以才拚了老命赶来……: So I forced these old bones to weather the journey.
看起来是你的功劳啊？: Don't tell me it was you who opened the passage?
……说起来，这片土地真够冷。: Nevertheless, it's rather nippy in these lands, eh.
这时候该上场的，就是酒吶。: But there's nothing like a good drink to warm the cockles...
唔、喔，是你啊。: Oh it's, good, good to see you.
差那么一点就要冻僵了吶。: I think I was about to freeze solid.
……这块土地啊，曾经发生\n某位尊贵的大人被掳走的事情吶。: You know, a holy personage was once abducted from these lands.
贫僧正在搜集相关的线索……: Thus I am here in search of clues that might unravel the mystery.
据说那群贼人躲进古代树森林，\n贫僧在找寻他们留下血腥足迹。: The abductor's bloody footprints are said to have disappeared in the Forest of Ancient Bowers.
唔？瞧你一脸古怪。: Hm? That's quite a face you're pulling...
贫僧不是常挂嘴上吗？贫僧是虔诚的圣职人员……: Need I remind you? Though I am but a humble man of the cloth,
还有，人生在世，谁无秘密吶？: each of us has our secrets, my compeer.
托莉娜，不对，\n总算找到您的身体了，米凯拉大人。: St. Trina's, no, Lord Miquella's cadaver.
贫僧遍尝了各种秘密，: I have partaken of untold secrets.
肯定能为您带来益处。: Such that I might aid you, O Lord.
还请您允许贫僧里可，: So please, I hope you can welcome your humble servant Rhico,
进入您的梦，以及您的心中世界。: Into your dream, the world of your heart.
也请您允准──: Indeed, I beg you grant my wish,
在神人的您成为神的那个时候，\n请允许贫僧随侍您的身旁。: That when you transcend from empyrean to god, allow me a place by your side.
……哦，你送给贫僧啊。: Oh ho, are you asking me to partake?
这是脸皮够厚，毫无心机，\n还是出于全然的好意吶？: Well, I haven't got a clue what to think.
真摸不透。: Is this outright impudence? Simple callousness? Or genuine kindness, I wonder?
唔、嗯，贫僧就收下吧。: Well, what matters it? I'll take some, regardless.
想来贫僧的秘密对你而言，\n可能也太过难解。: You couldn't possibly fathom the secrets I possess, my compeer.
贫僧正如你所见，一贫如洗。: You do know I'm merely a beggar.
就不能尊重前辈先进吗？: For those who came before you.
……呼，没想到有点吃力吶。: Well, that knocked the wind out of me.
拿珍藏的来喝一喝吧……: The perfect time to try that special reserve…
既然来自外地，\n想必入目的一切都令你惊叹吧？: After being out there, it must be quite surprising,
这座城市位在黄金树的树脚，\n沐浴在源源不绝的赐福之下──: to see our capital, cradled by the Erdtree, showered by an eternal wellspring of grace.
飘扬的乐音、芳香、光辉……\n一切都在正轨之上，在永恒之中。: The sights, the sounds, the luscious scents. Each precisely as they should be. Each eternal.
但仔细看来，你似乎是褪色者？: I didn't notice that you were Tarnished.
……既然如此，我好言相劝，: Now, you mustn't take this the wrong way.
尽快离开这座城市吧。: But you must leave the capital at once.
我是出自好意才如此规劝。: It is for your own good, I assure you.
正所谓人各有安身之地──: All things have their proper place.
受赐福宠爱的我们，被赋予这座黄金之城；: We, having been chosen by grace, were given this Golden Capital.
不受宠爱的你们，也有恰如其分的郊野可去。: You, on the other hand, have your own home, which is a far cry from here.
只要待在那地方，你们还能维持本色，\n不会玷污任何事物。: So far, in fact, that it cannot be further marred by your touch.
……在破碎战争的时候，\n就是有太多蠢人不懂得安分守己。: The Shattering caused a great many fools to overstep their bounds.
竟敢反叛“赐福王”蒙葛特，\n举兵进攻，企图侵略、夺走圣地。: Their impudence led to insurgency against Morgott, Lord of Grace. They raised an army, and sought to lay siege to this sacred ground.
可是你瞧，蒙葛特王的治理无可匹敌！: But do you see where it got them? King Morgott's rule would not be shaken!
妄想攻击黄金树之城的，皆不能得逞，\n我们得以永远蒙受赐福。: Their attempt to defile the capital failed, and while we revelled in eternal grace,
所有叛徒都被恐怖“恶兆妖鬼”盯上，\n一个个都在城墙外尸迭成山、血流成河！: the traitors were eyed by the grotesque Fell Omen, and their corpses piled high outside the wall!
你是应该离开这座城市。: The capital is simply not where you belong.
……我是好言相劝，: You mustn't take it the wrong way.
既然如此，你的去留就另当别论。: Well, then perhaps we can talk.
你身为褪色者，一介野蛮人，\n但似乎能明辨是非。: For a barbarous Tarnished, you see the difference between right and wrong rather clearly.
好吧，我允许你在这座城市短暂停留。: Very well. I permit your stay in the capital for the time being.
接着，我以榭海德一族之名，\n向你提出狩猎恶兆之子的要求。: And in the name of the house of Shanehaight, I beseech you hunt down the foul Omen.
这座城市的地底已然化成弃置场，: The Undercapital is a repository of waste.
从古至今，那群骯脏的恶兆之子，\n还有不曾切除畸角的恶鬼之子，就躲藏在地底。: For ages it's teemed with repulsive Omen. Fiendlings, even, who've never lost a horn.
……让人深感悲痛的是，从不久之前开始，\n那些东西发出的，令人作呕的叫声竟然传至: And what's worse, they've taken to bellowing in a most blood-curdling manner. You can hear it all the way up here.
丝毫不放弃玷污黄金树的意图。: A vile, ceaseless affront to the Erdtree's sanctity.
去狩猎那些躲藏在地底弃置场的恶兆之子，\n快快断绝那一阵阵令人作呕的叫声。: Hunt down the vile Omen scurrying about in the Undercapital, and give us peace from those wretched howls.
我很期待你的表现。\n切记，勿做出侮辱我族英名的举止。: I know you can do it. Do not dishonour House Shanehaight.
……还不打算狩猎恶兆之子吗？: Haven't set off to hunt the Omen yet?
看来你比我认为得还要优柔寡断。: Well, you're certainly dragging your heels more than I foresaw.
我可以等──宽容待人是身为贵族的气度。: We Shanehaights are known for patience, a virtue amongst the noble.
那些东西……令人作呕的叫声……\n快要逼疯人了。: That wretched screeching... I feel as if I could go mad.
哦，久候多时了。: Ohh, there you are, pleased to see you.
那些弃置场的恶兆之子，你狩猎完毕了吧？: You must've expunged the Omen from the repository.
因为那令人作呕的叫声渐渐消失了……: Otherwise their revolting screeches would still be affronting my ears.
不过啊，你做得非常好。: Well, you've done us a fine service, I must say.
诸位树神官肯定会欣喜无比。: The Erdbishops will be very pleased to hear it.
……唔，不只如此……: No, this is above their station...
只要确实证明是我的功劳，: If I explained that this was all my idea,
也许还能觐见“赐福王”蒙葛特，一见尊容。: I could be granted audience with Morgott, Lord of Grace.
这是何等荣耀的事情。: That a viscount as myself might be seen by the Lord of Grace.
肯定能成为一族流芳百世的荣誉。: Such an honour will place me amongst the most venerated Shanehaights.
……唔，失礼了，我忘记你还在现场。: Oh, very sorry, I almost forgot about you completely.
这是我们榭海德一族的传家之宝，: This Shanehaight heirloom has been held for generations.
用来奖励你完美达成了要求。: It is yours now, a reward for your fearless execution of my request.
……对一介褪色者来说，那是过于贵重的物品。: I'm afraid its worth might be lost on a Tarnished, but...
哎，也无妨。\n当作是庆祝我们榭海德一族的荣耀之始吧。: For everything, there is a first. For you, and for House Shanehaight, and its newfound glory.
……我得开始做准备了。: Now, I need to get myself ready.
万一真要觐见赐福王，: If fortune favours me, and I am seen by the Lord of Grace,
一身邋遢的，成何体统。: I'd be put to shame if I didn't look my very best.
不能再玷污黄金……: He is a stain upon all things golden...
不管你是谁，最好离开我身边。: Well, it matters not. If you are wise, you will leave, immediately.
我体内的猩红腐败正在蠕动……: My flesh writhes with scarlet rot.
这是诅咒，不是一般人该接触的东西。: It is a curse. Not to be meddled with by man.
……最好离开我身边。: If you are wise, you will leave, immediately.
……要我用这根针刺自己吗？: You ask that I stab myself with the needle...
我选择相信你。: than simply continue to spoil from within.
……能请你闭上双眼一阵子吗？: Would you mind...averting your eyes for a moment?
……顺利刺进去了，真没想到。: Well. That was easier than expected.
抱歉，在那之后就失去意识，\n没有向你好好道声谢。: My apologies, for when last we met. I fainted before I could even thank you.
没错，和你说得一样。\n把针刺进身体后，猩红腐败就不再蠕动。: Everything is as you said. Since inserting the needle, the scarlet rot has ceased to writhe.
而且不再做恶梦了……\n也能自在行动，我到现在还不敢置信。: Even the nightmares have abated... And now, though I can scarcely believe it myself, I can move as I please.
对你真是不知从何感谢起。: Not that I could ever truly repay you,
这是微薄的心意，请你收下。: but I would like you to have this, by way of thanks. A token, though it is.
……我想出门旅行。: I'm considering leaving. On a journey.
针刺进身体之后，\n我在朦胧的意识中想起了──: With the needle buried in my flesh, I've started to recall, but dimly...
我叫米莉森，期待以后再相会。: My name is Millicent. I pray fate permits us meet again.

……您知道金面具先生吗？: Do you know of the noble Goldmask?
他在过去作为褪色者，\n人还在交界地之外的地方时，: Though he was but a Tarnished, living outside the Lands Between,
就能准确预测赐福的指引即将到来，是一名大学者。: he was a great scholar, who foresaw the coming guidance of grace.
他现在身在交界地，独自探索黄金律法……: And now, I hear he has come to the Lands Between alone, to contemplate the Golden Order...
知道这件事之后，我就非常想向他讨教，\n也很想帮忙探索黄金律法。: I wish nothing more than to seek his instruction, and perhaps even help him in his research.
哦哦，等您很久了。: Ah, I had been waiting for your return.
打算去寻找先前和您提过的金面具先生。: As I mentioned, I'm off in search of the noble Goldmask.
只是这么一来，就暂时无法和您见面。: We may not meet again for some time.
如果有想学习的祷告，请把握机会。: If there's any incantations you wish to learn, now's the moment.
打算去寻找名叫金面具的大学者，向他讨教。: I'm off in search of a noble scholar known as the Goldmask, to beg his instruction.
离开圆桌厅堂后，遇见故知……\n令人感到无比雀跃啊。: How delightful, to meet a familiar face, even after departing the Roundtable Hold.
其实在启程之后，\n我又学到了一些，有所收获。: I've been doing some learning of my own since then, actually.
如果您愿意的话，请听我说。: And will happily pass it along to you.
……我还没有见到金面具先生。: I'm yet to find the noble Goldmask.
可能他在更靠近黄金树的地方吧。: I suppose he'll be closer to the Erdtree.
那对我来说是条险峻的道路，\n但我不打算轻易放弃。: The path ahead might be perilous, but tread it I shall.
在离开圆桌厅堂，\n独自一人旅行之后才明白，: Since departing the Roundtable Hold, I've come to understand, in my solitude,
原来自己是这么地无知……: How little it is I truly know...
听外表的描述，那的确就是金面具先生。: From your description, it can be no other than the Goldmask himself!
……他真的在这个地方啊。: Of course, of course, I knew he would be close by.
黄金律法啊，感谢您与我同在。: Bless the Golden Order, and its benevolent rays.
我也该向您道谢，\n真不知道该如何表达我的谢意。: And to you too. My sincerest thanks.
……我准备离开这里，\n前往金面具先生的所在地。: I will soon leave to join the noble Goldmask.
幸亏有您的帮助，真的非常谢谢您。: It is entirely thanks to you. You have my sincerest gratitude.
托您的福，我成功找到金面具先生了。: Thanks to you, I have become acquainted with the noble Goldmask himself,
老师允许我跟在他的身边。: and taken my place by his side, as you can see.
而当然，我也在继续教导如何祷告。: Have no fear, I will still teach you incantations, as before.
只是为了避免干扰老师的思绪，\n音量要压低，再麻烦了。: Though we must do so quietly, such that we not disturb the great master's cogitation.
……老师一直在专注思考之上。: The master is always deep in contemplation.
我拚了命想赶上他的指头，记录表达的内容。: While I frantically attempt to record his wisdom; the movement of his finger.
而记录的内容，我只看得懂一小部分……: And though I am yet to comprehend even the daintiest morsel of his wisdom...
但我马上明白，这是上天赋予我的天职──: I know that this, this is my life's calling.
黄金律法赐予毫无才能的我，担任记录者的任务。: The Golden Order has bestowed me, talentless as I am, the great duty of documentarian.
老师，您是怎么了呢？: Master! What ever is the matter?
请您继续思考、继续奏出旋律！: Please, I implore you continue! Continue your reflections, your rhythms!
让我把一切记录下来！: I must be the one to record them!
拉达冈不过是细微末节的小事。: What matters this issue of Radagon, really?
黄金树──黄金律法就近在眼前了，: The Erdtree, heart of the Golden Order, lies before our very eyes!
您到底在犹豫什么呢？: Why must these qualms come to you now?
噢，究竟在犹豫些什么！: We were on the very cusp!
……啊，是您啊。\n很抱歉，我没有注意到您。: Oh, was that you? Sorry, I hardly noticed.
因为老师静止不动，我有点慌了。: I'm a little shaken since the master ceased his movements.
是的，老师一直静止不动。: Yes, the master is still ceased.
唉，都走到这一步了，怎么会……: And after coming all this way... Why now, of all times?
……越靠近黄金树，老师的思考就越加繁复──: The master's reflections had heightened as we neared the Erdtree.
基本上严谨缜密，类似数学，\n但也不乏从中浮出放纵不羁的旋律。: While still a precise calculus, the rhythms grew increasingly wild.
老师正面临着神秘的谜题。: Now the master is facing quite the puzzle.
在黄金律法之中，我们视玛莉卡女王为唯一神……: The Golden Order is founded on the principle that Marika is the one true god. However...
事实如此，但现在却找到\n玛莉卡的第二任丈夫，王夫拉达冈的名字。: The name of Marika's second husband, King Consort Radagon, also appeared...
从找到拉达冈的名字之后，他的指头就不动了。: His finger has remained still, ever since Radagon's name was discovered.
只有我待在老师身边，却什么忙都无法帮。: The master only has me, and here I fail him...
……您对老师做了什么？: What on earth did you do to the master?
老师的指头又动了起来，开始思考。\n我认为这样就够了。: Master's finger moves again, resuming his cogitation; more than good enough for me.
对您真的感激不尽。: I haven't the words to thank you.
说是谢礼可能不恰当，但这件事只让您听──: So I'd like to pass this on to you instead.
关于我记录到的，黄金律法的深渊，其中部分内容。: A glimpse into the heart of the Golden Order, documented by yours truly.
……拉达冈的真实身分，就是玛莉卡。: To think, that Radagon was Marika herself.
从老师的指头编织出的数学与旋律，\n只能有这种解释。: Or at least, such is all I can interpret from the rhythm and calculus of his finger.
……但这种事情真有可能吗？: How would such a thing even have been possible, I wonder.
我完全无法吸收，真难受。: Sadly, I cannot comprehend it, myself.
难道说，您能完全理解这件事？: Do you have a fuller understanding of the matter?
嗯，即使无法理解，我也会继续记录。: Well, either way, I can continue my documentation.
老师的思考，还有真相──\n我的理解于此，都不是必要。: In truth it matters very little whether I understand the master's thoughts or not,
我只是单纯的记录者，也想贯彻这一点。: I am merely his scribe. It is my sole and unwavering purpose.
唉，但那是这么重要的事吗？: But oh, how important could it really be?
到底在犹豫什么呢？: Why must these qualms come to you now?
您居然来到这种地方。: I can't believe you've come all this way.
其实……我心中有个恐怖的猜测，挥之不去。: I've…been gripped by a terrifying thought.
……老师的指头编织出的数学与旋律，: The rhythms and calculus of the master's finger...
表现出对黄金律法的完美，产生怀疑……: betray a suspicion of the holism of the Golden Order.
我从中感受到了万万不可有的傲慢。: A conceit, I am afraid, that cannot be overlooked.
唉，那种事情不可能发生，: Oh, but how could this be?
也千万不能发生。: I dread to even entertain the possibility...
我没办法完全信任老师了。: but somehow, I cannot cast aside my doubts about the master.
是我哪里出了问题吗？: Tell me, have I simply lost my head?
但如果，老师对黄金律法依旧虔诚，: Only, if the master were true to the Golden Order,
那为什么，他会考虑进入这座有着禁忌火焰的山？: why would he think to breach this forbidden mount of fire?
唉，老师，请您否定吧。: Oh master, put my mind at ease.
我想相信老师，我想继续当您的记录者。: I want to place my trust in you, to be your scribe.
您要我遗忘一切吗？: It will make me forget, you say?
要我遗忘这恐怖的猜测吗？: So that I can push aside these frightful thoughts...
我怎么可能遗忘……: Would that I could... Would that I could...
老师就只是个疯子。: The master was nothing more than a madman.
坚信那傲慢又荒诞的妄想，否定黄金律法的完美，: Enchanted by a vain and ruinous delusion, he rejected the perfection of the Golden Order,
还想推动独善其身的完美，只是个不虔诚的信徒！: seeking to supplant our glorious faith with his own!
哈哈，真是讽刺啊。: Could there be a more pitiable comedy?
看啊，投注多少心血探索的完美存在，\n竟然会燃烧得那么剧烈！: Look at it. The culmination of perfection, burning, before our very eyes!
我在这里，请让我见见您。: I'm right here. Please, show me.
您的指头编织出的数学与旋律，: Your finger. Your rhythms, and calculus.
热衷学习，是好事一件。: It's good to see your enthusiasm.
是的，我很乐意收下。: Indeed, I will happily take it off your hands.
上头记载着与黄金树不相关的祷告……: Its incantations bear no lineage from the Erdtree.
我是探索黄金律法的人，: My interests lie solely in the Golden Order.
……我明白了，我愿意收下。: Very well...I'll take it off your hands.
即便我会因此不再纯净，我的信仰会不再无暇，: I cannot afford to maintain my innocence any longer. I must dirty my hands to test my faith.
只要能借此找到些什么，蛛丝马迹也好，\n有办法成为老师的助力，我欣然接受。: Even if it offers only the most meagre of hints, I will do whatever I can to help my master.
您怎么动手！: What are you trying to achieve?
所谓的信仰，也包含抵抗的力量。: Faith grants me strength, that I might endure.
黄金律法啊，与我们同在吧。: O Golden Order, shine through me.
希望赐福的指引能早日放弃您。: That the guidance of grace abandons you.
……所谓正确的死亡，指的是回归黄金树的怀抱。: A proper death means returning to the Erdtree.
耐心等吧──等到树根呼唤你的那一刻……: Have patience. Until the time comes...and the roots call to you.
……灵庙正在漫步，怀抱着无魂的半神。: The mausoleum prowls. Cradling the soulless demigod.
噢，“永恒女王”玛莉卡啊，\n安歇在它怀中的，是您丑陋的弃子。: O Marika, Queen Eternal. He is your unwanted child.
……小树啊，生自伟大黄金树的小树啊。: O Sapling! Sweet sapling of glorious gold.
……我们的安眠地受玷污了，怎么有这种事？: Unthinkable. Our hallowed resting place is violated.
竟然会有拒绝回归黄金树，\n死后继续活命这种事，太可怕了。: To refuse the Erdtree's call to return, to live within Death... Sickening.
……那群母亲被掳走的亚人暴动了。: The demi-humans wax wroth, now their mother's been taken...
……唉，救救我吧。我可是贵族啊。: Please, help me. I'm of noble blood.
一旦被那些杂种吃下肚，我会永不得……: If those hideous mongrels eat me, I'll be forever marred...
啊，我不要沦落那种下场，不要玷污我！: Anything but that, please! Think of the disgrace!
……我想当个战士，战斗到最后一刻。: All I wanted was to fight. To fight, as a warrior, to the last...
赐福的指引啊，那为什么这扇门不开……？: So, why? Why, O guidance of grace, will this door not open?
……女巫大人啊，女巫大人，您在哪里呢？: Maiden, dear maiden, where are you?
……哦，看到了，就是那座塔吧！: Ohh, there it is, the tower!
总算能回去黄金树的树脚，回到我们的故乡了！: Finally, I can return. To our home, bathed in rays of gold!
唉，艾尔帕斯老先生，\n只有您活命也好，请千万要躲好……: Please, even if it's just you, old Albus, hide well and still your breath.
……唉，维克大人，结果您不是王吗？: Ahh, Lord Vyke, it seems that you were no lord, after all.
我们的王，我们的癫火之王啊，您在哪里？: Then where is he? Our true Lord, our Lord of Frenzied Flame.
请熔化那分隔你我的一切事物吧。: We beg of you, incinerate all that divides and distinguishes.
……雷亚卢卡利亚，唯我独尊的魔法学问殿堂啊。: Raya Lucaria, hallowed hall dedicated to the study of magic.
为什么关上了大门？就因为我没有辉石头罩？: Why shut your doors to me? Am I barred from donning the crown of stone?
大人要我们守着这块王室的领地，: These royal grounds were placed in our trust,
……星象仪啊，将星星与月亮的法则，\n传达给后世的人们吧。: O Celestial Globe, transmit to posterity. The wisdom of the moon and stars.
永远隐藏公主所犯下的罪过吧。: And obscure, forever, the transgressions of the princess.
……菈妮大人，小的一直在等待。: Lady Ranni, we have long awaited you.
请大人复兴王室。: I pray for your house's swift revival.
愿满月与卡利亚同在……: May the full moon shine upon Caria.
……各位，快从昏暗的地底出来吧。: Come out, one and all, from the darkness underground.
为女巫大人献上我们的葡萄吧。: And let us offer unto the maiden our eyes.
……唉，那位大人也发疯了。: Ahh, the poor fellow...gone perfectly mad.
爱恨情仇，一切都被癫火烧熔了。: Love...revenge...the frenzied flame melts it all away...
另外一条回去黄金树树脚的路……: Another path, leading back to the foot of the Erdtree.
……噫……听到庆典的歌声了……: Eek... I hear a festive melody...
我的皮已经受玷污了……: My hide is filthy, I swear...
屹立不摇的黄金律法啊。: The Golden Order itself, unwavering, stretched to the sky.
请赐下指引，引导我们的艾尔登之王。: Confer your guidance. To our Elden Lord.
让世界得以修复……: To put this weary world to rights...
如果这充满污秽的战场，\n这副景象是你所盼望的亵渎……: If this putrid field of death is what your blasphemy would bring,
我就无法继续跟随你了。: then I can no longer abide.
竟然会爱上那种骯脏、残身的丑女，: Just deserts, for falling for that severed harpy.
还被那种罪人夺走了城和宝剑……: No surprise that guilty cretin took the castle and our storied sword...
嘻嘻……我一定要活下去，: Heh heh... I'll survive, I swear it.
活下去，回到火山官邸……: I'll soon be back at the Volcano Manor.
艾奥尼亚的初始之花，就是在这里绽放的吶。: The very first flower of Aeonia bloomed on this very spot.
……玛莲妮亚大人，请您成为女神。: Malenia, may you blossom into a goddess.
让拉塔恩将军恢复战士的名誉……: Honor General Radahn, with a warrior's glory.
杰廉啊，万事拜托了……: It's in your hands, Sir Jerren...
……拜托，再让我看一眼吧。: Let me see it, if only one last time.
那猩红腐败随之舞动的美妙剑舞。: Your splendid blade, dancing amongst the scarlet rot.
……好渴，好渴啊……: I'm dry, dry as a bone...
让我吃下，你的心脏……: Let me feast on your heart.
盖利德也好，魔法镇瑟利亚也罢，: The very earth that Caelid rests upon, and Sellia, town of sorcery.
一切都完了吶……: The end is nigh, for us all.
……噢，太阳啊！索尔的寒冷太阳啊！: Ohh great sun! Frigid sun of Sol!
让无魂的尸骸，得以再世……: Grant life to the soulless bones!
太阳还未受到侵蚀，都怪我们的祈祷过于无力。: The sun has not been swallowed. Our prayers were lacking.
……我可能无缘见到……: I will never set my eyes upon it now...
……光芒啊，照亮我的去路，: Show me the path, O gentle lights.
引导我前往应许的圣树！: The promised path to the Haligtree!
光芒啊，照亮我的去路……\n前往艾布雷菲尔的路……: Show me the path, O gentle lights...the path to Elphael.
……可恶的蒙格，流着诅咒之血的恶兆之子。: Mohg, you rotten Omen. Your blood is cursed.
你这种身分的东西，竟敢触碰大人……: How dare you lay hands on such precious flesh!
请您开恩，将小的纳入王朝的末座。: I beg you, grant me a seat at the table of the dynasty.
受到灰灭火焰焚烧，还是屹立不摇。: Tall and unwavering, mindless of the scorch of the flame of ruin.
既然如此，我们就还是黄金之民……: Then, we are yet Golden Ones.
……回朝啦，引颈期盼的王，回朝啦。: He is returned! The Lord has returned at long last.
我们的初始之王，会再一次展现艾尔登法环吶……: Our very first lord, to brandish the Elden Ring once more...
学习交战的方法，想起身为战士的事实。: Recall the arts of war. And your warrior's blood.
噢，我们是黄金之民、正统王者之民。: O, we are the Golden Ones. The true and rightful heirs.
我等是否还能返家？: Is there still a place for us?
赐予我等生命露滴吧。: Grant us the droplets of life,
我们除去蛀虫，我们拨开火星，: We swat at flies, snuff out flame,
我们驱散恶兆，我们屏除褪色。: Repel the Omen, and undo Tarnish.
侍奉永生，永生侍奉吧。: Serve you we shall, in life, eternal.
亚基尔的火焰啊，请将我燃烧殆尽吧……: Feral flame of Agheel, burn true...
棺木与我们同行，: We journey on a road so far,
我们寻找战争后英雄残存的片段，: Coffin in tow, we'll find a hero
我们寻找英雄的死亡命运。: And scraps of his great deeds!
这是谁的来路？: Who rode along this road before?
……你是褪色者吧？: You're a Tarnished, I can see it.
好像不会攻击我。: That you're not after my throat.
既然如此，要不要买些什么？: Then why not purchase a little something?
我叫咖列。\n可能看不太出来，我是做生意的。: I am Kalé. Purveyor of fine goods.
……怎么？还想买些什么吗？: What is it? Still going to purchase something?
又过来啦？那要不要买些什么？: Well, you're back. Care to buy something?
我出身流浪民族。: I am of a nomadic people.
艾尔登法环破碎之后，\n这块土地的人，脑袋几乎都变得不正常。: The land has been tainted by madness since the shattering of the Elden Ring.
好在有你们褪色者，\n我才得以摆脱毫无收入的下场。: It's only Tarnished like yourself who keep things from drying up entirely.
总之，之后也请多加惠顾了。: Let's say you're a very welcome customer.
啊，你手边的卢恩要是还够的话，: You know, if you can spare the runes,
我建议你买下工具皮袋。: you should buy yourself a crafting kit.
有了那只皮袋，就能自己制作简单的道具。: A crafting kit allows you to make basic items on your own.
要在这块土地奋战下去，颇需要这类东西。: Essential really, if you intend to survive out here for any duration.
那确实有点价位，卖出去我也能赚个一笔……: The kit costs a bundle, and I admit, I do take my cut.
但我的初衷，是希望重要的客人能活下去。: But the important thing is that you survive. Every customer counts, after all.
谢谢你相信我的话。: I'm glad you took my warning to heart.
我们幸存的族人，\n应该也在这块土地上讨生活。: There are others of my people who yet survive in these lands.
要是你遇到他们，有兴趣的话，\n和他们买点东西吧。: If the mood takes you when you meet one, then offer them some trade, won't you?
……我们流浪民族从古至今，\n都不受黄金赐福的青睐。: My people, wanderers all, have long been spurned by the grace of gold.
因此我们被迫四处为家，过着困顿的旅行生活。: Which is why we cannot settle, but instead are forced into this pitiful, unceasing journey.
在艾尔登法环破碎之后，我们还能保有神智，\n可能这就是原因吧。: But thanks to that, things are not so different for us now, though the Elden Ring is shattered.
光这点看来，褪色者和流浪民族，: I think this makes us kindred spirits of sorts.
我们两个还颇类似的。: Your people, the Tarnished, and mine.
……先和你说一声好了。: I suppose I shouldn't keep this from you.
再过一阵子，我会离开这个地方。: I'm thinking of moving elsewhere for a time.
流浪民族就该四处旅行，这也是理由……: My people are wanderers all, which I won't deny is one reason...
但主要是因为继续待在这里，\n好像也没办法得到大商队的情报。: But I've done all I can here, in search of the Great Caravan.
嗯，这个警告也许对你没有意义……: Perhaps you don't need to hear this, but...
记住，绝对不要攻击我们的族人。: See that no harm comes to my kin.
流浪民族有一条族规：: We have a saying, we wanderers.
“孤单也很好──即使受人轻视、被人抛弃，\n也不必想着谋求什么。”: Lament not your solitude. Expect no sympathy. No regard. Nothing.
“唯独那些伤害我们的，绝不能轻易放过。”: But if anyone dares harm us, show them no mercy.
要说的话，这就是我们的律法。: That is our code, so to speak.
这民族听起来很执着、很烦人吧？: Just the way we are. Deeply... unforgiving.
你有听过“大商队”吗？: Have you heard of the Great Caravan?
我们以前也有等同故乡的存在，: Well, even we had a place to call home, once.
就是那个“大商队”……\n只是不知不觉中消失不见，很久没人看过。: The Great Caravan, they called it… but it's been lost to us for ages.
我一直在寻找大商队的下落。: I've been searching for it as long as I can remember.
既然都有这么响亮名字了，: And with a name like that,
说不定能看见数也数不尽的稀世珍宝啊。: You'd hope they kept some fine goods there, eh.
……雾林里有狼嚎……: The howl of a wolf, in the Mistwood...
这样啊，是他……: I suppose he must still be skulking about...
……对了，应该介绍给你认识。: Mmm, I know. Why not meet him for yourself?
你之后听到狼嚎，\n在那声音的正下方打出暗号吧。: Next time you hear the wolf's howl, make this signal right under the source.
……没事，这没有什么。: Oh, don't fret, there is nothing to fear.
只是觉得你们应该处得来。: I just have an inkling the two of you might hit it off.
对了，有个人我想介绍给你认识。: Oh, by the way. There's someone you should meet.
你之后如果有听到狼嚎，\n在那声音的正下方打出暗号吧。: If you happen to hear a wolf's howl, make this signal under the source.
哦，你见过布莱泽了？: Oh, then you met Blaidd, did you?
那很好啊，我从中牵线也有价值了。: Wonderful. I'm glad I pointed you in his direction.
他态度不怎么友善，为人笨拙，\n找东西的能力也差到令人发噱……但人不错。: He's boorish, blunt, and couldn't find his nose with both hands, but he's a good egg.
希望认识彼此对你们来说，都是一件好事。: I think the two of you are sure to find the best in one another.
石文放得有价值了。: I knew leaving the sign would be worth the trouble.
我会暂时待在这里做生意。: Thought I'd set up shop here for a time.
要不要买些什么？: Right then. Care to purchase anything?
……你有没有在这附近看过乌鸦？: Have you seen a crow around here by any chance?
那种鸟爪上绑着信的墓地乌鸦。: You know, a burial crow, with a letter fastened to its claw?
要是你有看到，希望你能把它带的信卖给我。: Well, if you do set eyes upon it, I'll buy that letter from you, no question.
当然，之后买东西会给你一点优惠。: I'd give you a generous sum for it, of course.
谢谢，我一直很想得到这封信。: My thanks. I've been wanting to get my hands on this.
我们说好的，全是优惠价，挑你喜欢的吧。: And I was willing to pay whatever was needed. Your reward, as promised.
关于你拿来的那封信，: So, about the letter you brought me...
和我料想的一样，\n上面写着流浪民族使用的暗语。: It's just as I suspected, it features a cryptogram of my people.
……这可能是来自消失不见的大商队，\n上头标注的或许是他们的所在地。: And I'm sure it's come from wherever the Great Caravan disappeared to.
说不定我离他们越来越近了。: This could be my chance to get close to it.
……等我解开暗语之后，就会离开这里。: Once I decipher that cryptogram, I'll be packing up shop again.
对，我会用石文留下目的地。: Don't worry, I'll leave a sign that shows where I've gone.
要是有缘分，应该会再见到面吧。: With any luck, I'll see you there, eh.
……其实，我对于孤独一人这件事很满意。: I've always preferred my own company, to that of other people's...
而且事到如今，\n我也不是有什么话想对祖先说……: And I don't have any burning questions I wish to ask my ancestors...
我只是想知道──: But there's something I need to know.
我到底是谁、来自哪里、要往哪里前进？: I want to know who I am. Where I came from. Where I'm headed.
石文留得有价值了。: I knew leaving the sign would be worth the trouble.
当然，我还是有在做生意。: The shop is all set up.
对，关于那封信的暗语，: Oh yes, about the cryptogram from the letter...
上头写的位置，好像是在那座王城的地底。: I think it's pointing underneath the capital.
上头写的位置，好像是在这座王城的地底。: I think it's pointing here, underneath the capital.
可是我完全不知道怎样才能进到地底。: But I'm perplexed as to the path to take down there.
嗯，反正也不急于一时。: Well, the journey can wait, I suppose.
我打算多花点时间调查看看。: I'll settle here for the time being, and start looking into it.
……原来，在那种地方……: I can't imagine how it ended up there...
……说不定和那口井相连啊──: But the well might just lead under the capital.
信纸上暗号所写的，王城地底的某个地方。: To the spot indicated by the cryptogram from the letter.
……大商队会在那种地方，是有点奇怪……: Seems like an odd place for the Great Caravan...
想破头也没用。\n调查完之后，直接过去看看吧。: But no amount of thinking will change anything. I'll be heading straight there, after some preparation.
又受到你的帮忙了。: Once again, I find myself in your debt.
这是谢礼，收下吧。: Take this, as a token of my appreciation.
是非卖品，相当特殊的东西。: It's not from my usual stock, but something rather more special.
希望下一次我会在大商队和你碰面，: I hope you can join me at the Great Caravan, in fact.
说不定到时候，我的生意规模会变得更大！: Who knows what wonders there might be to trade?
我们祖先的模样，你看到了吗？: Did you see? What they did to my ancestors?
一整个民族被活埋进地底，病的病，疯的疯。: The whole clan, buried alive. Sick. Maddened. Husks of themselves.
那一阵阵，不像人类发出的悲叹声，\n你有听见吗？: Have you heard their moans? They're hardly human anymore.
……我们是参指的信徒？是招来狂病的祸首？: They think we worship the Three Fingers? That we called the maddening sickness down upon them?
好啊，那好啊！我就让一切变成事实吧！: Well. If that's what they expect from us, then that's what they shall get from us!
受到赐福的世界啊、人们啊，\n你们要轻视我们、抛弃我们都没关系。: The world of grace and its people should have been content to see us sink between the cracks.
只要你们影响、践踏我们的孤独，: But to have intruded upon our solace... Having broken us upon their whims...
我就绝对不会原谅你们。: I'll never forgive any of you.
对你很抱歉，但我不会再和你做生意了。: I'm sorry, but we won't be trading any longer.
……就此永别吧。: And...I think it's time we parted ways.
受到赐福指引，目标当上艾尔登之王──: Guided by grace, you seek to become Elden Lord.
我已经不能认同你们这些褪色者的存在。: I don't want anything to do with you Tarnished lot any more.
让你配合我东奔西跑，最后变成这种结果。: It's my fault that we stumbled into this mess.
就此永别吧。: I think it's time we parted ways.
……你受赐癫火了吗！: You've inherited the flame of frenzy!
啊啊，我……我也想要癫火……: Oh, that's it... That's what I need...
能把诅咒、痛苦、绝望、律法，\n所有的一切都熔化的……: To melt away the curses, suffering, and despair. And the Order, entire.
……参指啊，请您打开门吧。: O Three Fingers, throw wide the door.
请将黄色浑沌火焰赐予我吧。: Please, bestow unto me the yellow flame of chaos.
赐予我将诅咒、痛苦、绝望、律法──\n所有的一切都熔化的癫火吧。: A frenzied flame to melt away the curses, suffering, and despair. And the Order, entire.
……我不是……对的容器……: I was not... a suitable home.
……来到……参指深渊的人啊……: You, who reached the Three Fingers' abyss...
……转达给……必定为王的人……: Tell the one... Who will become Lord...
……卸下一切……走向门……: Divest yourself of everything, and head to the door.
……把诅咒、痛苦、绝望、律法……\n所有的一切都熔化……: To melt away the curses, suffering, and despair. And the Order, entire.
熔化诅咒、痛苦、绝望、律法……\n熔化所有的一切吧……: Melt away the curses, suffering, and despair. And the Order, entire.
……你要给我酒吗？: Are you offering that drink to me?
嗯，我不是那种商人，不接受贿赂。: Oh, no, what do you take me for? I am an honest merchant of good standing!
……我开玩笑的。: Oh, for heaven's sake, I jest.
如果是单纯表示心意的礼物，我愿意收下。: That's a very kind gesture, and I accept.
之后再请多关照了，大常客。: A pleasure as ever, old friend.
唉，原来你的真面目是盗匪啊。: I knew you for a highwayman all along.
就让你知道，: Then it's time you learnt a lesson.
攻击流浪民族，下场会怎样！: Our people will not stand for your barbarism!
你的真面目还真是无聊。: Is that all you were, mate?
你也一样？: So you're just like the others?
想要践踏我们吗？: Another would-be oppressor to my people.
唉，我懂了。你是属于那一边啊──: I see. I see how it is! You were one of them all along!
那些践踏我们，受到赐福的恶意化身！: Trying to trample us underfoot, you grace-given bastard?
……你们最好都熔化到尸骨无存，: Your kind...will all be razed clean.
这里……我在这里、在这里……: Yes, right this way... Right this way...
欢迎光临……流浪民族的商店……: Valued customer... Come trade, in our wandering emporium.
拜托了……我已经饿了好几天……: I'm hungry. I've been hungry so long. Please.
您又来光顾了啊……: How nice of you to stop by, again.
待在这么偏僻的地方，居然还能找到我。: Surprised you found me in my little nook.
嗯，也罢，总之横竖都是客人。: No matter, no matter. Your money's as good as anyone else's.
那来谈谈生意吧。: Why don't you take a look at my wares?
商品的来源，就别追问了。: Don't ask me how I got my hands on them, eh.
明白我商品的价值，很有眼光嘛……: Not everyone can tell how good my wares are. You've a discerning eye, you have.
您是客人吗……？: Are you here as a customer?
您再度莅临了啊。: I-I didn't realise you came back.
商品不是很尽善尽美……: I'm afraid I've very little to offer.
您、您不满意吗？: Oh, nothing that suits your tastes, then?
那就快点离开。: Well, be on your way, then.
已经很久没有客人上门了。: It's been an age since I've seen a customer.
……你跑到这么偏僻的地方，求的是什么？: How can I help, here at the end of the earth?
这些老商人的货物，有什么吸引到你的目光吗？: Did this aged merchant have something that caught your eye?
这件事，久远到令人怀念啊。: Well, how long has it been.
世袭职业真像影子，分也分不开啊。: Divorce from one's trade does not come easily.
畜生！你有什么问题？: Bollocks! What the devil's wrong with you!
……燃烧吧、熔化吧……: Melt away with the rest of it...
你干什么！住手！: What are you playing at! Stop this!
混账，少瞧不起人了，你这强盗！: That's the last straw, you bloody thief!
……别对我们流浪民族动手。: Stay away, Us wanderers have had enough.
我道歉！我会道歉！: It was me! It's all my fault!
……所以我才说，要你住手啊……: I warned you. I told you to stop...
你果然非善类！: I knew it, you dirty scoundrel!
打从一开始我就觉得可疑！: There was something off about you from the start!
去死吧！臭强盗！: Hurry up and die! You wretched thief!
流浪民族到底有多恐怖？: Of the swiftness of a wanderer's fury.
……在这种地方也会遇上强盗。: You'd come this far for your pillaging?
你们真的是无所不在。: No different than a plague, your kind.
真烦人，消失吧。: I've heard enough from you. Be gone.
……就连唯一的孤独，也不能拥有吗……？: All that I wanted was solitude…
沐浴光下，黑影转弱。: Shadow bathes in light and knows weakness
下方有求学洞窟。: The Cave of Knowledge lies below
我朝北方的利耶尼亚出发了。\n要是有缘分，再来谈生意吧。:
I'm bound northways for Liurnia.
May fate find us doing business again.
叛徒的后续处置完成了。\n\n你先前往诺克隆恩吧，\n我随后赶到。:
There's a traitor taken care of.
Onwards to Nokron, then.
Go on. I'll catch up.
致没有女巫陪伴的您：\n\n请动身前往利耶尼亚地区，\n门前镇西边的蔷薇教堂。:
Find yourself maidenless?
Off to Liurnia with you, then!
Seek the Rose Church, west of the Gate Town.
想找的物品，看来就在底下……: Surely what you seek is somewhere close by...
虹彩石是藏宝地点的标记。: Rainbow Stones lead the way to riches...
请到南门外的破屋一趟吧。: Stop by the shack beyond the southern gate
我朝北方的王城罗德尔出发了。\n要是有缘分，再来谈生意吧。:
I'm bound northways for Leyndell.
May fate find us doing business again.
大道的西方。: Seek the western edge of the main road
小道的楼梯上方，坏掉的桥。: Seek a shattered bridge at the top of a bypath
即使引导早已破碎，\n也请您当上艾尔登之王。:
Though the path be broken and uncertain,
claim your place as Elden Lord!
废墟有地下室。: A chamber lies under the ruins
在遥远的东方之地，\n应该有汇集龙之力量的大龙飨教堂。:
Far to the east, you'll find
the Cathedral of Dragon Communion.
A place where draconic power gathers.
我在王城外围的壕沟，等着玷污你。: I'll defile you next. Come to the outer moat.
嗯……这就是火山啊，\n没想到一点也不烫。\n去更下方试试看吧……:
I thought this a mountain of fire,
but I hardly feel a thing!
I'll have to head further down...
徒弟啊，我回去学院\n准备废除卡利亚王室、复兴起源。:
I will return to the academy, my apprentice.
To expel the Carian royal family,
and restore the primeval current.

在配置多人联机游玩的暗号之后，\n会和配置同一组暗号的玩家进行联机配对。\n\n:
If you set a multiplayer password, you'll only be matched with other players using the same password for most multiplayer features.

However, multiplayer passwords do not apply to invasion or support multiplayer.
在配置群组暗号之后，\n会优先显示使用同一组暗号玩家的下列状态：\n讯息、召唤记:
If you set a group password, you'll be more likely to see messages, summon signs, bloodstains, phantoms, and so on from others using the same password.

Elements given this special priority will appear differently from others.
消耗唤勾指药能看见召唤记号，\n借此召唤其他世界的玩家。\n（指药为消耗道具。）:
With a Furlcalling Finger Remedy, you can see summon signs, which can be used to summon players from other worlds.
(Finger Remedies are consumed with use.)

There are various types of summon signs.
Gold signs summon Furled Finger cooperators.
Red signs summon duelist adversaries.
(For either type of multiplayer, the summoning player becomes Host of Fingers.)
能写下协力多人联机游玩用的召唤记号。\n\n写下的记号会传布到其他世界，\n其他:
You can leave a gold summon sign to play cooperative multiplayer.

This sign will appear in other players' worlds and allow them to summon you as a Furled Finger for cooperative multiplayer.
Multiplayer begins once you are summoned.
(Your objective will be to defeat the area boss.)

If you leave a second summon sign, the older sign will vanish.
能写下敌对多人联机游玩用的召唤记号。\n\n写下的记号会传布到其他世界，\n其他:
You can leave a red summon sign to play competitive multiplayer.

This sign will appear in other players' worlds and allow them to summon you as a duelist adversary for competitive multiplayer.
Multiplayer begins once you are summoned.
(Your objective will be to defeat the Host of Fingers.)

If you leave a second summon sign, the older sign will vanish.
能作为“血指”入侵其他玩家的世界。\n\n入侵成功后，将前往其他世界，\n开始入:
Attempt to invade another player's world as a Bloody Finger.

If you successfully invade, invasion multiplayer will begin. (Your objective will be to defeat the Host of Fingers.)

You can attempt another invasion of the same world by using a Phantom Finger item. (These items are consumed upon use.)
能选择亲自召唤的人物，\n将对方遣返回原本的世界。\n\n该名人物会离开多人联机:
Choose a summoned player to
send back to their own world.

This player will be removed
from the multiplayer session.
离开多人联机游玩，返回原本的世界:
Removed from multiplayer session.
Returning to own world.
能吸引入侵者前来。\n\n即使没有召唤协助者（勾指）也会受到入侵，\n并且缩短玩:
Lures in invaders.

This allows your world to be invaded without any Furled Finger cooperators present, and it also shortens the interval between windows of opportunity for invasion.

Additionally, enables the arrival of a second invader to join when a cooperator is present. (With two invaders, the maximum number of cooperators becomes one.)
解除吸引入侵者的状态: Stop beckoning invaders to your world
收到来自其他世界的召唤请求时，\n能回应要求，作为狩猎入侵者的猎人接受召唤。\n:
Puts you into a ready state to answer, should
someone in another world call for rescue.
You will be summoned to their world as a hunter.

Multiplayer will begin once you are summoned.
(Your objective will be to defeat invaders.)
被入侵者入侵时，\n能自动发出请求，召唤狩猎入侵者的猎人。\n也能在被入侵后再使:
Allows you to automatically request for a hunter from another world to come to your rescue when your world is invaded.

You can also use this after being invaded to summon a hunter for help.
(Summoning rescuers may not always be possible.)
能将协力多人联机游玩的召唤记号\n送往数个记号聚集处。\n（仅限已可使用的记号聚:
Send a cooperative summon sign to several summoning pools (activated pools only).

If you are summoned, you will be transported to that summoning pool's location in the host player's world and multiplayer will begin.
(Your objective will be to help the host player defeat the area boss.)
抹除送往记号聚集处的协力记号: Remove co-op summon sign from summoning pool
能将敌对多人联机游玩的召唤记号\n送往数个记号聚集处。\n（仅限已可使用的记号聚:

the longer it takes for the death gauge to fill.
